title: Walamo Jehova Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Walamo Jehova Nyasaye,
Walamoi, Yesu Kristo,
Kod Roho Maler mar Ruodhwa,
Hera margi duong' ahinya.

2. Walamo Wuonwa gi Roho,
Omiwa chiemo mar chunywa,
Kodi gik moko mabeyo,
Wamiyogi duong' tinende.

3. Walamoi, Yesu Kristo,
Nisethonwa e Kalwari,
Iluoko chunywa gi rembi,
Wamiyoi duong' tinende.

4. To Roho Maler mar Nyasaye,
Manyisowa richo duto
Odwaro nyisowa Nyasaye,
Wamiyoi duong' tinende.

title: Un Duto Joma Dak e Piny
Nyasaye Maduong'
lyrics:
1. Nyasaye maduong' in kendi e Ruoth
Nichiwo Ruoth Yesu Wuodi mihero:
Modoko misango kuom richo duto,
Mond' oyaw yor Polo ni ji duto te.

Chorus:
Pakuru Nyasachwa, Piny duto opake.
Pakuru Nyasachwa, Nyinge mond' oyud duong'.
Biuru ir Nyasaye kuom yie Yesu,
Miyeuru duong' Nyasachwa maduong'.

2. Warruok mwaseyudo en tich mar Nyasaye,
Ni ng'ato ka ng'ato moyie Yesu.
Ng'at moyie Yesu oyudo warruok
Richone duto te owene chutho.

3. Ruoth osepuonjowa weche mag polo
Momiyo wabet gi mor kuom Ruoth Yesu.
Osemiyowa teko mar bet kode,
Kendo en notelnwa ndalo duto te.

title: Denduru Ruodhwa
lyrics:
1. Denduru Ruodhwa maduong' malo,
Kuwer kodi mor, herane to duong'
En e Jarit marwa nyaka nene chon
Betne oler chutho ma duto opake.

2. Hulie tekone, nyis ji ng'wonone,
En e Chieng' mar piny, maloyo duto.
Mirimbe to duong' ka mor mar polo,
To jo moyie e molong'one adier.

3. Ditamwa hulo hawi man kuomwa,
Osemiyowa mwachando pile,
Ng'wonone ni kodwa ndalo ka ndalo,
Koro wakulore e nyime kwalame.

4. Wan dhano mar piny ma onge teko,
In e mwageni ok iweyowa:
Kuom Yesu Kristo iyiewa koro,
Rembe omiyo wasudo kwalamoi.

title: Anawer Wende Malong'o
lyrics:
1. Anawer wende malong'o
Kuom Yesu ma nothona,
Noweyo duong'ne e Polo
Mond' otho e Kalwari.

Chorus:
Anawer wende miwuoro
Kuom Kristo ma nothona,
Weruru, jo maler duto
Man e Polo gi piny te.

2. Ka nalal, Yesu nonwang'a
Kaka rombo morwenyo,
Gi hera maber moloyo
Ma noduoga e yore.

3. Jawarna nowara chutho
Kuom richo ma noloya,
Naketho, luoro nomaka,
To noresa kuom duto.

4. Chandruok pod obiro kuoma
Kaneno chuny lit bende,
To Jawarna ok oweya,
Ohoya maber pile.

title: Wapaki Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Wapaki Nyasaye kuom Wuodi mihero,
Kuom Yesu Motho, Mochier, Modhi e Polo.

Chorus:
Halleluya! duong' mari, Halleluya amen.
Halleluya! duong' mari, Jiwowa koro.

2. Wapaki Nyasaye nikech Roho Maler,
Monyisowa Jawarwa Magolo mudho.

3. Pak kodi duong' kuom Nyarombo Nyasaye
Moseting'o richowa, Moluokwa mapoth.

4. Jiwowa kendo, pong' chunywa gi hera
Mondo tichwa omoko gi mach mar Polo.

title: Nyinge Ni Duong'!
An Apake
lyrics:
1. Ka nawinjo Soko nochwer,
Mar luoko richo duto,
Nayie Roho kopenja,
Idwaro doko maler?

Chorus:
An apake! An apake!
Yesu ma notho kuomwa;
Pakeuru un mong'eyo,
Ni rembe e moluoko richo.

2. Kata yorni obet madiny,
Gik ma yande nahero,
Duong' kodi ber mar pinyni,
Akwano ka gin nono.

3. Mach mar Nyasaye e mopwodha,
Mojiwo chunya koro,
Ok naweyo pako Nyinge,
Duong' obedne pile.

4. Duong' nobed ni Nying Yesu!
Amor nikech herane.
Moweyona richo duto,
Moluoko chunya maler.

5. Duong', duong' ni kuom Wuoro!
Duong', duong' ni Wuode!
Duong', duong' ni kuom Roho!
Gin adek to gin achiel!

title: Neuru En Omiyo
lyrics:
1. Neuru En emomiyo ji teko mar loyo lueny,
Gari mare huyo malo e kor boche mag Polo.
Malaika man e Polo giluongo nyinge ni Ruoth;
Kwaruake e chunywa koro wanamor ma nyaka chieng'.

2. En ng'awano ma nomiyo ji duto mapako En,
En Yesu, ma Wuod Nyasaye, En Yesu Ruodhwa maber.
Nochandorenwa mokuongo, nyaka nothonwa e Yath.
Thone nogo en Owuongo noriembonwa tho chutho.

3. Nochiko jogo makwaye, En nobi omigi gweth.
Noidho e Polo malo, ne ginene kak' odhi.
E piny ka notimo duto ma Nyasaye nochike.
Tichne e piny ka norumo, enodok e i Polo.

4. Kawuono En e Jadolo, wanadonjo gi rembe.
Jogo maler ma nokwaye En ong'won owinjogi,
En ochikowa kamano En ogolo richowa.
Nyasaye noyie mondo othonwa kuom richowa.

5. E ringre ma nogur e Yath, ema nochwero remo,
E kuome wayudo hawi wadoko nyithind Nyasaye,
Nyasaye obedo malo En kanyachiel gi joge.
Kayie Ruodhwa mokwongo anadonji e Polo.

title: Alleluya! Yesu Ruodhwa!
lyrics:
1. Alleluya! Yesu Ruodhwa! Werneuru wer mamit:
Alleluya! En moloyo, En moloyo En Owuon.
To winjuru wende Polo, Ka ji wero wer mamor:
"Yesu e mowaro duto, Rembe e mogudowa."

2. Alleluya! Ok iwewa Kaka kiye dong' malit:
Alleluya! Intie butwa, Wan wayie chutho ma.
Kata en nodok e Polo, Ka noa e piny kucha,
En nosingore kamano, "Nyaka chieng' abet kod in."

3. Alleluya! Cham me Polo, In misirowa e piny:
Alleluya! In mikonyo Jo maricho duto ka:
In milamonwa e Polo, Wan wahombi, ng'wononwa,
Terwa ka malong'o malo, Ka maler e nyimi cha.

4. Alleluya! Yesu Ruodhwa! Werneuru wer mamit:
Alleluya! En moloyo, En moloyo en owuon.
To winjuru wende Polo, Ka ji wero wer mamor:
"Yesu e mowaro duto Rembe e mogudowa."

title: Moyawo Yo Madhi
lyrics:
1. Oganda jopolo wero kech mar Nyasaye kuom Joge,
Pi mar soko no mar ng'wono oketo wer e chunya,
Chunya wero ni Ruoth Wende pak kahulo ng'wonone maduong'
Moyawo yo madhi dala ni tieng'no ma nobayo.

2. Aparo herani maduong' miya bet nyathi Nyasaye,
Lwetino matiyo kuoma nochopa e singruokni,
Ruoth miya hulo kuom Misangoni misetimo kuom Yesu,
Moyawo yo madhi dala ni tieng'no ma nobayo.

3. An jagop wach mar Warruokni ka ok a hule ni ji.
Kechni koro otue chunje e lojno mar ng'wononi,
Kama niora Ruoth itelna' yo, miya chir aland wecheni,
Moyawo yo madhi dala ni tieng'no ma nobayo.

title: Chieng' Mar Chunya
lyrics:
1. Ruoth in e chieng' mar ngimana,
Jawarna maber mahero,
Otieno mudho ongena
Ka in buta Ruodha Yesu.

2. Ka nindo koro teroa,
Pong' parona kod kuwe mari
Mondo ayud nindo mokuwe
Ebwo herani mosiko.

3. Bed koda Ruodha mahero
Otieno kendo e odiechieng
Kik abedi mabor kodi
Kabet kodi en ngima adier

4. Kaka nyathi mayom adier
Adwaro hochni pile Ruoth
Maka gi lweti mar ng'wono
Awinj ka lweti miya hoch.

5. Ji matuo oyud kweni;
Ji modhier one ng'wononi,
To ji mayuak oyud hochni
Duto oyud nindo maber.

6. Okinyi ka piny orunwa
Wasud iri kama intie
Kwadonj' e piny mosekoru
Wabed e lweti mar konyruok.

title: Chunya Pak Ruoth Yesu Kristo
lyrics:
1. Chunya pak Ruoth Yesu Kristo,
Napodh nyime ka apake;
Ong'wonona ochangoa,
Momiya warruok maduong'.
Anapake, Anapake,
Kuom warruokne man gi gweth.

2. Anapake kamiye duong',
Nikech noloyonwa lweny;
Anapake, mak adok chien,
Nikech nohera adier.
Anapake, Anapake,
Nikech herane maduong'.

3. Oritowa wan nyithinde,
Ong'eyowa moloyo;
Otayowa ka wawuotho,
Oriembonwa wasikwa.
Anapake, Anapake,
Kuonde duto madhiye.

4. Malaika bende pake,
Kagirango wang' Yesu;
Wan bende chieng' ma wanachier
Wanapake kanyakla.
Wanapake, Wanapake,
Nikech ng'wonone maduong'.

title: En Wach Maduong'
lyrics:
1. En wach maduong' mawuoro ahinya
Ka Ruodha Yesu noyie tho kuoma.
Ne gigure e yath rembe nochwer
Mar luoko richona ka yie kuome.
Hera mar Nyasaye moloyo richona gi duong'
Nonyisore ratiro ka nochiwo Ruoth Yesu.
Hera maduong' kod ng'wonone
Nofwenyore ka notho kuoma.

2. Remb Kristo man gi teko maduong'
Nochwerna e wi Yath mar Kalwari.
Tiend wachni ok anyal nge'yo chuth
Ka Nyasaye nochiwe mond' othona
Kata chwechne duto man e Polo wuoro te
Kaka Kristo ne nyalo kawo kit dhano ka an.
Mond' owara kuom ng'wonone
Konyiso hera maduong' chutho.

3. Ne oweyo duong'ne e Polo
Kar dak maber ma onge maromogo,
Nikech an noweyo duong' Polo.
Ni mondo othona e Kalwari
Nonyiso herane gi ng'wonone adiera
Kochiwo ngimane ni mondo ayudi warruok.
Warruok maduong' kuom ng'wonone
Manogonya ae twech richo.

4. Chunya nokuyo ei twech richo
Richo kod mudho nopong' dhood chunya
Nyaka ler mar Ruoth nofwenyore.
Mayudo thuolo kod ler e chunya
Koro apako ng'wonone maduong' kuoma
Mogonya kendo gola ae twech mar richo
Osegonya koro amor
Momiya bedo thuolo chutho.

5. Bura koro ok oloya kendo
Abedo mar Ruoth Yesu to en mara.
En e wiya to an e ringre
Osepong'a kod adiera mare
Koro an gi chir mar chopo e kom duong' maler
Kuom Yesu aserwako osimbo ma nyaka chieng'
An ok aluor bedo bute
Nikech Ruoth Yesu osewara.

title: Duong' ni Nying Yesu
lyrics:
1. Duong' ni Nying Yesu Kristo! Jomalaika dende;
Keturu osimbo kuome, Kwatime Ruoth chutho.
Keturu osimbo kuome, Kwatime Ruoth chutho.

2. Ji mag ogendini duto Modak e piny ngima,
Miyeuru duong' chutho, Waleuru ka Ruoth.
Miyeuru duong' chutho, Waleuru ka Ruoth.

3. Chieng' ma wanabed e Polo, Wanapodhi nyime,
Wanapake gi wer pile, En e Ruodhwa chutho.
Wanapake gi wer pile, En e Ruodhwa chutho.

title: A Nyasacha, Aneno Gik Miwuoro
lyrics:
1. A Nyasacha, aneno gik miwuoro,
Ka tich lweti nyisowa riekoni.
Sulwe gi chieng', gi dwe marieny e Polo,
Tekoni Ruoth ritogi kuonde gi.

Chorus:
Chunya opong' gi wer ka pakoi,
In Nyasacha, tekoni duong'!
Chunya opong' gi wer ka pakoi,
In Nyasacha, herani duong'!

2. Kawuoth' e gwenge duto gin tich lweti,
Chwech duto wer, gi mor ka pakoi,
Gode gi bunge, winy, nam gi aore
Kanenogi nyiso chal tekoni.

3. Kabet kaparo herani Nyasacha,
Ikelo Yesu e ringruok mar piny,
Mond' e ringre okumie richo jogi,
Dhiera hulo tut herani kuoma.

4. Yesu bang' tho, nochier, nodhi e Polo,
Enoduogi oma wabed kode.
Nating' dwonda kapake manyaka chieng',
Kahulo kechne momiya nono.

title: Yesu Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Yesu Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye,
Chon nobiro konyowa.
En nonyisogi rieko,
En nochango jo matuo.

Chorus:
Yesu Kristo, Wuod Nyasaye,
Onyisowa, onyisowa rieko.
Yesu Kristo, En kend' e Ruoth,
Wanabet nyithinde adier.

2. Yesu Kristo oloyo duto;
En modwaro konyowa,
Mondo wan wawe gi fuwe
Mondo chunywa bed mak.

3. Koro wan wayie Yesu;
Kite long'onwa koro.
Pilepile wanahere,
Wachne wanamak adier.

title: Yesu Jawar, Pakuru
lyrics:
1. Yesu Jawar, Pakuru Jawarwa maduong'!
Herane tut tama hulo duto.
Malaika kod Jomoyie mag piny duto
Hulo duong'ne kod berne kuom joge.
Kaka Jakwath wang'e ni kuom Rombege,
Kuonde duto owuotho kod joge.
Joma geno chamo olembe mag god Zion
Tiyo ni Ruoth ka gi dende kod pak.

2. Yesu Jawar kuom herane notho kuomwa,
Rembe thone nopwodho richona.
Singruok manyien notim kuom rembe gi ringre,
Warruok na chung' e lwanda mak yiengni.
Hera Jawar notimo chir e sandruok,
Teko mar tho nolo e msalaba,
Kondo kudho ka gi jare kendo yanye
Noloyo tho ongima tinende.

3. Yesu Jawar Jadolo en Ruodh Piny duto,
Chwech me Polo pake wer Hosana.
Loch Ruoth Yesu osiko chieng' manyaka chieng'
En noloyo Jachien kod riekone
Mi nyinge duong' e wecheni duto te.
In tho onge wach mopondo kuomi
In okang' mar weyo ringruokni mar piny
Ka arwakora gi ringruok mar Polo.

title: Pakeuru, Un Mong'eye
lyrics:
1. Pakeuru, un mong'eye,
Yesu Kristo ma Jawarwa,
Oseng'iewa, e momiyo
Wahere adier.

2. Nying mabernwa en e Yesu,
En e moritowa pile,
Onge manyalo chandowa
Ka pod wagene.

3. Geneuru ndalo duto,
En adieri mak olokre.
Onge manyalo golowa
E hera mare.

4. Ritwa, Ruoth, mondo wak
Jogi moyiei pile
Nyaka iterwa e Polo;
Wanabed kodi.

5. Ka wabedo ku ma Intie
Wanabedi malony chutho
Gik ma koro pod waremit
Ginibed marwa.

title: Chieng' Moro Ka Polo
lyrics:
1. Chieng' moro ka Polo ne il ahinya,
To piny mwalo richo noketho chuth,
Yesu nobiro monyuole ka dhano,
Mondo obed gi ji modak e piny.

Chorus:
Nohera chutho; nothona e yath;
En nogolo richo mag chunya.
Nochier moloyo tho, mond' ayud gonyruok
Obiro duogo, Jawarna Maduong'.

2. Joricho mag piny nokawo Ruoth Yesu,
Kendo negigure e Yath malit,
Nohinye chuth kendo noting'o wichkuot,
Mondo owarwa wa-ae richo.

3. Chieng' onogo ne gikawegi ike,
Ei bur mokuny mondo oyuwe,
En e geno mar jomaricho duto
Kuom en wayudo warruok maduong'.

4. Burno mane gi ikoe Ruoth Yesu,
Noyawore gi teko mar Nyasaye.
Yesu nochier mane oloyo tho chuth
Koro ongima modak gi joge.

5. Chieng' moro en nowir kendo e pinyni,
Wabiro nene gi duong'ne maler,
Noduog kod joge maler duto chieng'no,
Chieng'no wanamor kwaneno wang' Ruoth.

title: Ok Anawe Pako Nyinge
lyrics:
1. Nikech Nyasaye ogwedha ngang',
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
Kuom herane maduong' maber,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

Chorus:
Ok anawe pako Nyinge,
Jawarna, Jawarna,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge,
Osegwedha adier.

2. Nogolo richona duto,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
Dhano machon nogur e Yath,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

3. Okonya pile saa mar teo,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
To rembe bende pwodha,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

4. Otega ndalo duto te,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.
Otelona e yo maber,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

5. Ka pod awuotho e piny
Ok anawe pako Nyinge;
Kendo kotera e polo,
Ok anawe pako Nyinge.

title: Adierani Maduong'
lyrics:
1. Adierani maduong', Nyasaye Wuonwa,
Onge tipo manyalo geng'oi;
Ok ilokri, Ng'uononi ok nyal rem, ngang';
Mana kak' isebet in mosiko.

Chorus:
Adierani maduong', Adierani maduong'.
Pile ka pile kechni ni kuoma.
Gik ma an go lweti em' osechiwo—
Adierani maduong', Nyasaye Wuora.

2. Kinde mag liet gi ng'ich, gi koth kod koyo,
Chieng', dwe gi sulwe kuonde magintie,
Kaachiel gi chwech duto gi hulo duong'ni,
Gi ng'uono kod herani mosiko.

3. Ng'uononi mar weyo richo osiko,
Betni kodwa jiwowa telonwa,
Teko mar kawuono kod geno makiny
Gwethni mogundho chuth isemiya.

title: Tinende Apako Yesu
lyrics:
1. Tinende apako Yesu,
Ayiego e Ruodhwa,
Ok akwero kite kawuono.
Aselokora koro.

Chorus:
Tinende apako Yesu,
Ayiego e Ruodhwa,
Ok akwero kite kawuono.
Aselokora koro.

2. Ayieni In Iduong'
In Inge'yo chunya chuth,
Chon nadagi Wachni madier,
Gik mabeyo ok nadwar.

3. Chon naluwo bang' Satani,
Kodi gik man e yore,
Tinende, Ruoth, aseweyo
Wang'yore ne kod kite.

4. Ok adhi e yori kenda,
Ruoth, Itelona koro,
Gi lweteni matek ngang' ngang
Ndalona duto e piny.

title: Ji Duto Mondo Giwer
lyrics:
1. Oo, ji duto mondo giwer
Ka gipako Jawar, ka gi pako Jawar.
Giduong' mar Nyasachwa kendo Ruoth.
Gilochne mar ng'uono. Gilochne mar ng'uono.
Gilochne mar ng'uono.

2. Ruodha mang'won kendo Nyasacha
Konya mondo aland, konya mondo aland
Aland wachni kuonde duto.
Nyingi mondo yud duong'. Nyingi mondo yud duong'.
Nyingi mondo yud duong'.

3. Yesu e nying magolo luoro,
Magolo luorowa, ma golo luorowa.
En e wer e it jaricho.
Engima kendo kwe. Engima kendo kwe. Engima kendo kwe.

4. Ogolo teko mar richo
Ogonyo ng'at motue, ogonyo ng'at motue.
Rembe ema nyalo luoko richo.
Rembe nochwerona, Rembe nochwerona, Rembe nochwerona.

title: Jathieth Maduong'
lyrics:
1. Jathieth maduong' osudo ka,
En Yesu ma Jakonywa;
Wachne omiyo chunywa mor,
Yaye, winjuru dwonde.

Chorus:
Wer mamit mar jopolo,
Ka gipako Ruoth Yesu,
Nying' moloyo nying duto,
Yesu Kende, Yesu.

2. Oseweyoni richoni,
Winji Yesu kowacho;
Chunyi koro obed gi kuwe,
Kichiko wang'yor Polo.

3. Wadend Nyarombono more
Koro ayie kuom Yesu.
Ahero nying' mar Jawarna
Ahero nyingno, Yesu.

4. Nyingno ogolo richona,
Onge maromo kode;
Chunya mor nade kawinjo,
Nyingno maber mar Yesu.

5. Koduogo chiwo osimbo—
Osimb ngima mar locho—
Eka wanabedi bute,
Wanadend Jawar Yesu.

title: Ahero Pako Yesu Ruoth
lyrics:
1. Ahero pako Yesu Ruoth nikech nowaroa,
Adwaro miye duong' chutho ndalona duto ka,
Ayie chutho kuom rembe moluoko richo ji,
Amor kuom liswane mosetimo e Kalwari.

Chorus:
Yesu oseng'iewowa, Nogolo richowa,
Nosemiyowa ngima, En nowachonwa kama.
Yesu oseng'iewowa, Nogolo richowa,
Nosemiyowa ngima, En nowachonwa kama.

2. Ka ng'ato yie Yesu en odoko ng'a manyien,
Omor kuom tekono mar Ruoth Nyasaye man malo,
Ohero nyiso ji duto kuom liswane adier,
Ma Yesu nosetimoni ji gi ringre owuon.

3. Joma oyie Yesu ok onyalo dhi e mach,
Noting'ogi e luetene ndalogi duto ka,
Satani en e jasikgi otemogi matek,
To Yesu en okonyo jo moiko chunygi chuth.

4. Ndalo moro noomowa gi tung' machien moyuak,
Noterowa e polo kama wanasik kode,
Nomiyowa ringruok manyien nikech nosewacho,
Adwaro neno Yesu Ruodhwa mosewarowa.

title: E Nyingi, Yesu
lyrics:
1. E nyingi, Yesu, wan wayie
To owinjore wapake,
Malaika nochako Nyinge,
Nying'no maber mar Yesu.

Chorus:
Yesu, Yesu mwapako,
Yesu, Nyinge tu duong',
Yesu, wayuakne duto,
Nying' maber mar Yesu.

2. E Nyingi Yesu En kende
E ma nokelonwa ngima,
To nying' moro onge kuom ji
Maber moloyo Yesu.

3. To Weche oremowa ka,
Mondo wahul e malong'o,
To hawine ofwenyore,
Gi Nying' maber mar Yesu.

4. Gi wendeno to en hawi,
E ndalonogo mar Polo,
Gi higini gi higini,
Wawero Nying' mar Yesu.

title: Weruru Wer Mamit
lyrics:
1. Weruru wer ma mit ni Ruoth ma Nyasachwa.
Otimo gik malich miwuoro,
Kendo oselocho gi teko ne maduong',
Pake uru kuwer ne gi mor.

Chorus:
Wapake wadende ni gik mosetimo.
Wanyis ji ber mare gi ritne.
Kendo walame kwa dung'ne gi tik mamit.
Kwa kulore nyime gi Lamo.

2. Weruru Ni Nyasaye kupake gi thumbe,
Adier go uru thumbe mamit.
Ka achiel gi asili kod tunge mayuak
Kukok e nyim Nyasaye ma Ruodhwa.

3. In nam wuo ka achiel gi gik man eiyi
In piny gi ji duto wer uru.
Un nembe madongo paruru kupake
Ungode wer uru kanyakla.

4. Un pewe landuru Wach Maber mar Ruodhwa
Osebiro mondo orit piny.
Obiro rito ogendni duto me piny,
Gibura makare gadiera.

title: Yesu, Isethona
lyrics:
1. Yesu, Isethona, koro aheri,
Kuom tekoni anawe richo duto
Nikech in Jawarna mang'won maduong'
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

2. Aheri nikech ihera mokwongo
Nyaka iseting'o richona e Yath
Kaka nichandori kuom richo duto
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

3. Aheri kangima kata anatho
Kendo anapaki ndalo duto ka,
Anaparo pile kuomi, Jawarna,
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

4. Anamii duong' e ute Polo
Kadhi bedo kodi kuno nyaka chieng',
Ka wer kod osimb ngima mar Ruoth Nyasaye,
Koro Yesu Kristo aheri adier.

title: An Ahero Yesu
lyrics:
1. Ahero winjo Nying Yesu,
Ahero miye duong':
En wenda kod morna pile,
Omitna moloyo.

Chorus:
An ahero Yesu, An ahero Yesu,
An ahero Yesu, nohera mokwongo.

2. Nyingno onyisa kuom hera
Jawar ma nothona,
Rembe e ma nochwerona,
Magolo richona.

3. Onyisa kuom gweth mag Wuora
Momiyowa pile,
Kata awuotho e chandruok,
Lerne orienyna.

4. Nyingno onyisa kuom Jakony
Man koda ndalo duto,
Ka chunya lit ohoyoa,
Omiya mor pile.

title: Ng'wono Mawuoro
lyrics:
1. Ng'wono mawuoro ahinya,
Ma nowara chutho;
Nalal marach, to nonwang'a,
To koro apake.

2. Nopuonja gi ng'wono bende,
Nyaka chunya noyie.
Ne oberna ka naneno
Wach herane kuoma.

3. Kata awuotho e chandruok
Kod tem mathoth mag piny,
Kuom ng'wonone oserita,
Ritne e mageno.

4. Wanapake higni mak rumo
E Polo malo cha,
To pod noremnwa miye duong'
Kaka owinjore.

title: Neuru Ruoth Mar Ruodhi
In Maler Adiera!
Nowara
lyrics:
1. Nowara mi amor kahulo
Nowara gi remb Nyarombo;
Nowara gi ng'wonone maduong'
Koro abet nyathi Nyasaye.

Chorus:
Warruok, warruok!
Nowara gi remb Nyarombo;
Nowara, nowara,
Koro abet nyathi Nyasaye.

2. Amor nikech Yesu nowara,
Onego apake pile;
Lerne orienyna ndalo duto,
En koda ma ok noweya.

3. Aparo kuom Jawarna pile,
Noyie thona mond' owara;
Chunya opong' gi mor ka pake,
Wach herane e mawero.

4. Ang'eyo nanene gi duong'ne
Chieng' ma nobi omo joge;
Otelona kendo orita,
Wachne omiya 'mor pile.

title: Nyingno mar Yesu
lyrics:
1. Nyingno mar Yesu oloyo duto,
Malaika be kata ji duto,
Nyingno mar Yesu waduto wayie,
Waduto wahulo Nyingi Yesu Ruodhwa.

Chorus:
Yesu, Yesu Nyingi ni to nomi duong',
Yesu, Yesu oumowa duto te,
In miderma me Polo,
Kendo joKristo duto,
Yesu, Nyingi ni to ni duong' ngang'.

2. Nyingno mar Yesu malaika wer,
To joKristo duto giwer mamit,
Nyingno mar Yesu e ma wapako,
To wahulo duto Nyingi Yesu Ruodhwa.

3. Nyingno mar Yesu wayudo hawi,
Omiyo chunywa yudo mor chutho,
Nyingno mar Yesu e mwayud' e kwe,
To wahulo duto Nyingi Yesu Ruodhwa.

4. Nyingno mar Yesu oloyo duto,
To wayudoe ngima gi hawi,
Uwinji Yesu en e Jaloyo,
To wahulo duto Nyingi Yesu Ruodhwa.

title: To Mise Mar Kanisa
lyrics:
1. To mise mar Kanisa
En Yesu Kristo Ruoth,
Kanisa nosechuweyo
Gi pi gi wach maler.
Nolor ni mond' olose
Ka miahane maler,
Gi rembe noseng'iewe
Kuom ngimane notho.

2. Ogandane moyiero
Kuom jo modak e piny
Gigeno Kristo kende
Gi yie gi nyuol manyien.
Gipako nying Ruoth Yesu
Gichamo chiemo achiel,
Gigeno gik me Polo
Gi ng'wono kodi ler.

3. Jopinyini wuoro chutho
Kuom chandruokne mapek
Moyudo ei tichne
Kuom puonj mapogore.
To jomaler adieri
Gilemo kendo yuak,
Gichal joma nie mudho
To lergi biro rieny.

4. E chandruok moseyudo
E lwenjege mager
Orito ndalo giko
Gi kuwe ma ok norum.
Ka duong' mar Ruoth nofwenyore
Gibiro il adier,
Kanisa moselocho
Nobed gi mor adier.

5. E piny ka en gi riwruok
Gi Ruoth Nyasaye maduong';
To bende en gi riwruok
Gi ji mobet gi Ruoth.
Wakwayi, Ruoth, Ikonywa
Ni mondo wan ka gin
Wabed mangima kodgi
Kwadak kama intie.

title: Duong' Mar Hekalu Machien
lyrics:
1. Ndalo machon higni mosekadho,
E higa mar ariyo mar loch Ruoth Darius.
Weche mane Ruoth Nyasaye owacho,
Gidho Janabi Hagai emagi.

Chorus:
Chak ur' achaka tich nikech an kodu,
Kendo Roho mara ni kuomu.
Kik uluor awacho kama,
Abiro yiengo polo gi piny kodi nam.
Bende nayieng ogendini duto,
Mi mwandu gi duto nobi ka,
Mi napong' Hekaluni gi duong' maler,
Anie wuon fedha kendo dhahabu.

2. Bende nitie ng'ato modong' kuomu,
Manoneno Hekaluni gi duong' machon,
Kakamano to tind ochal nade?
Donge ochalonu kagi maonge.

3. Nyis Zerubabel, Joshua kod jitee,
Mondo gijiwre gibed motegno kuom Ruoth,
Ruoth Nyasaye Manyalo Gik Moko Tee,
An Ruoth Nyasaye emawacho kamano.

4. Duong' ma Hekaluni biro betgo,
Nolo duong' manene engo mokwongo,
An Ruoth Nyasaye Manyalo duto,
Kamano anakel kuwe gi gweth ka.

title: Yesu Jakwadha Mohera
lyrics:
1. Yesu Jakwadha mohera
Okecha ndalo duto.
An ok achando gimoro
Owuotho koda nyaka chieng'.

2. Naweyo yoo nalal marach
To en owuon nodwara.
Noting'a e goke mos komor
Nomor kotera dalane.

3. Kar lek mamit kar pi mokwe
Otera kanyo pile.
Okwayoa oritoa,
Yesu Jakwath mang'won adier.

4. Ka tho nitie ok analuor
Ka Yesu bedo koda.
Ohoyoa osiroa
En kende emotelona.

5. Opedho mesa e nyima.
Kikombena opong' chutho
Achamo chiemb misangoni
Owira gi mo mang'we ng'ar.

6. Otego chunya nyaka chieng'
Ogwedha ndalo duto.
Jakwath maber anadendi
Ei Polo ndalo duto.

title: Awero Kuom Hera Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Awero kuom hera Nyasaye maduong' manie polo;
Kuom ng'wonone maduong' ahinya nochiwo Wuode Yesu,
Mondo kuom sand kod tho ni jo moyie mag ogendini duto,
Masiche mag chuny kod parruok na aketo ni Yesu Ruoth.

Chorus:
En manotho mochwero rembe
Onge gima nowe ting'o.
Herano mar Yesu Jawarna
Okawo ting'na duto.

2. Awero kuom hera Nyasacha, e godno mar Kalwari,
Opwodho richona, komiyo adoko Nyathi Nyasaye.
Nobiro e piny mondo jomoyie kuome mondo oyudi gweth,
Kar dang'ni mara Ruoth iko yo okawo ting'na duto.

3. Roho mar Nyasaye miya ng'eyo tiend wachne pile pile,
Noloso kar dakne e chunya e teko mar Yesu Ruoth.
Koloko paro dwaro mondo ochal gi Ruodha Yesu,
Kar dak kadhier gi parruok pinyini omiyo amor kuome.

4. Awero mich polo mayudo kuom Yesu ma Jawarna,
Alamo teko polo konya lando wach warruok Yesu,
Mondo giwinj wach warruok mar richo kuom Ruodha Yesu,
Mondo gitony gia e yor tho giwuothi kod Ruodh ngima.

title: Be An Jarit Msalaba?
lyrics:
1. Be an Jarit msalaba?
Japuonjre Ruoth Yesu
Koso naluor hulo nyinge
Kendo ndhogo tichne.

Chorus:
Wanalo temruok
Nyaka watundi ire.
Wanalo temruok
Nyaka wanagow loka.

2. Kik adonji gi yo mayot,
Ma ok akedo lweny.
Kachiwora kata ne tho
Kendo kawachni sira.

3. Be iyie neno masiche
E yo madhi e polo
Pinyni jasik Ng'wono Ruoth
Maketa nyathi Nyasaye.

4. Nyaka akedi luenj jaloch,
Ruoth medna ng'wononi,
Dhier medore, ahiti ger
Elna konyruok e Wachni.

title: An Adwaro Yesu Moloyo
Daheri Moloyo
Winji Luong' mar Ruoth
lyrics:
1. Winji luong' mar Ruoth Yesu,
E piny ka ma kuwe onge,
Wachne obironwa kama,
"In ja-Kristo, bi, luwa."

2. Oluongowa mondo wawe
Dwaro mar gik makadho,
Kodi duto ma ditamwa,
To wahere moloyo.

3. Ndalo mwamor kata mwayuak,
Ka tichwa nobed mathoth,
Pod oluongi ndalo duto:
Mond' wahere moloyo.

4. Yesu oluongowa duto,
Wanawinji duonde,
Watine gi chunywa duto,
Wanahere moloyo.

title: Ang'eyo ni Jawarna Ngima
lyrics:
1. Ang'eyo ni Jawarna ngima,
Kendo chieng' En nowir e piny
En' ochiw ngimane mochwere
Ng'wono kod teko nie lwete.

Chorus:
Ang'eyo chuth ni Yesu ngima,
Kendo chieng' En nowir e piny
Ang'eyo ni ochiwo ngima,
Ng'wono kod teko nie lwete.

2. Gik mosingo duto nochopi,
Singruokne duto ok norem;
Kata gero mar tho nonega,
To chieng' moro nane Jawar.

3. Ang'eyo nolosona kar bet
Kam'odakie nadag kanyo;
En wach maduong' ni Ruoth ohera,
Nodwog e piny mond' ooma.

title: Nool Gweth Maduong'
lyrics:
1. Nool gweth maduong' kuomwa:
En singruok mar herane,
Wanayudi mew mar Nyasaye,
Mamiyowa mor chutho.

Chorus:
Gweth to nomiwa,
Gweth mar chuny e mwachando;
Oronwa gweth momedore
E mwakwayo kawuono.

2. Nool gweth maduong' kuomwa,
Mar jiwo chunywa kendo;
Jo mool kendo matuwo
Giniwinj ni gweth nitie.

3. Nool gweth maduong' kuomwa
Yaye, olnwa koro, Ruoth!
Pong' chunywa gi Roho Maler,
Wachni e moyudi duong'.

4. Nool gweth maduong' kuomwa:
To mond' obinwa koro,
Kwahulo richowa duto,
Ka waluongo Nying Yesu.

5. Nool gweth maduong' kuomwa:
Kwayie kendo winjo
Gima Ruoth osechikowa
Kwatimo dwaro Mare.

title: Nawuoth Kodi Pile
lyrics:
1. Ruodha aheri maradier,
In osiepna madiera,
E wuodha mar piny ma mwalo,
Ok nawe wuotho kodi.
Nawuoth kodi pile. Nawuoth kodi pile.
E wuodha mar piny ma mwalo,
Ok nawe wuotho kodi.

2. Ok nagen mwandu mar pinyni,
Mondo ji omiya luor,
Kata tem birona maduong',
In iwuo niyudo tem.
Nawuoth kodi pile. Nawuoth kodi pile.
Kata tem birona maduong',
In iwuo niyudo tem.

3. Telna e wuodha mar pinyni,
Dhi nyime koda e wuoth,
E dho rangach madhi Polo,
Nadonjie ka an kodi.
Nawuoth kodi pile. Nawuoth kodi pile.
E dho rangach madhi Polo,
Nadonjie ka an kodi.

title: Bedi Matek
lyrics:
1. Bedi matek kuom Ruodhwa Yesu,
Ruakri gi gi lweny mar Nyasaye,
Kituweyo oguchi gadiera,
Law akor en wach makare;
Lam ndalo duto kendo chungi
Kuom tamo Satani pile;
To nilo kuom Yesu Jawarwa,
Nobed kodi kuonde duto.

2. Ked lweny maber kaka jakedo,
Ting' gi lweny duto mar Nyasaye,
Tiendi oik gi wach mireme,
Kaw okumba yie matek chutho,
Ogut konyruok bende momiyi,
Kendo ligangla mar Roho.
To nilo kuom Yesu Jawarwa,
Nobed kodi kuonde duto.

title: Wan Jokedo Pile
lyrics:
1. Wan jokedo pile mag Ruodhwa Yesu,
Tich matek bende ni kuonde duto,
Ok naluor ka an gi Ruoth, anyalo kedo maber,
Ek' anyalo tiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu.

Chorus:
Kasekedo lueny maber, Kasedoko jaloyo,
Kondo mara bende nayudi e Polo ku,
Teko Ruodhwa nitie nyalo loyowa sigu,
Ek' anyalo tiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu.

2. Hera bende ni e ranyisi marwa
Mawuotho e wang' yore malong'o,
Adiera e maloyo teko ruoth ma nie mudho,
Ek' anyalo tiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu.

3. Ok naol, ok anawe kedo maber,
Teko Ruoth bend' e manyalo sira,
Analando wechene kaka nothonwa e Yath,
Ok anawe tiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu.

4. Yuoruru mondo ukedi kuom Yesu,
Kawuru giu duto te mag lweny,
En e teko mar Roho, gi lamo ndalo duto,
Ek' wanyalo tiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu.

title: Wuod Nyasaye Odhi Ka Lueny
lyrics:
1. To Wuod Nyasaye odhi ka lueny,
Kuom yudo duong' mar Ruoth:
Bendeche neno ku mabor,
To ng'a maluwo En?
Mamadh' o kikombene,
Koloyo rem malit;
Mating' o Msalapeno,
Adier oluwo En.

2. Jachir machayo kata tho,
Ma chunye ler adier:
Maneno Ruodhe malo cha,
Mokwaye mond' okony.
Koneno rem mar tho malit,
Nosayo kaka en,
Oweyonigi richogi.
Ng'a ma dilue ti?

3. Roho obet kuom jo moyie,
Oganda Yesu Ruoth;
Joote ma jochir adier
Mochayo tong' gi mach.
Ne ok giluoro tho malit,
Rem ok nobuogogi;
Thogi omiwa bet gi chir.
Ng'a ma dilue ti?

4. Ee, jo machuo gi ji mamor,
Oganda Yesu Ruoth;
Gimor nyim kom Jakonywa,
Koruakogi mang'won.
To ne gidonjo Polo kuom
Masira kodi lweny:
Wuon Polo miwa tekoni
Waluwogi kwamor.

title: Achiwo ni Yesu Duto
lyrics:
1. Achiwo ni Yesu duto!
Kata teko ma an go;
Wechena gi timbe duto
Mondo opake pile.

Chorus:
Duto nobed kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Ngimana nobed mare.
Duto nobed kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Ngimana nobed mare.

2. Lueta mond' otim dwarone,
Tienda odhi e yore,
Wang'a none Yesu kende
Dhoga mondo opake.

3. Nateg wang'a kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Kik gimoro oyuwaya
Chunya to nopare pile
Kaka nothona e Yath.

4. Ng'wono maduong' mawuoro
Ka Yesu, ma Ruodh Polo
Oluonga jahera mare,
Omiya yuweyo kuome.

title: Bet ka Yesu
lyrics:
1. Mor mar piny ok nyal yuwaya,
An dabed ka Yesu,
Ber mar pinyini ok notera,
An dabed ka Yesu.

Chorus:
Bet ka Yesu, en wenda,
E kuonde duto pile;
Bedo kaka Ruoth Yesu!
An dabed ka Yesu.

2. Tamruok duto osegolo,
An dabed ka Yesu;
Mond' atine ndalo duto,
An dabed ka Yesu.

3. E yore duto mawuothe,
An dabed ka Yesu;
Kalando wechene pile,
An dabed ka Yesu.

4. Nyaka chieng' matundo ni
An dabed ka Yesu;
Mond' owachna, "In ja-Kristo"
An dabed ka Yesu.

title: Ruoth, Ting'a Malo
lyrics:
1. Areto kawuotho e yo
Madhi malo ndalo duto;
Kalamo pile mondo Ruoth
Oting'a malo moloyo.

Chorus:
Ruoth ting'a malo mond' achung'
Kayie wecheni duto,
Med ting'a malo moloyo,
Abed kapakoi pile.

2. Chunya ok gomb siko e piny
Kama chich gi luoro nitie;
To adwaro loyogi te,
E malami ting'a malo.

3. Adwaro loyo gik me piny
Ma Satani diwuondago;
Nyaka ane mor e Polo;
Genona ni kuomi pile.

4. Adwaro bedo motegno
Nyaka ane mor e Polo;
E momiyo pod alamo,
"Ruoth ting'a malo moloyo."

title: Nyisa Weche Mag Ruoth
lyrics:
1. Nyisa weche mag Ruoth Yesu,
Pidhgi duto e chunya,
Weche mabeyo maloyo
Duto ma wasewinjo.
Nyisa kaka jomalaika
Nowero chieng' mar nyuolne,
Duong' ni Nyasaye man malo,
Mirembe kuom ji duto.

2. Nyis kuom ndalo ma nodhi
E thim ka noriyo kech,
Noteme nikech richowa
To noloyo makare.
Nyis kaka notiyo ni ji
Kod rem ma noting'onwa,
Ne gichaye kendo sande
Kodoko Jawar kuomwa.

3. Nyisa kaka ne gigure
E Yath koting'o richo,
Nyisa liende ma nowuokie
Kochier mong'ima tinde.
Wechego puonja herane
Kochandore nikech wan;
Chunya okuyo kang'eyo
Nothona mondo owara.

title: Kristo ni Kuoma
lyrics:
1. Ndalo moro nalal e richo,
Ler onge e chunya;
E Wach Nyasaye nanwang'o ler,
To Kristo ni kuoma.

Chorus:
Kristo ni kuoma,
Kristo ni kuoma,
Ma e warruok maduong',
Ka Kristo ni kuoma.

2. E kaka ler moa e wang' chieng',
Olodho cham me piny,
Ngima gi hera gi ler oa
Kristo ma ni kuoma.

3. Kaka cham ni e i kodhi,
Yath onyak olembe,
Kama apako Nyasaye madier,
Rohone ni kuoma.

4. Dwaro mar chunya ni koro
Mondo abet ka En,
Kaparo e chunya hononi
Ka Kristo ni kuoma.

title: Ber Uparo Kuom Yesu
lyrics:
1. Kauluor Satani do loyou,
Kobiro pile kendo otemou,
Ber uparo kuom Yesu, ma Jawarwa,
En odwaro konyowa.

Chorus:
Ber uparo kuom Yesu,
Ber uparo kuom Yesu,
En Jawarowa, En oherowa,
Ber uparo kuom Yesu.

2. Ka chunyu ok ohero tich Nyasaye,
Kata ok ohero lame pile,
Ber uparo kuom Yesu, ma Jawarwa,
En odwaro konyowa.

3. Kudwaro yudo Much Nyasaye e chunyu,
Kudwaro mor gi Yesu nyaka chieng',
Ber uparo kuom Yesu, ma Jawarwa,
En odwaro konyowa.

title: Kaw Nying Yesu Kodi
lyrics:
1. Kaw nying Yesu kodi pile,
In mawuotho e piny ka;
Nomiyi mor kodi teko,
Par Nyinge ku midhiye.

Chorus:
Nyinge ber, Nyinge mit!
Nyingeno e genowa;
Nyinge ber, Nyinge mit!
En Yesu mowarowa.

2. Kaw nying Yesu kodi pile,
En nobed kuot mariti:
Ka tem kod richo obiro,
Lam e Nyingeno maler.

3. Ee, nyingno maber mar Yesu,
Okelo mor e chunywa;
Ka En oruakwa e Polo,
Wanawer kuom nying Yesu.

4. Koro wadendo nying Yesu,
Kwa lame, owinjowa.
Ruoth moloyo ruodhi duto,
En Yesu, ma Jawarwa.

title: Kwawuotho gi Ruodhwa
lyrics:
1. Kwawuotho gi Ruodhwa
E ler mar Wechene,
Mor maduong' momiyowa ka!
Kwatimoni Nyasaye
Gik modwaro duto,
Enogwedhwa gi hawi mare.

Chorus:
Yie gi tim;
Olong'o ni Nyasaye
Okelo mor e chunywa,
Kwageno kuom Yesu.

2. Ok wanyalo bedo
E mudho mar jo-piny
Nikech hera mar Yesu kuomwa.
Ok wayie koro
Kuom lisweche moko.
Wayie remb Yesu kende.

3. Onge tuo moro,
Kata tho manyalo
Geng'owa kuom hera mar Yesu.
Nikech Yesu nochier,
Wan bende moyie,
Wabiro bedo kode kuno.

4. Wan gi lalruok maber
Kod Yesu Jawarwa,
Gi lamo kuom Roho mar Nyasaye.
Kwachiwore kuome,
Kendo dok jo-tichne
Nopong' chunywa gi mor maduong'.

title: Ka Tho Gi Yesu
lyrics:
1. Ka tho gi Yesu, kuom tho En mara;
Ka ngima kode, en ngima manyien,
Ka ng'iyo Yesu duong'ne neno,
Pile ka pile, Ruodha, an mari.

Chorus:
Pile ka pile orita maber,
Pile to ngimana ni mar Yesu;
Ka ng'iyo Yesu duong'ne neno;
Pile ka pile, Ruodha, an mari.

2. Onge dhier moro ka Yesu nitie,
Onge ting' mapek mak nowe ting'o,
Ok aneno kuyo ka En koda,
Pile ka pile Yesu orita.

3. Ka chunya lit, to kata chunya pek,
Ka pi wang' owuok, ka chur e iya,
Ka temruok biro, anyalo loyo,
Pile ka pile Yesu opara.

4. Ka nyawo nitie, En e mong'eyo,
Tuwowa duto onyalo chango;
Pile ka pile e weche duto,
Yesu, Jawarna, e ma ni koda.

title: Opando Chunya
lyrics:
1. Ruoth Yesu Kristo e Jawar maduong',
Jawar maber chutho kuoma,
Nochiwo ngimane mondo owara,
Herane e moritago.

Chorus:
Opando chunya e lwanda morita,
Momiya abedo maber;
Opando chunya e tut mar herane
Ouma gi luete mang'won,
Ouma gi luete mang'won.

2. Ruoth Yesu Kristo e Jawar maduong',
Ogolna gi mapek kuoma,
Orita mondo kik achwanyra ngang',
Omiya tekone pile.

3. Omiya gweth mathoth pile ka pile
Mopong'a gi morne chutho,
Mapake gi wer gi ilo mag chuny,
Amor gi Jakonyna chutho.

4. Chieng' moro notera kadhi e Polo
Nabedi kode nyaka chieng'
Kod joge ma noa e pinje duto
Napake malong'o chutho.

title: Winjuru Duond Yesu
lyrics:
1. Winjuru duond Yesu Kristo,
Ruodha maber ni e Yesu,
Winjuru Jakonywa Yesu,
En oluongwa, luongwa, waluwe.

Chorus:
Analruo bang'i, Yesu,
Analruo bang'i, Yesu,
Analruo bang'i, Yesu,
En noriti, riti chunya.

2. Biuru unune yora,
Yoranogo e malong'o,
Luewuru yoranogo,
Ma utundi ira un duto.

3. Yoranogo e yo madiny,
Mochiko tir chutho pile,
Yoranogo odhi malo,
Ndalo duto nyaka e pinyni.

4. Yora en e yo mar ngima,
Yora en yo mar mor chutho.
Mor ma ok norum kendo ngang'
To nosiki kodwa e Polo.

title: Asebayo E Yo Mabor
lyrics:
1. Asebayo e yo mabor
Kuom Ruodhwa Nyasaye.
Chunya nopong' gi tim richo,
Weya koro, Ruoth.

Chorus:
Abiro koro, Ruoth,
Kik aba kendo,
Kuom ng'wononi abiro ni
Yesu, Jawarna.

2. Naketho e nyimi mathoth,
Luoka koro, Ruoth,
Kalokora gi chuny malit;
Luoka koro, Ruoth.

3. Koro aol gi richona,
Luoka gi rembi,
Ka geno herani kuoma,
Abiro iri.

4. Chunya lit nikech kethona,
Abiro iri.
Medna teko kod genoi,
Puodha koro, Ruoth.

title: Wakedo gi Satani
lyrics:
1. Wakedo gi Satani kodi joge maricho,
Yesu Kristo en e Ruodhwa, motelonwa yo maber,
Wadwaro luwo bang'e ndalowa duto e piny ka,
Yesu Jawarowa.

Chorus:
Wan wawero Haleluya,
Duong' Nyasachwa e mosiko,
Wan wawero Haleluya,
Yesu otelonwa.

2. Ok wanyalo lokoji kodi bunde kata luth,
To wanyalo loko ji mana gi Wach gi Much Nyasaye.
Ji ginyalo yudo ngima mana ka gilokore,
Yesu, Jawarowa.

3. Kwakedo kak'onyisowa, wanyalo loyo en;
Kwalamo pile pile kodi somo Wach mar Ngima,
Wanadok matek kuom kedo pile ka konyisowa,
Yesu otelonwa.

4. Adwaro pako Yesu nikech nosewaro ji,
Adwaro pako Ruoth Yesu nikech nosegonyo ji,
Adwaro pako Yesu nikech nosemiyo ji mor,
Yesu Jawarowa.

title: Keduru Jo Ka Yesu
Ende Wadhiuruwa
An Amor E Tich Ruoth
lyrics:
1. An amor ahinya e tich Ruoth Yesu,
Opong'o chunya gi ilo;
Omiya mor ma tich moro ok dikel,
Kaka mar Ruodha Yesu.

Chorus:
E tich mar Ruodha Yesu,
Achiworane chutho;
Omiya kuwe gi mor gi gweth
E tich mar Ruodha Yesu.

2. An amor ahinya e tich Ruoth Yesu,
Opong'o chunya gi ilo;
Kata tek manadi pod awer pile
E tich mar Ruodha Yesu.

3. An amor ahinya e tich Ruoth Yesu,
Opong'o chunya gi ilo;
Adwaro luwe kuonde motelona
E tich mar Ruodha Yesu.

4. An amor ahinya e tich Ruoth Yesu,
Opong'o chunya gi ilo;
Giga duto ma ango achiwone
Kuom tich mar Ruodha Yesu.

title: Luwe, Luwe
lyrics:
1. Dak iwinji ka Yesu oluongi,
Luwe nyaka ka moteloni,
Luw ndache kichiko yo modhie Polo
Luwe nyaka ka moteloni,
Yesu nowuotho nyimwa,
Nong'eyo wang' yo chutho
Ka nochandore bende
Ka noting'o richowa.

Chorus:
Luwe, luwe nyaka ka moterie,
Luwe, luwe nyaka ka moterie,
Winji kaka owachoni,
Luwa, luwa, An kenda.

2. In to, ti ich mar Yesu Jawar,
Luwe nyaka ka moteloni,
Ihiyudi loyo kuom Yesu pile,
Luwe nyaka ka moteloni.
Bi mondo ikeyone,
E puodho mosekochek,
Mi inyudi hawi
Kitiyo ni Ruoth Yesu.

3. Kata temruok dwaro loyie piny,
Luwe nyaka ka moteloni,
Teko mare omedonwa timo chir,
Luwe nyaka moteloni.
Kata yo nobed matek,
Yie kendo gene pile;
Wanawe ting' wa mapek
Mi wanayudi pokwa.

title: Yesu Chikowa
lyrics:
1. Yesu chikowa mond' wanyiso ji,
Kaka mach oliel ka Polo imore,
Ende wadhiuru tero wachne,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

2. Yesu chikowa chako nyiso ji,
Hera mare e momiyo wadhi,
Ende wadhiuru tero wachne,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

3. Yesu chikowa ek' wati maber,
Nyiso jo ma kia kaka En notho,
Ende wadhiuru tero wachne,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

4. Yesu chikowa mond wanyiso ji,
En to bedo kodwa ek' wanyalo dhi,
Ende wadhiuru tero wachne,
Puonjo pilepile gi Wach Nyasaye.

title: Awinji Kiluonga
lyrics:
1. Awinji kiluonga, ni mond' abi iri,
Iluoka gi rembi maber mochwer e Kalwari.

Chorus:
Abiro ni Ruoth, abiro iri;
Kageno rembi kende mochwer e Kalwari.

2. Kata richona thoth, ageno ng'wononi;
Kiluoko chunya dok maler, namor kuom tekoni.

3. Apako warruokni! mobedo kuom ng'wono!
Kuom chiwonwa Yesu Kristo, Jawar, ma nothonwa.

title: Wadok Joloyo Mar Yuakne
lyrics:
1. Wadok joloyo mar yuakne,
Ndalo mar kedo gi wasikwa,
Chieng' mar Ruodhwa Yesu,
Kik kibaji makwa, kik waringi.

Chorus:
Joloyo, joloyo,
Kik uwe mak uketo chunyu;
Kuom tekone mondo ujiwo,
Ni Yesu En teko mar Polo,
Kuom kondo ma wayudi kuome.

2. Ubedi joloyo mar tong'e
En gi teko e Polo,
Wanawe Satani gi chiembe,
Kuom tekone e mwajiwore.

3. Wadok joloyo mar tong'e
Ok anawe keto chunya,
Kuom tekone e mwajiwore,
Wagene ka En kodwa.

4. Kudok joloyo nucham gikeni,
Pok maber nomiwua piyo,
Wanariwore gi Ruoth me Polo
Jo ma nowar nopogini.

title: Jawar Telna
lyrics:
1. Jawar telna kik alal,
Ewuodha ndalo duto:
Ka an buti ok naluor,
Herani en kwe mara.

Chorus:
Jawar telna,
Maka gi lweti matek chutho,
Mi nabed matek adier.
Jawar telna kik alal.

2. Chunya opondo kuomi
Ka yembe mag piny kudho,
Ka In koda ok naluor,
In e genona Ruodha.

3. Telna nyaka chieng' giko,
Nyaka piny Ruoth mosiko,
Nyaka chandruok piny nomu,
Pi wang' ok nochwer kuno.

title: Jowetewa Chikuru Itu
lyrics:
1. Jowetewa, chikuru itu, kuom Jawarwa,
En nobi kaka owacho, mondo ogolwa.

Chorus:
Yesu Kristo En noduogi, En e genowa,
Konyowa gi teko gi kinda mond' wariti.

2. Satani jawasikwa mohero wuondowa,
To Jawarwa miyowa rieko e Kitape.

3. Waseneno yore pinyni, wito ji mathoth;
Yesu Kristo nowir piyo loso piny manyien.

4. Jo me piny ma ok oyie, noyudi bura.
Jo machayo Evangeli; mach nowang' malit.

title: Mak Wach Kitabu
lyrics:
1. Mak wach Kitabu, weche manono:
En e janyis mos e adiera;
Ng'a moseyudo onyise ji moko
Mwandu maduong' man kuom weche Nyasaye.

Chorus:
Mak wach Kitabu
Mak wach Kitabu
Mak wach Kitabu
Manyisowa yo.

2. Mak wach Kitabu, kendo mond' ilandi
Ji mool manindo chiewgiuru,
Landogi pile weche mag Ruoth Yesu,
Isekadho tho, idonj' e ngima.

3. Mak wach Kitabu, mwanduno mosiko,
Ng'a moseyie en gi ngima chutho,
Jo moketho ok noyud ngimanogo,
Ng'a mopodho mondo oa malo.

4. Mak wach Kitabu, odok tach tiendeni.
Ji mosebaro e yo oduogi.
Rachikgi mar yie madhiyo e Polo,
Golgigru uchikgi e Polo.

title: Herreuru Mana Kaka Aherou
lyrics:
1. Chik mamiyou ema,
Herreuru mana kaka aherou,
Onge hera maduong',
Mang'ato nyalo herogo osiepene.

Chorus:
Moloyo chiwonegi ngimane,
Ka utimo gik machikou.
To eka un ubed osiepena,
Herreuru e kind uwegi.

2. Kaka Wuora osehera,
E kaka an bende aseherou,
Sikuru e herana,
Kaka an bende aserito chik Wuora.

3. Piny ochiek jokeyo nok,
Aorou karombe e dier ondiegi,
Beduru mariek ka thwol,
Kendo beduru mamuol kaka akuru.

4. Dhiuru epiny duto mondo uland,
Wach maber ne ji duto tee,
Ng'at moyie kendo obatise nokwo,
Ng'at modagi bura nolo.

title: Okonyowa
lyrics:
1. Nawuotho gi Satani Ndalo machon,
An e yo machielo Madhi e Polo.
Nwapako Yesu, Nokonyowa maber,
Anamor ndalo duto Nokonyowa.

Chorus:
Okonyowa, Okonyowa,
Anamor gi lala, Ang'eyo Yesu, haleluya,
Okonyowa, Okonyowa,
Wanawuotho mathoth ahinya,
Nokonyowa.

2. Ni Yesu noluonga, Adhi ire, adhi ire,
Nowuotho e yore, E yo malong'o,
Namor gi yie, Wanapako Nyinge,
Wachne duong' ahinya, Nokonyowa.

3. Gi yie mare, Nitie duto te,
Nowaro chunya, Watundo e Polo,
Kasetundo kuno, Dalane agombo ngang'
Di ne oweya ok nakwo. Nokonyowa.

title: Ka Ma Notelna
lyrics:
1. Ka ma notelna anadhi,
Osepuonja gene chutho.
Kaparo kaka nothona
Ka nogure e Kalwari.

Chorus:
Yesu notelna godiechieng'
Notelna gotieno bende;
En e Jakonyna madieri,
Notho kuoma e Kalwari.

2. Ahero rito chik mage,
Amor kotelona pile,
Timo dwarone oberna
Ka 'paro rembe mosechwer.

3. Adhi nyime ma ok aluor,
Ka mor pile gi Jakonyna;
Chieng' moro anane Yesu,
Napake pile e Polo.

title: Ruoth Ni Koda E Yo Duto
Kuom Kristo Asenwang'o Ber
lyrics:
1. Kuom Kristo asenwang'o ber,
Moroma e chunya.
Kuwe gi mor ma nadwaro chon
E mosebirona.

Chorus:
Kristo kende e moroma,
Nyinge e maberna,
Hera, ngima, gi mor chutho
Ni kuom Ruodha Yesu.

2. Nadwaro mor kod yuweyo,
Nagombogi, ok Ruoth;
Ka pok nang'eyo Jawarna,
Herane nomaka.

3. Nadwaro gik mar pinyni ka,
Chunya ok nopari
Nyaka ng'wononi notucha
Mar neno ber mari.

4. Modho ma Yesu nomiya
Nogolona riyo:
Nomiya ngima nyaka chieng',
Kuom yie gi chunya chuth.

title: Tiuru, Yesu Biro
lyrics:
1. Tiuru, Yesu biro; Tiuru gi kinda.
Otieno biro piyo Ka ok watiyo.
Jiwuru chunyu ndalogi; Puonj ji yor warruokne.
Tiuru, Yesu biro Mi tichwa norum.

2. Tiuru, Yesu biro; Tiuru gi hera.
Nomiwa teko pile Kwakwayo kuome.
Morne maber moloyo Nobed ni jotichne.
Tiuru, Yesu biro Nuyuwe maber.

3. Tiuru, Yesu biro; Tiuru gi geno.
Chwo Wachne kuonde duto; Wanaka kuome.
Kik lwetwa bed manono Chieng' ma Yesu nobi;
Tiuru, Yesu biro; Nuyud duong' kuome.

title: Kik Watim Richo
lyrics:
1. Ok nane wich kuot ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang'.
E piny ka nengo noremiye,
Kik watim richo ngang'.
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang'
Yesu nyalo luok chunywa,
Kik watim richo ngang'.

2. Wanasin gi richowa,
Kik watim richo ngang'
Bura duong' moloy' ahinya,
Kik watim richo ngang'.
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kristo golo bura kuomwa,
Kik watim richo ngang'.

3. Kik wabedi e fuwo,
Kik watim richo ngang'
Wa ae kido machon,
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang',
Wa ae kido machon.
Kik watim richo ngang'.

4. Richo oketho chunywa,
Kik watim richo ngang'
Yesu kwerowa e richo,
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang',
Kik watim richo ngang',
Richo gi malit chutho,
Kik watim richo ngang'.

title: Yesu Ochiero Lazaro
lyrics:
1. Ruoth Jal mayande ihero chande, tinde tuo!
Bi mond' ichange, mondo imiye ngimane!

Chorus:
Yesu miwa ngima,
Yesu miwa ngima mar adier.

2. Tuone ok mar tho, mano obedo mar piny ka
Tuono en kamano, mondo wuoro oyud duong'.

3. Wadhi yo Judea, kam' osiepwa oninde
Adhi mond' achiewe, mond' adwogne ngimane.

4. Ruoth kadibed ka, owadwani ok dak otho!
Koro aseyie ni in e Wuod Nyasaye adier.

5. Owadu tinende, enochier kawuononi
Duong' odog ni wuoro nyisauru kanyono.

6. Onge gima nyalo, tamo Yesu Wuod Nyasaye
Nyinge oyud duong', osechiero jalo motho.

title: Enopanda
lyrics:
1. Ka chandruok mar piny ochopo,
Lweny mager e piny ginam:
Anadwar kar pondo mara,
E tipo mar luet Nyasaye.

Chorus:
Enopanda, Enopanda,
Kama chandruok ok noloya.
Enopanda, Enopanda
E tipo mar luet Nyasaye.

2. Kata oyie ane chandruok,
Pod named geno Polo,
Ruoth okumo jomohero,
Konyisogi yo maber.

3. Ka wasika dwaro hinya,
Ka Satan dwaro loya,
Ruoth nolok gima dihinya.
Obedna mor mochwere.

4. Ka ating'o msalapa, ka aneno
Chandruok e piny.
Yesu ema orito chunya.
Ok noweya mond' alal.

title: Luoro Maga Ami Yesu
lyrics:
1. Luoro maga 'miyo Yesu
Mond' orita kagene
An ok anyal luor gimoro
Kagene ndalo duto

Chorus:
Anagene, anagene
Anagene, en kende
Anagene, anagene
Anagene, en kende.

2. Richona duto amiye
Mond oluoka gi rembe
Mond' abed maler e nyime
Ma bura ok oloya

3. Kihondkona 'miyo Yesu
Mi chunya nuang'o yweyo
Wang'a koro neno maler
Yora bende ni kod ler.

4. Morna bende 'miyo Yesu
Ka agene en kende
Mondo mor mar piny makadh
Kik chak tera e mudho.

5. Chunya duto ami Yesu
Giga duto amiye
En Ruodha to an nyathine
Wawuotho mak wapogre.

title: Ka Wageno Remb Ruodhwa
lyrics:
1. Ka wageno remb Ruodhwa,
Wan gi ngima moromowa,
Richo mawa noluoko,
Kodi rembe ma nochwernwa.

Chorus:
To kuom Yesu wachungoe,
Enie lwandana mangima,
Enie lwandana mangima.

2. Kata yora 'timo mudho,
Konyruokne miyowa teko;
Kata achandora malich,
Kagene pile nokuwea.

3. Rembe gi singruok gi muma,
Kageno pile, gisira,
Kata gi piny duto norum,
Yesu Ruodhwa e moroma.

title: En Dokonywa
Wagenuru Singruok Duto
lyrics:
1. Wagenuru singruok duto mag Ruodhwa,
Wechene en adier mondo wapake,
Ndalo duto wanamuonye 'duong' ka,
Wanamor kuom weche mag Nyasaye.

Chorus:
Genuru Wach.
Genuru Wach mar Ruodhwa Nyasaye Jawarna;
Genuru Wach.
Nikech singruokne en adier chutho.

2. Genuru nikech Wachne e mosiko,
Ka chich gi luoro manadi ni kuomi,
Wach mangima mar nyasachwa oloyo,
Wanamor kuom singruok mar Ruodhwa.

3. Wagenuru singruok duto mag Ruodhwa,
Nikech herane wadoko nyithinde,
Kwawuotho kuom ler mar Roho ok waluor,
Wanamor kuom Weche mag Nyasaye.

4. Wagenuru singruok duto mag Ruodhwa,
Gi teko mar Roho ok wawe geno,
Yesu ma Jawar omiyo waloyo,
Wanamor kuom Weche mag Nyasaye.

title: Ruoth Ipanda Kar Kenoni
lyrics:
1. Ruoth ipanda kar kenoni mokwe
Kendo ihoya e chandruokna duto
Aseyudo yuweyo kuomi Ruodha
Irita e yore na duto.

Chorus:
Ruoth ipanda kar kenoni,
Ka ayudo tembe kod sandruokna duto.
Ruoth ipanda kar kenoni,
Ruoth ipanda kar kenoni mokwe.

2. Ruoth ipanda kar kenoni mokwe
Kendo irita gi duong'ni maler.
Duong' mari maler emo uma
Aneno mor e kinde duto.

3. Ruoth ipanda kar kenoni mokwe
Kar pondo mari nayudie gweth
En nouma gi Jawarna Ruodha
Onge ng'ano manyalo loya.

title: Ang'eyo Jal Matelona
lyrics:
1. Ka temruok piny sando chunya
Yamb ahiti gengona yo
Ka an kuom Ruoth ok nayiengni
Ang'eyo Jal matelona.

Chorus:
Ang'eyo Jal matelona
Eweche te ma ngima piny;
Yembe kudho apaka ger,
Ang'eyo Jal matelona.

2. Kinde duto Jaketh hima
Oketo kuth' e yorena
Ok nalwor ngang' kata dok chien
Ang'eyo Jal matelona.

3. Kata ndalo medna chandruok
Kendo wuoth med bedo mapek,
Ang'eyo nagow loka cha,
Ang'eyo Jal matelona.

4. Hera Jawar menyona yo
Ochikoa kotelona,
Anagene e wuodha te
Ang'eyo Jal matelona.

title: Ruoth E Lwandawa
lyrics:
1. Ruoth e lwandawa mar pondo,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok,
Ogeng'o gima dihinywa,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok.

Chorus:
O, Yesu e lwandana e piny chandruok,
E piny chandruok, E piny chandruok,
O, Yesu e lwandana e piny chandruok,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok,

2. Tipo 'diechieng', rageng' 'tieno,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok,
Onge luoro kat' mana buok,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok.

3. Chandruok maduong' nyalo luora,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok,
Ok wanawe konyruokwa lal,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok.

4. Ruoth ma nyalo en Ruodh konyruok,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok,
Bed Jakonywa machiegini,
Kar yweyo e saa mar chandruok.

title: Yesu Nowara
lyrics:
1. Yesu nowara, kor' eka mor,
To osedonjo, omenyo chunya,
Kor' ekwadwaro wacho ni ji,
'Ok anamung' ngang', ok analing'.

Chorus:
Mano ni morna, mano wenda,
Kapako Nyinge ndalo duto,
Mano ni morna, mano wenda,
Kapako Nyinge ndalo duto.

2. Yesu nopuonja hero Nyasaye,
Kor' ekwadwaro puonjo ji duto,
Kata gikwero kata giyie,
'Ok anamung' ngang', ok analing'.

3. Koro kageno Jawarowa,
Yesu ni berna, bende ni lerna,
Ka tichne norum, ka piny ogik,
,Eka nobi ni mond' ooma.

title: Nyak' Abed Gi Ruodha
lyrics:
1. Nyak' abed gi Ruodha Yesu,
Nikech ok dawuothi kenda
Nyak' awinj tekone kuoma
Kendo bade kolwora.

Chorus:
Eka chunya ok noluor
Notelna kuonde duto
Anadhi maonge tamruok
Kaluwo wang' yorene.

2. Nyak' abed gi Ruodha Yesu
Nikech an gi yie manyap
Nojiwa gi weche mamuol
Onge nga ma diwachna

3. Nyak' abed gi Ruodha Yesu
E wuodh ngimana me piny,
Ka paka mag pinyini goya
E lwenje mopogore

4. Nyak' abed gi Ruodha Yesu
Mondo wang'e menyna yoo,
Nyak' achop e hoho mar tho
Nyaka tho om' chunya chuth.

title: Onge Moro Maduong' Ka Yesu
Padori Kuom Ruoth Yesu
lyrics:
1. Padori mana kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Enokonynoki, nokonyoi,
Kiyie herane abidha,
Nomii mor kod kuwe.

Chorus:
Padri kuome, geno herane,
Padri kuome, yie ng'wonone,
Padri kuome, geno Polo Malo,
Padri kuom Ruoth Yesu;

2. Padori mana kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Enemiyi mor, nomiyi mor,
Yie luwe kama enoteloni,
Yie mond lwinj duonde.

3. Padori mana kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Nyise wecheni machandi,
Hulne gigo duto' modhieri,
Ite owinjo!.

4. Padori mana kuom Ruoth Yesu,
lyue kuome, yue kuome,
En gi ng'wono, kendo gi hera,
Oparowa pile.

title: An Jacham Mwandune
lyrics:
1. Wuora ni gi udi gi pinje mathoth,
Mwandu mag pinyini duto ni e luete!
Fedha gi dhahabu gi dhok mabeyo,
Duto mag Wuora, En gi mwandu mathoth.

Chorus:
An jacham mwandune,
Jacham mwandune!
Kod Yesu Jawarna,
An jacham mwandune.

2. Wuode mohero, nodoko Jawar,
Nowuotho e piny ka jachan nikech wan;
To koro oloyo e Polo gi duong',
Chieng' moro nadhi kar dakna e Polo.

3. Richona mathoth nopoga chutho
Bedo jacham mwandu; To koro amor'
Konyuola manyien gi Roho mar Nyasaye,
Nyinga nondiki, an nyathi Ruodh Polo!

4. Gik ma ango ka, to kata ginok,
Olosona kar bet malich e Polo!
An wendo e pinyiri, to pod awero:
"Duong' ni Nyasaye, an nyathi Ruodh Polo!"

title: Ber Kwageno Yesu Kristo
lyrics:
1. Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo,
Kendo yie kuome pile,
Ka wayweyo kuome pile,
Wawinji moseluwe.

Chorus:
Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasachwa,
Ikonywa ndalo duto,
Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasachwa,
Ikonywa ndalo duto.

2. Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo,
Ka nonenwa richowa,
Mond' oluoko chunya duto,
Gi rembe ma nochwerwa.

3. Ber kwageno Yesu Kristo,
En odagi richowa,
Mond' ogonywa e richowa,
Gi rembe ma nochwerwa.

4. An adwaro paki pile,
Yesu osiepa kende,
Mond' odag e chunya pile,
Noritwa ndalo duto.

title: Otelona
lyrics:
1. Otelona, koro amor,
Nikech Yesu otelona;
Ka madhiye, ka mabetie,
Koro Yesu otelona.

Chorus:
Otelona, otelona,
Yesu Ruodha otelona,
Adwaro luwe gi kinda,
Nikech Yesu otelona.

2. Ndalo moro piny orachna,
Ndalo moro piny oberna,
To kata ber, to kata rach,
Koro Yesu otelona.

3. An adwaro mako chinge,
Eka chunya nomor chutho,
Kayieng' gi gik ma nomiya,
Nikech Yesu otelona.

4. To ka tichna mar piny norum,
Kuom ng'wonone nadhiye Polo,
Ok analuor kata atho
Nikech Yesu otelona.

title: Nyasaye Doritou
lyrics:
1. Kik uluor kata uchandoru,
Nyasaye doritou;
Beduru but Yesu pile,
Nyasaye doritou.

Chorus:
Nyasaye doritou ndalo duto,
Ka mudhiye, Nyasaye doritou,
Nyasaye doritou.

2. Ka jo makwer gichandou,
Nyasaye doritou
Kupuonjo ji gi Wechene,
Nyasaye doritou.

3. Gik muchando tin domiu.
Nyasaye doritou.
Gik moko maber mukwaye,
Nyasaye domiyou.

4. Kata uneno dhier ahinya,
Nyasaye doritou,
Lame gi chunyu ndalo duto.
Nyasaye doritou.

title: Yesu En Jakwadha
lyrics:
1. Yesu en Jakwadha, ok nachand'ra,
Omiya yuweyone,
E lum mang'ich otelona.
E dir pige mokuwe.

Chorus:
Lote ni yot kendo ting'ne ni yot,
Ang'eyo ma, ang'eyo ma,
Otelona pile ka pile
Ka pi mar ngima chwer.

2. Chunya yuakni miya tekoni,
Mondo awuothi e yo
Modhi madiny, modhi kare,
Nikech Nyingi maber.

3. U kata anakadhi e yor tho,
Ok analuor gimoro,
Nikech In koda kendo luth
Mar Wachni ohoya.

title: Yie Kende
lyrics:
1. Kwedh Ruoth, kik uluor, luw Yesu chuth,
Notho kendo ongima nikech joge,
Teko man e piny kod mar Polo duto
Nomiye nikech herane kuom kwedhe.

Chorus:
Yie kende, yie kende;
Duto onyalore, yie kende;
Yie kende, yie kende;
Duto onyalore, yie kende.

2. Kwedh Ruoth, kik uluor, otelo nyimu,
Jakwath maber nochikou tir e yo;
Pi mar Mara noleki doko mamit,
Ni jo moyie yudo ngima kuome.

3. Kwedh Ruoth, kik uluor kata ting' nitie,
Odonjo kodi kuonde ma ji ok ne,
Ok nowyey ngang' to En kodi pile,
Gen kuome chutho, hawi nobed mari.

title: Chomuru Wang'u Kuom Yesu
lyrics:
1. Chunyu ni kod parruok koso,
Ler onge to mana mudho?
Kamano biuru ir Yesu,
Nomiu ngima moloyo.

Chorus:
Chomuru wang'u kuom Ruoth,
Ranguru wang'eno maler;
Eka gik me piny ok noterwa ngang',
Hap Yesu e momiyowa ler.

2. Kuom tho noloyo richo duto,
Wan bende wakwano ndalo,
Ma richo ok noluowa kendo,
Yie Yesu ogonyowa.

3. Wachne e mochungi adiera,
Yie kend' e manyalo duto te:
Dhiuru nyis ji duto molal,
Osekelonwa warruok.

title: Kwan Gweth Magi
lyrics:
1. Ka Satani otemi, kodwaro loi,
Ka chunyi oani e masicheni:
Par Yesu jawari ndalo mokonyi,
En nosiri koro, pod oheroi.

Chorus:
Kwan gweth magi, hul achiel achiel,
Kwan gweth magi, ka wiyi owil,
Kwan gweth magi, hul achiel achiel,
Yesu osekonyi, kik wiyi owil.

2. Koso in Ja-Kristo man gi chuny mapek?
Ting'o misalaba e wach matek?
Par Yesu jawari, chuny mapek noa,
Iniyud mor koro, kata e piny ka.

3. Kinyo jo moko man gi pith mag piny,
Mwandugi nokadhi ndalo yoko piny;
Par Yesu Jawari, Ruodh polo malo,
Gen moloyo Kristo gi pok masko.

4. Kendo e twenje bedi ng'atno mager,
Wach mar mirambo to logi wach maber,
Yesu ma Jawari gi malaka,
Ginimor moloyo e Polo kucha.

title: Ruoth Dak Idew?
lyrics:
1. Ruoth dak idew?
Ka apaka mag tem hinya mak dating wiya
Ka tekra rumo genona ringo
Kendo wuoth medo bet mabor?

Chorus:
Ong'eyo wechena duto,
Chunya kik obed maluor
Kat' ahiti gingore malieh
Apaka wuo ok noweya.

2. Ruoth dak idew
Ka mudho yimo yora sama masiche ng'eny
Kendo genona lokore kuyo
Ruoth awakni yie 'mak lweta?

3. Ruoth dak idew
Ka masiche mag chunya otamore rumo
Thim mag otieno gi pi wang' mathoth
Ka chunya lit aonge kwe?

4. Ruoth dak idew
Kasekwedo nwandu kod mor duto mag Piny ni
Katweyo chunya ne dwaroni Ruoth
Kuwe ni ema orom chunya?

title: Wachni, Ruoth, Osiko
lyrics:
1. Wachni, Ruoth, osiko,
Temonwa kawuotho:
Ng'a moyie adierie
Ler gi mor oyudo.

2. Ka wasikwa sudo
Wachni duogo chunywa:
Wach mar hoch madierni
Nyisowa Jakonywa.

3. Yamo to kokudho,
Mudho lil e nyimwa,
Ler mar Wachni telo
Ni jowuoth madwari.

4. Ng'a manyalo kwano
Mor madier gi mwandu
Ma jomulo duto
Nwang'o e Kitapi?

title: Asenwang'o Osiep Maber
lyrics:
1. Asenwang'o 'siep maber, En Yesu Jawarna,
Oberna maloyo gana gi gana;
Aneno ber duto mag piny obet kuome kende,
Opwodho chunya kendo omiya 'kwe;
Ohoyo chunya pile e ndalo mar chandruok,
En e moting'ona gik mapek te.

Chorus:
Apako Jawarna, Yesu, Otimona ng'wono,
Oberna maloyo gana gi gana.
Ohoyo chunya pile e ndalo mar chandruok,
En e moting'ona gik mapek te.
Apako Jawarna, Yesu, Otimona ng'wono,
Oberna maloyo gana gi gana.

2. Oseting'o chandruok ga, kod richona duto,
Kitema orita, En e tekona;
Bet gariyo ok nyalre, En kende malame,
Osewara, orita gi tekone;
Kata jopiny nochaya, Satani notema,
Kuom Yesu gi Wachne nalo dute.

3. Yesu ok noweya ngang', kata ok nojuang'a;
Onyisa abet ma ngima kuom yiena;
En e twanda mosiko, ok naluor gimoro,
Gi 'manna' mar Wachne opidho chunya;
To chieng' moro nooma, nanene wang' gi wang',
Wanabedi gi mor ndalo mochwere.

title: An E Ritne
lyrics:
1. An e ritne ka ma bedo maber;
Kata aneno tem kod pek moko,
Pod chunya gene, kang'eyo norita
Oseng'iewa, koro an nyathine.

Chorus:
E bwo ritne, e bwo ritne,
Ng'a ma dipoga kode?
E bwo ritne e ma dasiki,
Norita chutho pile.

2. An e ritne, mohoyo chunya pile!
Kata aol, omiya yuweyo!
Kata ayudi masira e pinyi;
Yesu orita, ogwedha bende.

3. An e ritne, omiya mor maloyo,
Norita nyaka naa e pinyi;
Onge gi marach moro ma dihinya;
Kuom Yesu abedo maber pile.

title: Awuoro Ng'wono mar Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Awuoro ng'wono mar Nyasaye,
Mosefwenyorena;
Hera mar Yesu ka notho,
Nowara e richo.

"Ang'eyo Jalo ma aseyie,
To ayie chutho onyalo rito
Ngimana gi chunya duto
Nyaka ndalo nogono."

2. Awuoro ka nochiwona
Yie ma osewara;
Kendo geno Wachne chutho
Momiya kwe e chunya.

3. Awuoro ka Roho Maler
Onyiso kuom richo;
Mofwenyo Yesu gi Wachne
Kokelo yie kuome.

4. Awuoro kaka Ruoth nobi
Chieng' moro nooma;
Odiechieng' kata odiewuor.
Mos wanarom kode.

title: Kuwe Ma Wuoro
lyrics:
1. Nabiro ir Yesu mi nanwang'o
Kuwe mawuoro; kuwe mawuoro.
Kata chandruok kod tem obirona
An gi kuwe maber.

Chorus:
Kuwe, kuwe, kuwe mawuoro.
Kuwe, kuwe, kuwe mar Polo.
Nyaka Jawarna noreso chunya
An gi kuwe maber.

2. Herane matut orita maber
Ma an gi kuwe, ee, an gi kuwe;
Anyalo yuweyo kuom Nyasaye,
An gi kuwe maber.

3. Yesu nowaro chunya gi rembe,
Koro amor, koro amor.
Omiya abed mangima kode,
Mi koro amor.

Chorus:
Mor, mor, mor mawuoro,
Mor, mor, mor mar Polo.
Nyaka Jawarna noreso chunya
An gi mor maber.

title: Un Jo Mohero Nyasachwa
lyrics:
1. Un jo mohero Nyasachwa
Ikeuru ni lweny,
Ni lweny matimore e chuny
Jo-Kristo ndalogi.
Watim teko ndalo duto
Wadhi nyime pile;
Yie e mwaloyogo adier
Tem duto mag pinyni.

Chorus:
Yie e mwalochogo,
Yie e mwalochogo,
Yie Yesu ma jawarwa
E mwaloyogo piny.

2. Bendechwa to en herane
Wachne e ligangla;
Waluw e yorene pile
Kwapako Ruodh Yesu.
Kuom Yie wabed jokinda ka
Kik chunywa a koro
Yie e moloyo kara tho,
Pod obet kuot marwa.

3. Ng'a molocho kuom Nying Yesu
Noyudi duong' maler.
Wakawuru ogut warruok
Hera mojiw chunywa.
Warweyore kod adiera
Mi wanariemb mudho.
Ng'a molocho kuom Nying Yesu
Noyudi duong' maler.

title: Ahero Winjo Nying' Yesu
lyrics:
1. Ahero winjo Nying Yesu,
Omit ni jo maler,
Ohoyoa, ochangoa,
Omiya bet jachir.

2. Othiedho chunya ma netuo,
Okuweyo mirima;
Oromo chuny ka cham mamit;
Oyueyo ng'at mojony.

3. Akawo koro Nying' maber,
En Lwandana matek;
En Mwanduna ma nyaka chieng',
En Decha ma ok rum.

4. Yesu Jakwath makwayoa,
Jaduong' malosona;
In Yo adier materoa
E Dala mar Nyasaye.

5. To pod nonge teko ka,
Adwaro heroi;
To ka naneni kak' ibet,
Napaki chutho ku.

title: Koro Wagenoi Yesu
lyrics:
1. Koro wagenoi,
Yesu mar Kalwari,
Yesu Ruodhwa;
Winjwa kwalamoi,
Gol kethruokwa oko,
Konywa bedo maber
Pile pile.

2. Ruoth, nyiswa ng'wononi,
Jiw chunywa, ilegwa,
Mediwa geno;
Kaka nitho ni wan,
Miwa heri chutho
Gi hera mosiko,
Ma ok lokre.

3. Ka wadak e piny ka,
Ka chunywa okuyo,
Yesu konywa;
Ruodhwa, dag e chunywa:
Bedi Jahochwa ka,
Chieng' moro terwa e
Polo Maler.

title: Ka Nogik Chieng' mar Pentekost
lyrics:
1. Ka nogik chieng' mar Pentekost,
Ne nitie jo-Kristo,
Kendo Roho nool kuomgi,
Kaka Ruoth nosechiko.

Chorus:
Ruodhwa Yesu, iritwa,
Kaka jogi noriti;
Iolnwa Roho Maler,
Mapong'o chunywa chuth.

2. Kane giwinjo duond yamo,
Ka yamo maduong' ngang',
Nobiro kendo nopong'o
Odno ma ne gibetie.

3. Kendo lep machalo gi mach
Ne ofwenyore nigin,
Ma nopong'o jogo duto
Kaka Ruoth nosechiko.

4. Kendo Roho Maler adier
Nopong'o jogo duto.
Ne giwuoyo gi dhok moko,
Kaka Roho miyo gi.

title: Yesu Kristo en Osiepwa
lyrics:
1. Yesu Kristo en osiepwa.
En mogolo richowa.
Wan wanyalo kwaye pile
Gi maber mwachando ka;
To nikech waweyo saye,
Ok walame pile ka,
Kuwe oonge e i chunywa
Ber wanyisi Yesu wach.

2. Ka Satani dwaro temu,
Ka masira maku,
Chuny kik oa kuom Yesu,
Ber wanyisi Yesu wach.
Ere ng'ato ma dikonywa
Kuom masira manie piny?
Yesu ong'eyo nyawowa,
Ber wanyisi Yesu wach.

3. Wan wanyap, wajony, to pile
Richowa chingowa;
Luandawa en Yesu kende
Ber wanyisi Yesu wach.
Ka owadwa dwaro wewa,
Ber wanyisi Yesu wach;
En noruakwa, En nokonywa,
En nomiwa chuny mamor.

title: Lam Kichiew
lyrics:
1. Lam kichiew ia e nin'do, lam bende godiechieng',
Lam kendo godhiambo bende, lam kendo gotieno be,
Mondo chunya othege chuth, kod timbe mag mudho,
Geno kuom Ruoth Yesu kende, lam ndalo ka ndalo.

2. Owadwa, bed gi chury mar lamo ne ji duto,
Osiepe kod wasigu midwaro ndhogogi.
An bende kuonde duto asiki ka alamo,
To rem duto maango nyasaye pong' ona.

3. Kapo ichando kar dak lam pile mak iyue,
Kel chandruok magi duto jahoch mang'won nitie,
Roho maler jakonywaodagi e chunyi,
Mondo orwaki ire e Polo ka Nyasaye.

4. Kang'ato ohero piny ni ok noyudi gweth mathoth,
Gen mana kuom Nyasaye kende kaka osechikoi,
Kwa weruok kuom Ruoth Yesu Kisetimo richo,
Bed mamor kod Ruodhi chutho en e Nyasach hera.

title: Wuo Gi Chunya
lyrics:
1. Wuо gi chunya, Ruoth Yesu,
Nyisa wach kak' obet
Ka niwacho gi ng'wono
Ok niweya kenda.
Yaw chunya mond' awinji
Piyo kiwuoyona.
Dhoga to mond' opaki
Kamor kuomi chutho.

Chorus:
Wuo koda ndalo duto
Kinyisa berani
Nimondo alo richo
Kawuotho kuom Roho.
Wuo koda ndalo duto
Kuom wachni mar ng'wono,
Ageno singruok mari
Ok niweya kenda.

2. Wuо gi nyithindi pile,
Tergi e yo maler,
Pong'gi kod hera gi mor,
Puonjgi rito lamo
Mondo giwalni chunygi
Kod ngimagi bende
Mondo pinyruodhi obi
Wanameni, Yesu.

3. Wuo koda koro, Yesu,
Nyisa gi midwaro
Mondo atim pile
Kamako chik duto.
Keta amri duong',
Konya nyiso pakni
Gi mor natim dwaroni
Kalumori pile.

title: Bi Roho mar Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Bi Roho mar Nyasaye,
Bi konyowa duto,
Walamoi kawuono,
Konyowa gi tekoni.

Chorus:
Roho mar Nyasaye,
Bi, changwa duto,
Walamoi kawuono,
Gedie chunywa pile.

2. In e Roho Mang'won,
Chunywa bende yuakni,
Wadwaro mond' ilose
Ek' wadoko jo Nyasaye.

3. In e Roho mahero,
Chunywa bende ikony
In mikelonwa, ngima,
Ber wan duto waheri.

4. Roho mar Nyasaye bi
Gedie chunywa duto,
Wanabed kodie Polo
Higini gi higini.

title: Wachokore e Nyim Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Wachokore e nyim Nyasaye,
Warito gwethne koro,
Wageno En moherowa,
Nong'iewowa gi rembe.

Chorus:
Bi Roho mar Nyasaye,
Riw chunywa gi hera,
Kudh tekoni kuomwa
Majiwowa.

2. Wanamor kuom teko mari,
Wanawer kuom ng'wononi,
Roho mond'ibi e dierwa,
Bi, ee, bi, lo e chunywa.

3. Mi walami gi adiera,
Kendo sir chunywa duto
Kwamako singruok gi yie
Mar tekoni kuom Roho.

title: Kik Iweya
lyrics:
1. Kik iweya mak igwedha,
Winji yuakna;
Ka pod ilimo ji moko,
Kik ikadha, Ruoth.

Chorus:
Jawar, Jawar,
Winji kwayona,
Ka pod igwedho ji moko,
Kik ikadha, Ruoth.

2. Mi ayudi ng'wono kuomi,
Kod kwe e chunya;
Kahuloni richo maga,
Luoka gi rembi.

3. Ageno tekoni kende
Gi hera mari;
Chang chunya mosethkoni,
Wara gi ng'wono.

4. In e soko mar pi maber
Makelo ngima;
Onge ng'a maromo kodi,
Manyalo konya.

title: Godiechieng', Gotieno
lyrics:
1. Pile adwaro bedo
Kuomi Yesu, Jawar maduong';
Rembi isechwerona,
Rita pile,abed mari chuth.

Chorus:
Godiechieng', gotieno,
Tekoni obed kuoma,
Herani oyuyawa
Buti pile, pile, Ruoth Yesu.

2. E wuodha ndalo duto
Telna e yo madhi e Polo;
Kageni ok nalal ngang';
Rita pile, aluwi maber.

3. Adwaro heri chutho
Nyaka ngima mar pinyi orum,
Nyaka adhi dag kodi
Malo kucha e Polo gi mor.

title: Wan Gi Jakonywa
lyrics:
1. Wan gi Jakonywa modak ei Polo,
Osiepwa maber ngang', orito ji te,
Oritwa, okonywa ni mondo wayie,
Wayie Jakonywa mokonyo ji te.

Chorus:
Koro wan wayuakni, Koro wan wayuakni,
Koro wan wayuakni, Jawar, jo molal.

2. Geno maber ngang' dibed marwa,
Yesu omiyo ji duto moyie,
Gitundo maber ngang', gidak ei Polo,
Walamo Nyasachwa mowinjo ji te.

3. Jawarwa nobiro ni mond' owarwa,
Owachonwa weche mabeyo ni ji,
Walame, wasaye, Jawarwa owinjwa,
Ji duto moyie gitundo e Polo.

title: Kik Iwe Lamo
lyrics:
1. Kik iwe lamo, Ruodhwa nitie,
Kik iwe lamo, nowinj' yuakni.
Nyasaye osesinge, En adier,
Kik iwe lamo, noduogni wach

2. Kik iwe lamo, kuom chan mai,
Kik iwe lamo, Ruoth nowinji,
Onge lamo matin e nyime,
Kik iwe lamo, nomiyi duto.

3. Kik iwe lamo e temruok te,
Kik iwe lamo, diber chutho,
Kristo nong'eyo gweth mar lamo
Kik iwe lamo, nomak lweti.

4. Kik iwe lamo ka chunyi lit,
Kik iwe lamo, nomiyi kuwe,
Wiye ok nowil kuom chandruokni,
Kik iwe lamo nomiyi duto.

5. Kik iwe lamo to med' gene,
Kik iwe lamo, lamo 'winjre,
Geno oriombonwa dhier mathoth,
Kik iwe lamo, noduogni wach.

title: Luoka Maoth
lyrics:
1. Yesu Ruodhwa, adwar Roho mari,
Ni mondo osik koda ite pile,
Gol kuoma maricho gitim duto te,
Mani e chunya, mopog kodi Ruoth.

Chorus:
Luoka mapoth Aa, luoka mapoth,
Nyaka chunya vinjre Gi Roho mari.

2. Yesu Ruodhwa, kik iw gimoro ngang',
To duny kethona gi rembi manochwer,
Ajok kod mago mag piny nikech ginono,
Adwaro mor moa e Poo malo.

3. Yesu Ruodhwa, inena kama intie,
Kendo konya ni mondayik chunya,
Naweyo tim mar ji gi kt pinyini te,
Koro luoka gi rembi nabok maler.

4. Yesu Ruodhwa, Ne arit pile ka,
Bi losina chuny manyien maler chutho,
Kuom jo mosekwayi ok ikwer gi ngang',
To luoka mapoth eka nabed maler.

title: Bedi Koda
An Mari, Ruodha
lyrics:
1. An mari, Ruodha, nawinjo dwondi
Ka ninyisa herani,
To adwar imedna yie koro,
Kendo suda iri, Ruoth.

Chorus:
Ywaya buti, buti, Ruoth mang'won,
Nikech isetho kuoma,
Ywaya buti, buti, Ruodha maduong',
Nikech nichuero rembi.

2. Pwodha koro, Ruoth, mond' atiyoni,
Kuom teko mar ng'wononi.
Mi chunya geno kuomi pile, Ruoth,
Ka gi midwaro, berna.

3. Mor opong' chunya pile kabiro
Nyimi kendo iwinja.
Kalami, Nyasacha, man e Polo
Wan gi winjruok mar adier.

4. Herani matuk ok anyal ng'eyo
Nyaka atundi kuno.
Mor man e Polo okadho ng'eyo,
Anachopi kuom Yesu.

title: Adwaro Wach Yesu
lyrics:
1. Adwaro ng'eyo ka Yesu
Nokecha ka yande nalal,
Omiya ngima mak norum,
Kodi ng'wono amor kode.

Chorus:
Adwaro Wach Yesu,
Adwaro Wach Yesu.
Medna ng'eyo warruok chutho,
Kodi ng'wonone man kuoma.

2. Wach mar Yesu apuonjora,
Mondo ang'e gi modwaro.
Roho Maler otelona,
En opuonja ndalo duto.

3. Adwaro somo Wach mare,
Omiya winjruok kod Ruodha
Ka winjo duonde kuom weche,
En nobed maduong' kuoma.

4. Adwaro winjo kuom Yesu,
Weche duto mar duong'ine,
Kaka oloyo piny duto,
Ruodh mirembe nowir kendo.

title: Chiembi Mar Chuny
lyrics:
1. Chiembi mar chuny riya, koro Yesu.
Chon ne ipidho ji, to wan bende
Kuom weche magi mag Nyasaye mokonyowa.
Chunya riyo mako kuom Wach Mari.

2. Gwedhna weche magi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Kaka ikonyo ji moluwoyi.
Eka igonyona gik motweya.
Anayud kuwe mara kuomi, Yesu.

3. Konya mondo adok japuonj mari,
Ka joote machon e Galili.
Ka tichna orumo nalo duto,
Naneni e Polo, Yesu Ruodhwa.

title: Yawna Wang'a
lyrics:
1. Yawna wang'a mondo ane,
Weche mantie kuom chunya,
Miya Roho Maler mapuonja
Kendo medna teko mari.

Chorus:
Kawuono ariti, Yesu,
Chunya oikore kuomi.
Yawna wang'a, kendo puonja,
Roho Maler.

2. Yawna ita mi awinji
Weche mi orona koro,
Keta mond apar kuomi kende,
Golna richona duto te.

3. Yawna dhoga mond apuonj ji,
Gi mor nikech wach mar adier,
Mosedonjo e chunya koro,
Anadhi puonjo ji duto.

title: Wachni Obedi E Chunya
lyrics:
1. Wachni e taya mar tienda,
En ler mar yora pile,
Otelona a e richo,
Onyisa yo mar polo.

Chorus:
Wachni obedi e chunya,
Mondo kik aketh e nyimi,
Ni kik akethi, ni kik akethi,
Wachni obedi e chunya.

2. Wachni ma nyaka nene chon,
Ogurore mosiko.
Adier mari man kuom dhano
Obedo ma nyaka chieng'.

3. Gokinyi, gotieno pile,
Napaki ndalo duto,
Nikech In e miroma, Ruoth,
Obedna ka ma pile.

4. Kuom En ma wachni onyiso
En Jawar mar ji duto,
Warruok kendo kuwe nobiro
Ni ji moyie kuome.

title: Tim Kinda Mar Lamo
lyrics:
1. Tim kinda mar lamo, kiwuoyo gi Ruoth,
Pidh chunyi gi Wachne kibedo kuome,
Lal'ri gi Jokristo, kony jogo manyap,
To kik wiyi wil ngang', kuom dwaro gwethne.

2. Tim kinda mar lamo, piny kadho piyo,
Bed kode kipondo, kuom Yesu kende,
Ting' wang'i kuom Yesu, ibedi ka En,
Mi ji moko nong'e Yesu ni kodi.

3. Tim kinda mar lamo, Ruoth oteloni,
Kik iring e nyime, kata ringo chien,
E mor kata chuny lit, luw Yesu pile,
Ket wang'i kuom Yesu, kigeno Wachne.

4. Tim kinda mar lamo, opwodho chunyi,
Paro kod tich duto, obedi kuome,
Roho noteloni, nomiyi hera,
Nolosi kuom tiehne, e Polo malo.

title: Achando Kony Kuomi
lyrics:
1. Achando kony kuomi, Ruodha mang'won,
Onge ma dimiya kuwe to mana In.

Chorus:
Kony mari e machando; achando kony pile
Gwedha koro, Jawarna, abiro iri.

2. Achando kony mari, bed koda, Ruoth;
Tem ok noloya ngang' ka In buta.

3. Rita pile pile, ka angi mor
Kata aneno lit; bedi koda.

4. Adwari saa duto, In Jaler chuth;
Losa abed mari, Ruodha Yesu.

title: Rang Chunya, Ruoth
Saa Mar Lamo
lyrics:
1. Saa mar lamo, e mamorgo,
Omiya yuweyo e chandruok,
Omiya kinde mar nyiso
Wuora gik machando chunya,
Moheyo chunya kat' opek,
Kosira gi teko mare,
Maloyogo tem maricho
Katimo kinda kuom lamo.

2. Saa mar lamo e mamorgo,
Omiyo kwayona duto
Chopo ir Wuora me Polo,
Modwaro gwedha e chunya
Onyisa mond' asud ire
Kayie Wachne kendo geno,
Oting'ona paruok duto
Katimo kinda kuom lamo.

3. Saa mar lamo e mamorgo,
Otega kuom wuodha duto,
Nyaka chieng' moro anadhi
Dala ma ni e Polo cha;
Chandruok duto mag piny norum
Kaneno Ruodha wang' gi wang',
Mi nabet e lerne nyime,
Kapake to kwayo onge.

title: Tim Dwaroni
lyrics:
1. Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
In e Jachwech; an lowo kende,
Chweya kilosa kuom dwaroni,
Ka pod arito, kayie adier.

2. Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
Ranga kitema kawuono, Ruoth.
Pwodha gi rembi, luoka maler,
Kaling' e nyimi kendo ka muol.

3. Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
Gi chunya motur, konya koro.
Teko duto, Ruoth, e man kuomi;
Mula kichanga, jawar maler.

4. Tim dwaroni, Ruoth! Tim dwaroni!
In mond' iloya, chutho pile;
Pong'a gi Roho mi ji one
Ruoth Yesu kende e ngimana.

title: Jiw chunya, Ruoth Yesu
lyrics:
1. Jiw chunya, Ruoth Yesu, Mondo ane chuny ji,
Mul chunya, Ruoth Yesu, Mond' adhi apuonj ji.
Puonj chunya, Ruoth Yesu, Ka luwo yoreni,
Kaw ngimana, Ruodha, Mondo achwo kothi.

2. Jiw chunya, Ruoth Yesu, Kuom neno ng'wononi;
Nyaka ndalo moro Aneni wang' gi wang'.
Pong' chunya, Ruoth Yesu, Kod herani chutho
Nyaka ji one ni Abet mari adier.

title: Yesu Onindo E I Yie
lyrics:
1. Yesu onindo e i yie,
Kokadho Nam Galili;
Ahiti maduong' to okudho,
Pi nam gingore malich.
Jopuonjre chiewe gi luoro;
"Ruoth, ok idew kwatho?"
Eka Yesu nokwero apaka,
Nochiko yembe giling'.

Chorus:
To yembe gapaka winjo wach Ruoth:
"Kuweuru!" (Kuweuru!)
Kata ahiti malich chutho
Ka jochiende kelo kibaji ni ji.
Ka onge pi moro manyalo yimo
Yieno ka ma Ruodh Polo nindoe;
Gik moko duto nowinj chikne:
"Kuweuru, Kuweuru!"
Gik moko duto nowinj chikne:
"Mondo gikuwe!"

2. Yesu achandora tinde,
Apaka ni e chunya;
Temruok to ohiro ka yamo
Ayiengini, Ruoth konya.
Kethruok awinjo kohowa
Chunya odhier chutho.
To Ruoth Yesu, bi piyo,
Bi sira gi tekoni.

3. Ruodha, chunya koro kuwe,
Chandruok osekadhona:
Kuwe mari koro ni e chunya,
Kuom teko mar Wachni.
Bed koda pile, Jawarna,
Kik iweya kenda;
Eka danyal chopo kama
Abed kodi nyaka chieng'.

title: Adwaro Bedo Buti
Pwodha Abed Maler
Hera Ma Noseriwowa
lyrics:
1. Hera ma noseriwowa
E yie kuom Yesu Jawarwa
Kod lalruok maler ma ni e chuny joge ka,
Osiki kod gweth Nyasachwa.

2. Wanalam ni Wuonwa pile,
Otelwa e wuodhwa duto.
Kwachomo wang'wa ni Yesu ma Jakonywa
Wahore gi Wachne adier.

3. Di po ka masir' obiro,
Kata pek manadi mar piny,
Wanabed jokinda mar konyo owete
Kwasirore kuom geno Ruoth.

4. Wakuyo ka waweyore,
To Yesu noritwa duto
Gi herane nyaka watundi e Polo;
Wananere kendo kuno.

title: Yesu, Bed Jakwadhwa
lyrics:
1. Yesu, bed Jakwadhwa ndalo duto,
Wachando ritni kuomwa:
Pidh chunywa gi Wachni pile pile,
Loswa gigi mabeyo.
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Ning' Iewowa, wan magi,
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Ning' Iewowa, wan magi.

2. Wan magi, bed kodwa ndalo duto,
Telwa e yore pile,
Rit kwedhi, geng'wa e richo duto,
Dwarwa di po wabayo.
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Winjwa kod gi mwakwayo,
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Winjwa kod gi mwakwayo.

3. Yesu, ibed ruako nyithindo,
Wan gi richo kodi chan,
In gi ng'wono manyalo weyowa,
Luokwa gi rembi maler.
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Konywa mondo walok're.
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Konywa mondo walok're.

4. Dak igwedhwa ka pod wan nyithindo,
Konywa timo dwaroni.
Ruoth Yesu, in e Jawarwa kende,
Pong' chunywa gi herani.
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Iseherowa chutho.
Wapakoi, Ruodhwa Yesu,
Iseherowa chutho.

title: Wakelonu Wach
lyrics:
1. Wakelonu wach, wan jokwath maber
Mondo uwinji, wayudo hawi
E dala daudi Ruoth en Ruoth, e Bethlehem.
Osenyuolnwa Ruoth en Ruoth Yesu.

Chorus:
Wakelonu wach maber moloyo
Dala Bethlehem e Kisika (dhok)
Osenyuolnwa Ruoth manokuwe pinyi
Mondo wapake en Ruoth Yesu.

2. Ajuoge adekgi neluwo ler
Kagikelo mich ne nyathi monyuol
Negichopo mos e kund dhok maler
Manemane gi musubili (kodi ubani).

3. Jokwath bende mor wadhi Bethlehem
Wadhi wadendi nyathino monyuol.
Sulwe nonyiswa wang' yorno maler
Wadhi wadendi nyathi monyuol.

4. Herod' owinjo maiye owang'
Ochik' ajuoge uduogna wach.
An bend' awuogi adhi Bethlehem
Adhi adende nyathi monyuol.

title: Malaika Wuok e Polo
lyrics:
1. Malaika wuok e polo
Hayo e wi piny duto
Un muhero wend nyuol Jawar
Landuru nyuol Jawarwa.

Chorus:
Bi idende,
Kristo Ruoth onyuol.
Bi idende,
Kristo Ruoth Maler onyuol.

2. Jokwathgo e pap gi nano
Rito kwethgi otieno
Nyasaye gi dhano koro dak
Tach nyathi rieny loka cha.

3. Jomariek ne ok odewo
Kuom hingo ndiko maler;
Dwar Jaloch ogend piny duto
Museneno sand nyuolne.

4. Jomaler kulore nyime
Rito ka gidembore
Mapiyo Ruodhwa nolor piny,
En nonere kak' ochal.

title: Wadendi Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Usewinjo wer ne malaika wero
Gotieno chon ngang' ngang'?
Oganda me Polo nopako Nyasaye,
Ne giwacho kamano:

Chorus:
Wadendi Nyasaye man malo,
Wadendi Nyasachwa,
Wapako Nyingi, wapako nyingi,
Wadendi Nyasachwa.

2. Usewinjo wer ma ne jokwath nowinjo
Ka gikwayo kwedhegi,
Ka Polo nokakinigi momiyo giluor,
Nyaka giwinjo wach mano:

3. Usewinjo weche ma ne jorieko winjo
Ka gilowo bang' sulwe malong'o?
Timende kuwe osebiro e piny,
Kuom jo mohoro Nyasaye:

title: Noel Kanochakore
lyrics:
1. Noel kanochakore, malaika nower,
Ni Jokwath ma jochan manorito maber.
Rembe gi e lek, ka ginindo oko,
Ka piny timo koyo e ndalo nogo.

Chorus:
Noel, Noel, Noel, Noel,
Tinde onyuol Ruodh Israel.

2. Noel malaika, nochnungo butgi,
Kendo pichni mar Ruoth nokakni negi.
Mokwakogi, ne giluore ngang'!
Mikibaji nomakogi duto sidang'!

3. Noel e Bethlehem, dala mar Daudi,
Ei kisika dhok gi diek gi rombe,
Osenyuolnu nyathi, manokelu mor,
En Kristo Ruodh Polo, ma tinde olor.

4. Noel ma e ranyisi, nyathi nunwang' makwar,
Ei kisika dhok to adier en Jawar.
Gi kanyo nobet, gi malaikano,
Oganda me Polo kane giwer.

5. Noel wadendo Ruoth, man malo chutho,
Kuwe obed ne jopiny ma Nyasaye ohero.
Eka jomalaika, kagiseweyogi,
Kendo dok e Polo, gi wacho kendgi.

6. Noel to ber wadhi, loka Bethlehem,
Ne gireto monwang'o Joseph gi Min.
Kodi nyathi makwar, kaka malaika
Osehulonegi ne gilando wach ma.

title: Otieno Mokwe!
lyrics:
1. 'Tieno mokwe! 'tieno moling'!
Piny olil, sulwe rieny
Loka kama Nyathi oninde,
Jo maler e ma norite mos
Kwe mar Polo ni kodgi,
Kwe mar Polo ni kodgi.

2. 'Tieno mokwe! 'tieno maber!
Mudho rum', duto ler;
Jokwath winjo malaika wer,
"Haleluya ni Ruoth Maduong'
Osenyuolonu Jawar,
Osenyuolonu Jawar."

3. 'Tieno mokwe! Mudho onja
Sulwe rieny, tero ler,
Ajuoge moa e yo wuok chieng
Kelo mich mabeyo ni Nyathi
En Ruoth Yesu ma Jawar,
En Ruoth Yesu ma Jawar.

4. 'Tieno mokwe! 'tieno maber
Ler mondo orienynwa,
Wanamiye duong' kuom wer,
Haleluya ni Yesu Ruodhwa
En Jawarwa maduong',
En Jawarwa maduong'.

title: Ne Iweyo Duong'ni
lyrics:
1. Ne ibiro e piny mond' imany rombi
Ka niweyo duong'ni maler.
Ne ok iyudo kar bet e Bethlehem
Ne iyudo chandruok ni an.

Chorus: Stanza 1-4
Bi ibed kuoma Ruoth Yesu,
Ayawoni kar bet e chunya.
Bi ibed kuoma Ruoth Yesu,
Ayawoni kar bet e chunya.

2. Chieng' ono malaika nower ka paki
Ka nanyouli e Bethlehem.
Ne giye bedo ng'ut manyap chutho
Niweyo mwanduni duto.

3. Le mager mag thimbe gin gi buchegi.
Way ben de gin gi utegi.
To Wuod Nyasaye onge gi kar dakne,
Donge kata kar yweyo.

4. Ne ibiro e piny mond' wayud warruok.
Wabed jogi mowar adier,
To ji nochai kendo nonyieri
Oumb kudho gi ruak' e wiyi.

5. Jomalaika biro paki gi wer
Chieng' m'ibiro wire e piny.
Yie iwir piyo chunywa gomboi
Mond' wadag kodi nyaka chieng'.

Chorus: Stanza 5
Ruoth wanto wanail chutho
Kaduondi mamit luongowa.
Ruoth wanto wanail chutho
Kaduondi mamit luongowa.

title: Mor Ni E Piny
lyrics:
1. Mor ni e piny kuom nyuol Jawar.
En Ruoth pinyje duto.
Ruakeru e chunyu duto
Polo gi piny gi mor,
Polo gi piny gi mor,
To Polo gi piny gi mor kuome.

2. Mor ni e piny; Ruoth oloyo!
Ji duto pake
Pinyje gi gode duto pake
Komiye duong' maber,
Komiye duong' maber,
Komiye, komiye duong' kod pak.

3. Kik richo loyo piny koro,
To yieuru Yesu,
Nobiro reso jo ma nolal,
Kendo nokel hawi,
Kendo nokel hawi,
Nokel hawi ni jo moyie.

4. Oloyo gadieri chutho!
Ogendini none
Timne makare kod ng'wonone,
Kod herane maduong',
Kod herane maduong',
Herane, herane maduong' du.

title: Wan Gi Wende Mamit
lyrics:
1. Wan gi wende mamit adier
Kuom nyuol mar Yesu, ma Jawarwa.
Ka malaika kelo weche
Mabeyo momiyo ji mor ngang'.

Chorus:
Duong', duong' kuom Nyasachwa!
Ma nie Polo malo chutho!
Kendo mirembe ni e piny
Kuom jo mohero Nyasaye.

2. Jokwath moko ka giwinjo,
Ne gidhi Bethlehem ka Yesu,
Ne gipako kendo dendo
Nyasaye kosetimo sing machon.

3. Yesu, Jawar mar ji duto,
Noweyo duong'ne e Polo
Mondo ochiwore kuomwa
Wuod Nyasaye mogolo richowa.

title: Ne Onge Ot Maber
lyrics:
1. Ne onge ot maber, kata kitanda,
To kikia kende e moyangore;
Ne onge mor maber, ji ok noparo
Ka ne gin e richo, Jawar nobiro.

Chorus:
Yaw chunyi, mi Jawarmi
Kar bet e modwaro,
Dipo kitho miwinjo ni,
Onge kar bet mari.

2. Ji ok nodhi dende, ne ok giparo
Kaka nowinjore, gikulorene.
Nobiro ni joge, to ok ginuke,
Duong' ok gimiye, noon-ge kar bet.

3. To Nyasaye man malo, ne omiye duong'
Ka malaikane wer, kwe ma ni kuome
Jokwath moko bende, gi jogo mane winjo
Nodhi kendo dende; ne giyudo maber.

title: Winji Kaka Malaika Wer
lyrics:
1. Winji ka malaika wer,
"Duong' ni kuom Ruoth Yesu,"
Mirembe ni e piny duto
Ka Nyasaye nong' wonwonwa."
Chunguru gi mor maduong',
Pakuru Nyinge mamit,
Yesu Kristo onyuole
E dala mar Bethlehem.

Chorus:
Winji ka malaika wer
"Duong' ni kuom Ruoth Yesu."

2. Kristo en gi duong' malo,
Kristo en Ruoth mochwere,
Nosebiro kaka dhano
Ka noweyo duong'ne;
To wang'eyo en Nyasachwa,
Duong' obedne pile
Ma nodoko Jagachwa:
Yesu en Emmanuel.

3. Duong' ni kuom Ruoth Mirembe,
Duong' ni Ruoth Makare,
Mokelonwa ter gi ngima,
Kochangowa e richo,
Ka nobiro reso jogo
Manobedo e mudho;
Nomiyogi tekone
Dok nyithindo mag Nyasaye.

title: Biuru Un Duto
lyrics:
1. Biuru un duto, mohedo gi kinda,
Wanadhi Bethlehem gi mor e chunywa
Neuru Ruodhwa, mosebiro e piny.

Chorus:
Biuru ka wapake, Biuru ka kadende,
Biuru ka walame, Yesu Ruodhwa.

2. Jo-malaika wero, wer mamit moloyo,
Ka gikelo weche mabeyo mag Polo;
Duong' ni Nyasaye, kod mirembe nie piny.

3. Kamano wadendi, Yesu ma Jawarwa;
Nyingi obedi maduong' nyaka chieng',
Moseelonwa hera mar Nyasachwa.

title: Ne En Kende
lyrics:
1. Ne En kende ka nolamo
E puoth Gethsemane;
Kikombe mar rem nomadho
Kochandore kuoma.

Chorus:
Ne En kende,
Ka noting'o richo;
Yesu notho mond' owarwa,
Ne En kende ka nothonwa e Yath.

2. Yesu Kristo nochung' kende
E kar bura maduong',
Ginuko kudho e wiye,
To joge nowege.

3. Ne gigure e Yath mondo
Otho ni ji duto.
Nyasaye gi joge nowege
Mochiwo ngimane.

4. Dikwer hera maduong' kama
Kiweye in bende.
Bi ire, ruake e chunyi,
Ibed kode pile.

title: Wasechokre Kawuono
lyrics:
1. Wasechokre kawuono Mondo wapar kuom Yesu.
Ka ne pok oweyo piny, Nochiko kakama.
Ni walos rapar thone Nyaka Yesu wir e piny.

2. Yandwageno liswech piny, Ti waweyo mapo te,
Wayie remb Ruodhwa, Wayie Wuod Nyasachwa,
Wan warito ndalone, Nyaka Yesu wir e piny.

3. Mkatini ranyis ringre, Manoroch kuomwa duto;
Kikombe nyiso rembe, Monochwer e Kalwari,
Maluoko chuny jio moyie, Nyaka Yesu wire piny.

4. Neuru chiemb herruok, Madhuru kendo ucham;
Ka utimo kamano. Paruru kuom herane,
To kendo kuom ng’wonone, Nyaka Yesu wir e piny.

title: Remb Yesu En Kod Gweth
lyrics:
1. Remb Yesu en kod gweth mathoth, oluoko richo jomoyie
Wayudo waruok kuom rembe, manochwer e got Kalwari
Ne awinjora donj'eibura kuom richo mane atimo
To koro luoka gi rembi mi nadok matar kaka pe.

Chorus:
Tar moloyo pe, Tar moloyo pe,
Luoka gi rembi manochwer
Naded matar moloyo pe.

2. Ne girwakone osimbo mar kudho ka ne gigure,
Noyudo rem kod tem mathoth kanoting'o richo duto
An kor' adwaro donj e soko mond' ayud luokruok madier
Remb Yesu e soko luokruok, mi nadok matar kaka pe.

3. Nyasaye Wuora aseketho kendo chunya ool ahinya
Richona osemedore nayud warruokna aa kanye?
Kuom sokoni kende Ruoth Yesu abiro ka yawo chunya
To koro luoka gi rembi, mi nadok matar kaka pe.

title: Be Ne Intie?
lyrics:
1. Be ne intie ka gihingo Ruodha?
Be ne intie ka gihingo Ruodha?
Into bende ne ikonyo gie ndhogo Jawar?
Kane gihingo, ndhogo Jawarwa?

2. Be ne intie ka giguro Yesu?
Be ne intie ka giguro Yesu?
Into bende, ne ikonyo gie guro Jawar?
Kane gi guro, guro, Ruoth Yesu?

3. Be ne intie ka Jawarwa notho?
Be ne intie ka Jawarwa notho?
Into bende ne itho, ne itho, kode, kode?
Ka Ruodhwa Yesu Jawar nothonwa?

4. Be ne intie kane gi ik' e bur?
Be ne intie kane gi ik' e bur?
Into bende, ne in kode ebur, ebur nogo?
Kane gi iko Jawar ei bur?

5. Be ne intie ka Ruoth Yesu nochier?
