Be ne intie ka Ruoth Yesu nochier ?
Into bende ne ichier kod Jawar, kode, kode?
Ka Yesu owuon nochier mongima?

title: Chunya Wuoro Kaparo Yath
lyrics:
1. Chunya wuoro kaparo Yath
Ka ma Ruoth Yesu nothona.
Duto ma an go ni nono.
Ok awinjora gi herane.

2. Kik apako gi moro ka
Mak mana tho mar Ruoth Yesu.
Gik moko me piny mahero
Aweyogi nikech rembe.

3. Neuru herane kuomwa
Koting'o richowa Owuon.
Ne giketo osimb kudho
E wi Jawarowa mang'won.

4. Mwandu duto ma ni e piny
Nobedo mich matin kuome.
Owinjore achiwone
Chunya gi ngima kod duto.

title: Remb Jawar E Ma Nochwerna
lyrics:
1. Remb Jawar e ma nochwerna,
Ka Ruoth noyie tho,
En Maler nochwerena
Ma ok owinjrena.

Chorus:
E kuom Yath mar Yesu nakuongo neno ler,
Ma nogolo richo man e chunya,
Kuom yie rembe ma nochwerna,
Omiya amor ndalo duto.

2. Nikech richo ma natimo,
Nogure e Yadhno,
Chunya wuoro ng'wono ka ma,
En hera mokadho.

3. Chieng' nolokore ka mudho
Ka Ruodh Polo notho,
En Yesu Kristo Wuod Nyasaye,
Ma noting'o richo.

4. Yuak gi pi wang' ok dochula,
Gowi mar herane;
Chunya e machiwoni, Ruoth,
Abed ng'ati kende.

title: Jawar Notho E Kalwari
lyrics:
1. Jawar notho e Kalwari,
A gigo Ruodha Yesu,
Embe nochwer e Yath kuoma,
Misangoni owaroa.
E wi godno mar Kalwari,
Remb Yesu nochwerie kuoma.
E wi godno mar Kalwari,
Ki ma jawar notho kuoma.

2. Ka lwendini nobarore,
Ruodha Yesu notho kuoma,
Rageng' moyiech, oriwoa
Kod Nyasachwa moherowa.

3. Awuoro ngang' kuom ng'wononi,
Kiweyo ngimani kuoma,
Kitingo' Yath, gi sand duto,
Mondo iwara e richo.

title: Yesu, Dak Irit Chunya
lyrics:
1. Yesu, dak irit chunya
Obed kuomi pile.
Kwo nitie moa e
Soko mar Kalwari.

Chorus:
Kuom Yath ma nogurie
Yesu ma Jawarwa;
En obed pakna pile
E piny kod e Polo.

2. Nanwang'o ng'wono kuome
Ka nayie rembe,
Herane nofwenyore
Ka nothonwa e Yath.

3. Mi chunya neno Yesu,
Nyarombo mar Nyasaye.
Naluwe kating'o yath
Kaka nowachonwa,

4. Nikech nothonwa e Yath,
An agene chuth,
Nyaka oluonga adhi
Dag e Polo malo.

title: Chon E Got Ku Mabor
lyrics:
1. Chon e got ku mabor
Yath moro nochungie
Manyiso sand gi achaya;
To ahero Yadhno ka ma En mahena
Notho kuom jo maricho duto.

2. Jupiny nyalo chayo
Wach mar gur e Yadhno,
Aneno en wach maduong'
Nikech Ruodha Yesu nonyeyo duong'ne,
Moting'o richo e Kalwari.

3. Rembe maler nochwer
Chon ka ne gigure,
Omiyo awuoro ahinya
Ka Yesu nobeda misango moromo
Mar weyo richo jo moyie.

4. Koro anapako
Yesu ma nothona,
Kayie ting'o achayena,
Eka noluonga mabedi e Polo
Anamor kode gi duong'ne.

title: Winjuru, Lokuru Duto
lyrics:
1. Yesu nochier nowuokie bur,
Gi teko mar Nyasaye;
Notieko bura mar richo,
Kuom jo moyie rembe.

Chorus:
Winjuru, lokuru duto,
Kurito wiro Ruoth,
Chieng' moro En noomowa,
Koterowa e Polo.

2. Ne giruakone kondo
Mar kudho e wiye,
Ka ginyiere ka en e yath
Gi weche maricho.

3. Jotich mag Yesu nokawo,
Ringre gibo e nanga,
Gikete e bur mosekunya,
Giritogo chierne.

4. Ne ginene kak' odhiyo
E Polo malo ku
Chieng' moro en owir kendo
Kaka gine kodhi.

title: En Ng'awa
lyrics:
1. En ng'awa man e kund dhok,
Ma jokwath olamo cha?

Chorus:
En e Ruoth! To en Jawarwa!
En e Ruoth moloyo duto!
Wanagone chongwa piny,
Pakeuru, Yesu Ruoth.

2. En Ng'awa e thim kucha,
Ma Satani notemo?

3. En ng'awa e dho fiel,
Ma nochiero ng'a motho?

4. En ng'awa mathiedho ji,
Ma noyawo wang' jachan?

5. En ng'awa mogur e Yath,
Ma gisando, ma notho?

6. En ng'awa mochier maber,
Ma noloyo tho adier?

7. En ng'awa moheroa,
Ma nogolo richona?

8. En ng'awa e Polo cha,
Ma nobi e piny kendo?

title: Nitie Remo Nosechwer
lyrics:
1. Nitie remo ma nosechwer, ne en remb Immanuel;
Jo maricho koluokree, gipwodore maler,
Gipwodore maler, Gipwodore maler,
Jo maricho koluokree, Gipwodore maler.

2. Jamecho cha e kar thone Noyudo mor kuome;
To an bende ma ok aler, Noluokna kethna te,
Noluokna kethna te, Noluokna kethna te;
To an bende ma ok aler, Noluokna kethna te.

3. Remb Nyarombo ma nonegi, obedo gi teko
Mar pwodho jogo magene, ni kik giketh kendo.
Ni kik giketh kendo, Ni kik giketh kendo;
Mar pwodho jogo magene, Ni kik giketh kendo.

4. Nyaka nageno remono mochwer e Kalwari,
Apako hera mar Jawar, Moherowa kama.
Moherowa kama, moherowa kama;
Apako hera mar Jawar, Moherowa kama.

5. Ruoth kat' an ng'a marach kama, kuom ng'wononi maduong'
Isewara, ilosona Kar bet ma nyaka chieng'.
Kar bet ma nyaka chieng', Kar bet ma nyaka chieng'
Isewara, ilosona kar bet ma nyaka chieng'.

title: Nabayo E Richo
lyrics:
1. Nabayo e richo gi sunga,
Ka ok nadewo wach Ruoth Yesu;
Ok nang'eyo kaka nothona
E Kalwari.

Chorus:
Herane gi ng'wonone to duong',
Moweyona richona mathoth;
Asewang'o thuolo e chunya,
E Kalwari.

2. Wach Nyasaye nopuonja kuom richo,
Naneno kaka naketho chik;
Bura noloya nyaka nayie
Wach Kalwari.

3. Koro asechiwoni Yesu
Giga duto nikech en Ruodha.
Chunya opong' gi mor mawero
Kuom Kalwari.

4. Hera Nyasaye nolosso warruok,
Ng'wonone nokelo kony kuomwa
Notimonwa winjruok gi remo
E Kalwari.

title: Abiro E Msalaba
lyrics:
1. Abir' e msalaba'
An ayom, an ng'a modhier,
Aweyo gi piny duto,
Mond' akwo e msalaba.

Chorus:
An agenoi kende,
Nyarombo mar Kalwari;
Ruoth, akulora ni In;
Yesu Ruoth, mond' iwara.

2. Ayuakni koro, Jawar,
Richo e moloyou;
Yesu to wacho niya,
"Anawe giduto te."

3. Achiwoni duto te,
Ngimana kod tekona;
Chunya kod ringra bende,
Nobed mari nyaka chieng.

4. Kuom rembi ma nochwer,
Aseluokora koro;
Aweyo gombo duto,
Analuwi, Jawarna.

5. Yesu, bi, ipong' chunya,
Mond' abed molony kuom;
Abedi maler chutho,
Mond' apaki nyaka chieng'.

title: To Wuod Dhano Ma Notho
lyrics:
1. To Wuod Dhano ma notho,
Ma nosande, ma nogur,
En nusango mar jopiny.
Alleluya! En Jawarwa!

2. Ne gigure Golgotha,
Tho malit Owuon noyie;
Chunya mor, nawer kama,
Alleluya! En Jawarwa!

3. Jo maricho chon kucha,
Ne gisin kode marach,
Rembe to nowarowa;
Alleluya! En Jawarwa!

4. Yesu In nitho kuoma!
Nyaka chieng' naluwi ka;
Chunya mor, nawer kama
Alleluya! En Jawarwa!

title: Koro Ka Wachokore
lyrics:
1. Koro ka wachokore
Nomondo wahing Yesu;
Wanapar Yesu Kristo,
Wanayie gi chunywa;
Koro wahingo Yesu,
Ma notho e Kalwari.

2. Kwachamo mkati ni,
Kwandho kikombe ni,
Wanahing ring Jawarwa,
Ma nogur e Yath ni wan;
Wanahing remb Ruoth Yesu,
Ma nochwer e Kalwari.

3. Nyasachwa, ornwa Muchi,
Mondo donji e chunywa;
Koro wahingo Wuodi,
Kaka En notho ni ji,
Kaka rembe nochwerwa,
Ka notho e Kalwari.

title: Yesu Ruoth Ochier Tiniende
lyrics:
1. Yesu Ruoth ochier tinende, Halleluya,
Malaika, Jopiny wero, Halleluya,
Gouru mahu mar loch, Halleluya,
Jopolo mor piny pako, Halleluya.

2. Ongima tinende kendo, Halleluya,
In tho litni en liel, Halleluya,
Kuom tho Yesu wangima, Halleluya,
In tho litni orumo, Halleluya.

3. Onge rem e tij warruok, Halleluya,
Nochiwo rembe maler, Halleluya,
Tonde tho ok nyal genge, Halleluya,
Yesu yaw ranga Polo, Halleluya.

4. Tinende oloso kar dak, Halleluya,
Ka an e wuoth mar Polo, Halleluya,
Msalaba, liel, Polo, Halleluya,
Nachal kode Ruoth mochier, Halleluya.

title: Nochier Nowuok E Liende
lyrics:
1. Nomiyo ei bur,
Yesu Jawarwa;
Nochier bang' ndal' adek,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

Chorus:
Nochier nowuok e liende
Gi teko mar Nyasaye man malo,
Nochier ma noloyo tho gi Satani,
Ongima tinende modak gi joge,
Osechier! Osechier!
Haleluya, Ruoth Nochier.

2. Ne girito liel mar,
Yesu Jawarwa;
Ne girito kayiem,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

3. Tho ok nohingo Ruoth,
Yesu Jawarwa;
To noriembonwa tho,
Yesu Ruodhwa.

title: Wanarom E Polo
lyrics:
1. Ageno wanarom e Polo,
Ka chandruok mar piny norum,
Eka nahulo weche wuodha,
Ka chopo e nyim Nyasaye.

Chorus:
E nyim Jawarna, e kom duong' mare,
E dala Wuonwa, E pinyno mar mor,
Ageno wanarom, Ageno wanarom,
Kwasidho osimb locho e Polo.

2. Ageno wanarom e Polo,
E tiend yadh ngima maler;
Ageno wanapak Jawarwa,
Kuom warowa gi ng'uono.

3. Ageno wanarom e Polo,
Kwaluoro kom Jawarwa,
Ji duto mowar gi remb Yesu,
Kwa pako hera Nyasaye.

4. Ageno wanarom e Polo,
Katichna ma piny ogik,
Ageno wana mosre gi mor
Ka chopo e nyim Nyasaye.

title: Kawana Chop E Piny Polo
lyrics:
1. Kawana chop e piny Polo
Piny ma chandruok duto norum,
In e pinyo maok norum,
Kama pi wang' duto noywe.

Epiny ono ma Ruoth olosonwa,
toinjo duol mar Ruodha kaluonga,
Mechiegni anawe chandruokna
Mi anadag gi Ruoth manyaka chieng'.

Kawasechopo e Polo,
Kichio duto kod piny norum;
Kama chandruok duto norum;
Tiende mool nonwang' yueyo.

3. Onge dok chien e gik mag piny,
Chandruok duto mwase kadho;
Pi wang'wa ok nochwer kendo
Chuny jomoyie nobed mokwe.

4. Wanayud kuwe k'wasechopo
Kama Yesu rwak' e joge;
E piny Polo tembe norum,
Malaika wero wend rwak.

title: Nitie Piny Manyien
lyrics:
1. Nitie piny manyien gi Polo be manyien
Kama osesing ni jomaler.
Otieno ok nobedie kuno dala ler
Wanawer, wanamor manyaka chieng'.

Chorus:
Ende wadhiuru
Wadonji e dalano maler
Tho gi tuo ok nobedie
Ne jogo moseloyo lweny.

2. Yesu luongo jokorachwich ni duto tee
Bi udonj e morno mosiko
Kanatuo nulima bende nuruaka
Biuru un jotich mag Wuora.

3. Yesu riembo jokoracham auru,
Dhiuru e majno mosiko
Kana e jela ok ne ulima,
Ywagruok gi mwodo lak unubedgo.

4. Wang' yore gin ariyo madhi Polo
Yo matin Yesu nie rangach,
To malach Satan ochung e dho rangach.
Dak iyier yor ngima manyaka chieng'.

title: Osiepwa Wamor
lyrics:
1. Osiepwa wamor kwarom', E piny makadho piyo.
To paro mar kuyo Biro ni nyaka wago 'riti.

Chorus:
Ok wanapogre e polo, Ok wanapogre ngang'
E pinyno mar mor kod kuwe, Ok wanago oriti.

2. Mor miwuoro kajohera, Molocho dhi e ngima.
To ka tichwa ogik E piny ka wanadagi kodgi.

3. Weche manono ok nobedie, E dalano maler.
Mak mana wende mor Gi kwe kod ilo ema nwawer.

title: Pinyni Ok Thurwa
Onge Kuyo Kar Dak mar Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Onge kuyo kar dak mar Nyasaye.
Pi wang' kod rem ok nobedie,
Chuny mosin gi Parruok nonge,
Wanawer wende pak gi mor.
Rumbi mag Polo ok nobedie,
Bende ok none gi kendo,
To ler mar Ruodhwa norieny kuno;
Mor mar chunywa nochop kare.

Chorus:
An eyo madhi ka Nyasaye dala moho
Kama jomaler tienge duto
Nower e nyim kome mar duong'
Chunya gombo bedo e dala
Kendo neno wang' Ruoth ma Jawar
Mano mor manade manobedie cheng'no
E dalano mar dhahabu.

2. Ok wanabed gi gop kar udi
Gouru mag pinyni norum
Lepwa ok neyure kendo ti.
To ginisik manyien pile.
Ok wanare riyo kata kech
Chuny lit mar dhier ok nobedie
Mwandu mogundho go mag Polo
Nabed mag joge molocho.

3. Nyal kod thuth ok nobed dalano
Nyasi mag ik ok nobedie
Puothe liet ok nobed kanyo,
Tho bende ok nobed kuno.
Jo moti nobed ka nwere
Nomigi ringruokgo manyien
Ringruok ma ok wanohoe ngang'
Norieny malo sulwe gi chieng'.

title: Kendo Wang'a None Wang'e
lyrics:
1. Chieng' moro anawe piny ka,
Nimond' adonje piny malo;
To anamor katundo ku
Ka bedo gi Ruodha Yesu.

Chorus:
Kendo wang'a none wang'e;
Nahul warruok kuom ng'wone,
Kendo wang'a none wang'e
To anahul kuom warruokne.

2. Chieng' moro Ruodha noluonga,
Noluonga mos to nawinje,
Mi anawe piny ka gi mor,
Chieng' mawinjo luong mar Ruodha.

3. To chieng'ono, kaneno Ruoth,
Gosiepena mokwongona,
Abiro mor gi mor adier,
Kakadho rangach mar Polo.

title: Anang'eye
lyrics:
1. Katieko tich mara
Eka anakadhi e tho,
Anadonji e ngimano mar Polo,
Anang'eye Jawarwa,
Kasetundo e Polo,
Enechako mor koda pile pile.

Chorus:
Anang'eye, anang'eye,
Kachung' nyim Yesu ma Jawarwa
Anang'eye, anang'eye,
Kaneno mbala e luetene.

2. Anamor ngang' chieng'
Atane wang' Ruoth Yesu,
Anapak Nyinge pile pile kuno,
Kaparo kuom ng'wonone
Kodi herane kuoma
Molosonago kar bet ei Polo.

3. Osiepega mosedonjo,
Girita kawuono,
Aparo ndalo ma ne giweya ka.
Adwaro bedo kodgi
E Polo malo kucha,
To adwaro neno Yesu mokwongo.

4. Ka donjo ei Polo,
Enoruakna law maler,
Anayudi osimbo mara maber,
Moromo kodi tichna
Masetiyo e piny ka,
To adwaro neno Yesu moloyo.

title: Kar Dakwa Ma Nie Polo
lyrics:
1. Kar dakwa ma nie Polo,
Kama Jakony marwa odakie,
Kama jogo maler ok notho,
To gin gi ngima mak norum.
Kama tho ok nitie,
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo,
Kama Ruoth nitie e Polo,
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo.

2. Osiepe duto nobedie,
Mosekawo, motelo nyimwa,
Giwero ni Ruodhwa wer mamit.
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo,
To wendwa mwawero,
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo,
Kama Ruoth nitie e Polo,
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo.

3. Koro agombo bet kanyo,
Kama jomabeyo gimiere,
Wana a e kuyo marwa ka,
Kendo wanapake adier.
Kuwe nitie, kuwe nitie,
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo,
Kama Ruoth nitie e Polo,
Kar dakwa ma nie Polo.

4. Owetewa mang'eny nitie,
Kendo giritowa moloyo,
Ok wanawere chuth kendo ngang'
Wanadak kanyo nyaka chieng'.
E Polo, e Polo,
Wanadagie gi Yesu ku,
E Polo, e Polo, e Polo,
Wanadagie gi Yesu ku.

title: Kasekotieko Tich
lyrics:
1. Kasekotieko tich mara e piny,
Eka nadonji e Polo maber,
Eka nabedi gi Yesu Kristo,
Anamor kuno ngang' pile pile.

Chorus:
Anamor ngang' pile pile,
Kuom ng'wonone anane anane wang' Yesu,
Anamor ngang' ngang',
Anamor ngang' ngang'.

2. Hera mar Yesu Kristo to duong',
Enomiyo nabed kod' e Polo,
Kendo ka nane Yesu Jawarwa,
Anamor kuno ngang' pile pile.

3. Chieng' ka nane osiepega machon,
Abiro mor kodgi ndalo duto,
To nane Yesu koruaka kuno,
E momiyo amor pile pile.

title: Anamor Gi Lala
lyrics:
1. Anamor gi lala ka Ruoth nowir,
Anamor gi lala ka Ruoth nowir,
Anamor gi lala ka Ruoth nowir,
Koterowa e Polo.

Chorus:
Koterowa e Polo,
Koterowa e Polo,
Anamor gi lala ka Ruoth nowir,
Koterowa e Polo.

2. Wanawer gi ilo ka Ruoth nowir,

3. Wanarom gosiepwa ka Ruoth nowir,

4. Wanayud gir mwandu ka Ruoth nowir,

title: Anie Yo Madhi E Polo
lyrics:
1. Anie yo madhi e Polo
Ka ma jomaler dakie,
Haleluya, haleluya,
Enie piny ka Nyasaye,
Kuno 'tieno ok nitie,
Haleluya kuom Yesu.

Chorus:
Glory haleluya,
Anie yo madhi e Polo
Haleluya, haleluya.
Glory Haleluya,
Anie yo madhi e Polo
Haleluya kuom Yesu

2. Anie yo madhi e Polo,
Enie dala man gi kuwe,
Haleluya, haleluya
Ka maber mwanyalo dakie,
Jomaler duto dakie,
Haleluya kuom Yesu.

3. Anie yo madhi e Polo,
Dho rangach maduong' nitie.
Haleluya, haleluya,
Jo mabayo wuok tung' pinje,
Mondo gidonji e Polo,
Haleluya kuom Yesu.

4. Anie yo madhi e Polo,
Ananeno e Ruodhwa,
Haleluya, haleluya.
Higini gi higini,
Wanawere wende,
Haleluya kuom Yesu.

title: Adwaro Donjo E Polo
lyrics:
1. Adwaro donjo e Polo,
Adwaro donjo e Polo,
Adwaro donjo e Polo,
Nabedi gi Nyasaye.

Chorus:
Kadonjo e Polo, Nabedi gi Yesu,
Kadonjo e Polo, Nabedi gi Nyasaye.

2. Kudwaro bedo gi Nyasaye,
Kudwaro bedo gi Nyasaye,
Kudwaro bedo gi Nyasaye,
Biuru ir Yesu.

3. Kudwaro long'oni Yesu,
Kudwaro long'oni Yesu,
Kudwaro long'o ni Yesu,
Tiuru tich Nyasaye.

4. Kudwaro tiyo tich Nyasaye,
Kudwaro tiyo tich Nyasaye,
Kudwaro tiyo tich Nyasaye,
Kwauru chuny maler.

5. Kudwaro yudo chuny maler,
Kudwaro yudo chuny maler,
Kudwaro yudo chuny maler,
Weuru richou.

6. Kuyie weyo richou,
Kuyie weyo richou,
Kuyie weyo richou,
Nudonji e Polo.

title: Wanamor Nyaka Chieng'
lyrics:
1. Wawer wendene malong'o,
Kaka noborowa mokwongo,
Kaka nowarowa gi rembe,
Wanamor e Polo nyaka chieng'.

Chorus:
Wanamor nyaka chieng',
Wanamor kwatundo e gweng'no,
Wanamor nyaka chieng',
Wanamor kwatundo e Polo.

2. Enchangwa owarwa bende,
Gi remo mar Yesu Nyarombo,
Omiyowa mor koro chutho,
Kuom jakony me Polo nyaka chieng'.

3. Kawuono omiyo wan gi mor,
Nikech ber mar jabera nogo,
To kwatundo ire ndalono,
Wanapaki Nyinge nyaka chieng'.

4. Ka watimo kinda e Nyinge,
Nyaka Yesu en owir e piny,
Enoruakwa gi ng'wonone,
Wanamor kode chuth nyaka chieng'.

5. To nitie kite malong'o,
Mar jaler Ruoth Yesu nogono,
Mondo ji duto ng'eyo bende
Konyruok ma ni kuome nyaka chieng'.

title: Abiro neno Ruoth
lyrics:
1. Abiro neno Ruoth gi duong'ne,
E piny maber ahinya ngang',
Ka mudho olokore ka chieng',
Kobiro gi joge maler.

Chorus:
Abiro nene gi duong'ne, Nyarombo manotho,
Eka anapak Nyinge, Goganda mar Polo,
Haleluya, haleluya mi Nyarombo mar Nyasaye,
Haleluya, haleluya, Amen.

2. Noloka machalo gi Yesu,
Ndalo manenora kode,
Kendo ringrewa mar pinyni
Nolokore ka kit Kristo.

3. Ndalono maduong' e mwarito,
Ka Ruoth noter joge duto.
Jo moyie nong'eye chutho,
Ginine mbala e luete.

title: Bende Nyinga Nitie?
lyrics:
1. Mwandu mar piny nokadhi, Kod fedha duto te,
To Piny Ruodh e mosiko E madwaro donje,
Nyinga ni e kitabu, Mar Ruoth Yesu koso?
Mi chunya ng'eyo chutho Ka nyinga ni kuno.

Chorus: Stanza 1-2:
Bende nyinga nitie
E Kitabu Maler
Mar Piny Ruoth Yesu Kristo;
Bende nyinga nitie?

2. Richona thoth ahinya. To awinjo kaka
Remb Yesu e mowaro Ji dutto moyie.
Koro ageno Wachni Monyiso kuom richo,
"Kata gibedo makwar Nalokgi ma rachar."

3. Kamano amor bende Kageno Wecheni
Kuom udi man e Polo Milsonwa kar bet,
Richo ok nodonj kuno Kata ketho moro,
Yesu En e mowara Ee, nyinga ondiki.

Chorus: Stanza 3
Koro nyinga nitie,
E Kitabu Maler
Mar Piny Ruoth Yesu Kristo;
Koro nyinga nitie.

title: Wanasiki
lyrics:
1. Asewinjo kuom piny mar Polo malo cha,
Kar dak maber mar jo moseyie;
Yesu e moloso udi mag dalano,
En piny ka ma ok watho kendo.

Chorus:
Wanasiki, wanasiki,
E piny ka ma tho ok nobedie;
Wanasiki, wanasiki,
E piny ka ma tho ok nobedie.

2. E dalano maber ok wanachandore,
Wanabedi gi mor gilala,
Wanapaki Yesu higini ma ok rum
e piny ka ma ok watho kendo.

3. Ka tichwa orumo wanadhi dalano,
Masiche ok nobedie kendo,
Yuak norum bende to wanawer kod ji
Mosekwongowa dhiyo kuno.

title: An Jawuoth E Pinyni
lyrics:
1. An jawuoth e pinyni Ok nasiki ka ngang'.
Mwanduna osekan E Polo kod Yesu.
Malaika luonga Adhiyo e Polo,
An wendo kende Ok nasiki e pinyni.

Chorus:
A Ruoth, in to, in osiepna maber,
Kar dakwa ni kodi E Polo malo cha.
Malaika luonga Adhiyo e Polo;
An wendo kende, Ok nasiki e pinyni.

2. Jo ma nokwongona Rita abi kuno,
Ruoth Yesu nothona, En Jawarna mang'won.
Noweyo richona Notera e Polo,
An wendo kende Ok nasiki e pinyni.

3. Wanabedi e mer Mosiko nyaka chieng',
Ka waseloyo piny, Kuom yie remb Jawarwa;
Kwapako Nyasachwa Kuom herane maduong'.
An wendo kende Ok nasiki e pinyni.

title: Nyaka Wananomre
lyrics:
1. Nyaka wananomre duto te,
Ruoth oritu, puonju, konyu;
Ruaku te e kunde chutho;
Ruoth oritu nyaka e Polo.

Chorus:
Wananere te, wananere,
Wananere cha e tiend Yesu;
Wananere te, wananere,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e Polo.

2. Nyaka wananomre duto te;
Bade mond' oumu chutho,
Chiembu be opognu pile,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e Polo.

3. Nyaka wananere duto te;
Ka ukedo gi masiche,
Ruoth obedo gi nyithinde,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e Polo.

4. Nyaka wananere duto te;
Herane ni kuomwa koro,
Ruoth jageng'a lueny moloyo,
Ruoth oritu nyaka e Polo.

title: Wadhiuru Zayon
lyrics:
1. Biuru, un duto mohero Ruoth Yesu,
Wating'uru duondwa gi wer,
Wating'uru duondwa gi wer,
Kwapako ng'wonone, Kwapako ng'wonone.

Chorus:
Wadhiuru Zayon,
Ka maber malo e Polo,
Wadhiuru nyaka Zayon
En dala maber mar Nyasaye.

2. Jo makiya Nyasaye gi onge mor ka wan,
Nyithindo mag Ruoth me Polo,
Nyithindo mag Ruoth me Polo,
Lando wach herane, Lando wach herane.

3. Wan gi ber mar Zayon e chunywa koroni,
Kwamor kuom geno neno Ruoth,
Kwamor kuom geno neno Ruoth,
Kwatundo e Polo, Kwatundo e Polo.

4. Weruru gi chunyu, pakuru Ruoth Yesu,
Oloso kar dakwa malo,
Oloso kar dakwa malo,
Chieng' moro noomwa, chieng' moro noomwa.

title: An Jaketho Kende
lyrics:
1. An asebedo gi richo mathoth,
To koro aseruako Ruoth Yesu
Abedo mamor kuom ng'wonone,
Koro osewara, Jarwarna.

Chorus:
Ne alal chutho e richo,
To osewara gi ng'wono
An kor' apake kuom ng'wonone maduong
Mosemiya warruok e chunya.

2. Richo noloyo chunya ahinya,
Chunya nochayo weche mag Nyasaye
To Ruodha notho kuom richona,
Koro osewara, Jawarna.

3. Timna makare ne ok nyal wara,
Kuom yiena Ruodha nowaro chunya
Nogolona richona duto,
Koro osewara, Jawarna.

4. Analand wach warruokne maduong',
Ma aseyudo kuom yie Ruoth Yesu
Ahero Yesu nikech nothona,
Koro osewara, Jawarna.

title: Chieng' Mor Maduong'
lyrics:
1. Chieng' mor maduong' marahuma
Ka Yesu nofwenyorena.
Chunya no pong' gi mor maduong'
Machako hulo Nying Yesu.

Chorus:
Chieng' maduong', chieng' maduong'
Ka Yesu noluoko chunya.
Nopuonja mond' adag kuome,
Kotelona pile pile.
Chieng' maduong', chieng' maduong',
Ka Yesu noluoko chunya.

2. Koro wasekoyudore
An mar Yesu to En mara.
Naluwe pile kodi mor
Kahulo weche mag Nyasaye.

3. Chunya bed mokue kuom Yesu.
Yesu kende e mor chunya.
Koro chunya kik ibagni,
Luw Yesu tir En yoo adier.

4. Singruokna mokwongo e ma
Naluwi pile, Jawarna.
Nyaka chieng'no ma iniwir
Ka wananere wang' gi wang'.

title: Gope Richona Duto
lyrics:
1. Gope richona duto, Yesu osechulo
Kanotho kuoma e yath, kanyo nayudo ngima.

Chorus:
Gop richona te e yadh Kalwari
Yesu nochulogi te adong' ka an thuolo.

2. Ruoth Yesu koro wacho nyathina in miyom
Teko duto gi loch te yudore mana kuoma.

3. Ruoth adieri aneno teko mari kende
Emogolo dhohona mi apuodhora maler.

4. An ayie ni ok aler ageno ng'wononi
Ayie chutho kuom rembi moluoka abet maler.

5. Chieng' machopo e polo napodhi e tiendi
Anawer ma ok awe ni rembi oseluoka.

title: Keyo Nobed Nade?
lyrics:
1. Chwoyo kodhi odiechieng' maler,
Chwoyo kodhi e dier odiechieng' tir,
Chwoyo kodhi ka piny imore.
Chwoyo kodhi otieno mokwe
Oo, keyo nobed nade? Oo, keyo nobed nade?

Chorus:
Chwoyo e mudho, chwoyo kind' e ler,
Chwoyo gi nyawo, chwoyo gi teko,
Keyo e saa kata mochwere,
Adier, Adier, keyo nobedie.

2. Chwoyo kodhi e bethe yore,
Kothe mochwo ewi kite tho,
Bende mochwo e kuthe notho,
Ber chwoyo kodhi e lowo mayom,
Oo, keyo nobed nade? Oo, keyo nobed nade?

3. Chwoyo kodhi gi kinda pile,
Chwoyo kodhi gi paro matut,
Chwoyo kodhi gi kido marach,
Chwoyo kodhi makelo wichkuot?
Oo, keyo nobed nade? Oo, keyo nobed nade?

4. Chwoyo kodhi gi chunyi malit,
Chwoyo kodhi ka pi wang' ichwer,
Chwoyo kodhi kuom geno keyo.
Gini mor ka keyo nochopi.
Oo, keyo nobed nade? Oo, keyo nobed nade?

title: Dadhi e Nyim Jawar Yesu
lyrics:
1. Dadhi e nyim Jawar Yesu, gi lweta mani nono
Ka onge gima datigo kata gima damiye.

Chorus:
Dadhi e nyim Nyasaye Wuora ka onge gima dachiw
Kata mana ng'at achiel, ngang'. Dadhi kamano adier?

2. Kinde mathoth man' awito, dine aduogo ire.
Dine amiyo Jawarna be' dine atiyone.

3. In owadwa chiew kawuono, Ruoth Yesu pod oluongi
Bang' tho ok nibed gi thuolo mar tiyone Ruoth Yesu.

title: Winjuru Duond Ruodhwa
lyrics:
1. Winjuru duond Ruodhwa ka oluongou,
Jo-mool kendo man kod chandruok mathoth,
Bi-uru ire Yesu nomiu yueyo,
Nyalone noting'ni chandruokgi duto.

Chorus:
Bi tinende, nomiyi yueyo,
Ting' mar Ruodhwa Yesu, yot, yot miwuoro,
Ohore oluongi kod mwolo duto
Bi yud yueyo kuome, Bi tinendeni.

2. Ka chunyi osiko kod parruok pile?
Gi chich kodi luoro ngimani duto?
Wecheni go duto, bi go ir Yesu,
Koluongi tinende nomiyi yueyo.

3. Iselal e richo ngimani duto?
Onge yo machielo mar tony ae tho.
Resruok ni kuom Yesu, en kende eyo,
En monyalo wari kibiro ire.

4. In moyomno e wuoth, dak iwinj dwonde
En nomiyi teko kikwayo kuome,
Kendo kuom Nyalone nomiyi loyo,
Roho Maler nolor mar dak e chunyi.

title: Nitie Ngima e Msalaba
lyrics:
1. Nitie ngima e Msalaba
Yesu wacho, "Ng'iyauru:"
Mwandu mag piny gin gik makadho
Mwandu mosiko ni kuom Ruoth Yesu.

Chorus:
Kwang'iyo nitie ngima,
Kwang'iyo Msalaba,
Wayudo warruok madier,
Kwang'iyo Yesu Jawar.

2. Ka nang'iyo wang' Ruoth Yesu Jawar,
Nong'iyoa gi wang' mang'won,
Kendo ka temruok dwaro loya
Nayud teko kang'iyo wang' Yesu.

3. Nang'i wang' Yesu ndalona duto
Kageno singruok mar Nyasaye,
Satani ok onyalo loyo
Jogo mageno teko mar Roho.

title: Winjuru, Un Duto, Winjuru
lyrics:
1. Satani ohingo ji duto,
Un duto uhero Satani.
Ka Yesu notieko misango,
Notieko moromo ji duto.

Chorus:
Winjuru, un duto, winjuru,
Wakelonu wach maradier;
To Yesu notieko misango,
Notieko moromo ji duto.

2. Un bende umako gi fuwo,
Uhero gik moko maricho;
To Yesu nochulo gopwa,
Nochulo moromo ji duto.

3. Kuyie Jehova Nyasachwa,
Un bende utimo mohero;
Nyasaye e mooronwa Wuode,
En Yesu motho ni ji duto.

4. Winjuru, Nyasaye En mang'won,
Oluongowa mondo wabi.
Nyasachwa ohero gilala,
En bende oresowa duto.

title: Richona Diluok Gang'o?
lyrics:
1. Richona diluok gang'o?
Mana gi remb Yesu kende.
Chunya be diluok mapoth?
Mana gi remb Yesu kende.

Chorus:
Remo mar Yesu Ruoth,
Rembe luoka mapoth,
Onge moro kendo,
Remo mar Ruoth Yesu kende.

2. Onge ma dinyal luoka,
Remo mar Ruoth Yesu kende.
Onge tim ma di konya,
Remo mar Ruoth Yesu kende.

3. Mirimb Nyasaye dirum be?
Mana gi remb Yesu kende.
Dadonj e Polo ngang'o?
Mana gi remb Yesu kende.

title: Yesu Noseng'iewo Duto
lyrics:
1. Chon ka ne Yesu pok obiro chalo dhano,
Ji duto ok nohero ngima mar Nyasachwa mang'won;
Ne gidwaro gi piny moloyo weche Nyasaye
Ne gidwaro tichgi maricho moloyo tich Nyasaye.

Chorus:
Yesu noseng'iewo duto
Gi rembe maber.
Adwaro hero Yesu kende,
Adwaro chuny maler.

2. Wan bende ne wakwero Yesu, Jawarowa,
Ne watiyo tich mawa kende, ne ok wahero Nyasaye,
Hera mar Nyasaye Ruodhwa loyo hera duto
Odwaro waro jo maricho gi liswane maber.

3. Yesu nobiro thonwa duto e Kalwari;
Kawuono En e liswa marwa, En Jawarwa Maduong',
Nochier nowuok e bur gi teko mar Nyasachwa
Tinde odwaro miwa ngima, ngima ma nyaka chieng'.

4. Udagi Yesu Kristo nang'o? Oherou:
Odwaro luokou gi rembe, mondo omiu ngima.
Kuyie Yesu Kristo koro gi chuny maler,
Unumor gi Yesu e piny ka, unumor e Polo.

title: Yesu Notho Ni Ji Duto
lyrics:
1. Richo mawa onego wawe,
Kwadwaro donjo i Polo.
Wan wayie gi chunywa duto,
Wach Nyasaye marwa.

Chorus:
Yesu nothoni, Yesu nothona,
Yesu notho ni ji duto
Rembe mowarogi.

2. Kiti ji man e piny ka,
Ok olonwa gi moro,
Wan waluor, kibaji gowa,
Maricho mawa ng'eny.

3. Dak wang'iyo malo e Polo
Ka ma Ruodhwa nitie;
En ema nenochuweyo Polo,
Kodi piny duto be.

4. Yesu nothonwa e Yath,
Rembe e magolo richowa;
Wan wayie Wach mar Nyasaye
Gi chunywa duto te.

title: Winjuru Wach Injili
lyrics:
1. Winjuru Wach Injili, un piny duto gi nembe,
Weche mabeyo mag warruok Magi keloni kod an.
"Nyasaye nohero piny, kendo nochiwo Wuode,"
Ni ng'ama oyie kuome, noyud ngima mochwere.

Chorus:
Winjuru Injili Un piny duto gi nembe,
Winjuru Wach warruok En Warruok ni in kod an.

2. Winjuru Wach Injili, en Chiemo moselosnwa;
Kik ichayo luongno mar Ruoth, kata kwedo ng'uono ne.
"An e kuon mar ngima; chiemb chunjego modenyo,
Kata richoni kwar nade, gini bed matar ka pe."

3. Winjuru Wach Injili, kiyale kinde duto,
Ni kuom biro nigi duto modagi winjo wachno.
"Yie' tony ne ngimani; kik itamri winjo wach,
Kata kik item rango chien, Dipo ka piny omuonyi."

4. Winjuru Wach Injili, en Wach man gi mor maduong',
Gikelo weche mag ng'uono kuom Jawarwa ma nogur.
"Weche makelo mor ni ji duto te moyie,
Ni osenyuolonu Jawar, ma en Kristo kendo Ruoth."

title: Nachiwo Ngimana
lyrics:
1. Nachiwo ngimana, remba nochwer kuomi
Ni mondo owari e tho mar richoni;
Nachiwo ngimana kuomi, to in imiya ang'o?
Nachiwo ngimana kuomi, to in imiya ang'o?

2. Od Wuora man e Polo, gi kom duong' mar loch,
Naweyo ka nabiro, e piny ma nosanda;
Kuomi, kuomi naweyogi, ang'o miweyona?
Kuomi, kuomi naweyogi, ang'o miweyona?

3. Nachandora kuomi, moloyo paroni,
Ka nating'o richoni, nyaka natho e Yath,
Nachandora kama kuomi, ang'o miting'ona?
Nachandora kama kuomi, ang'o miting'ona?

4. Koro akeloni, gweth moa e Polo,
Weruok mar richo duto, warruok gi herana;
Akeloni mich madongo, to in imiya ang'o?
Akeloni mich madongo, to in imiya ang'o?

title: Teko Nitie E Remo
lyrics:
1. Di her yudo gonyruok kuom richoni?
Nitie teko e remb Ruodhwa.
Di her loyo temruok duto pile?
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

Chorus:
Teko nitie, teko e remo,
E remo mar Ruodhwa,
Teko nitie ma di waro ji,
Mageno remb Yesu Kristo.

2. Di her gonyruok kuom sunga gi mbaka?
Nitie teko kuom remb Ruodhwa.
Bi mondo oluoki e Kalwari,
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

3. Di her bet mapoth pile ka pile?
Nitie teko e remb Ruodhwa.
Richo duto nodunyo e remo,
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

4. Di her tiyoni Ruoth Yesu Kristo?
Nitie teko gene chutho,
Di her pako Yesu ndalo duto?
Nitie teko e remb Ruoth.

title: Ng'wono Maduong'
lyrics:
1. Ng'wono maduong' mar Ruoth Yesu
Oloyo richo gi kethowa,
Nochwero rembe e Kalwari,
Nyarombo Nyasaye e misango.

Chorus:
Ng'wono mar Ruoth,
Maweyo, maluoko richowa;
Ng'wono mar Ruoth,
Ng'wono magolo richo duto.

2. Richo ochalo ka apaka
Makuyo chuny gi rem maduong';
Ng'wono mar Nyasaye omiyowa
Kuwe kuom Yesu mothonwa e Yath.

3. Richo ok opondo ni Nyasaye,
Ere gi ma nopwodhe chutho?
Ne! Soko mar remb Yesu ochwer,
Onyalo luoki maler koro.

4. Onge ng'wono maromo gi ma,
Mochiwoni kuom yie Yesu;
In kidwaro nenori kode
Dak iyie ng'wonone koro?

title: Ahero Nyiso Weche
lyrics:
1. Ahero nyiso weche Moa kuom Nyasachwa;
Kuom Yesu gi duong'ne, Kaka noherowa.
Ahero nyiso weche Nikech gin adiera
Moromo chunya pile Moloyo duto te.

Chorus:
Ahero nyiso weche, Mobedo morna pile,
Kahulie weche adier Kuom hera mar Yesu.

2. Ahero nyiso weche, Ma wuoro ahinya,
Nikech pile kahulo Chunya omor chutho.
Ahero nyiso weche Ni ji ma pok omako,
Wechego kuom warruok Man e kitap Nyasaye.

3. Ahero nyiso weche Ni ji moseng'eyo
Ginyalo winjo kendo Mondo gidongogo.
Ka watundo e Polo Wanawer malong'o,
Weche ma wahero ka Kuom hera mar Yesu.

title: Biuru Duto Mowinjo
lyrics:
1. Biuru duto mowinjo.
Nitie Ruoth mang'won,
Kendo nomiyi yuweyo
Kiyie Wach Mare.
Yie kende, yie kende,
Yie kuom Yesu,
En owari, En owari,
Nowari koro.

2. Nikech Yesu nochwer rembe
Ogwedhowa koro.
Bi ire mondo oluoki
Eka nidok mapoth.
Bi ir Yesu, bi ir Yesu,
Koro bi ire,
En owari, En owari,
Nowari koro.

3. Yesu en e yo gi adier
Materowae Polo,
Yie kuome, kik ideki,
To bed gi hap Nyasaye.
Kik idagi, kik idagi,
Kik idag Yesu,
En owari, En owari,
Nowari koro.

4. Riwuru kawuono kodwa,
Wadhi e kar duong',
Wadag e pinyno maber ngang',
Kar mor ma nyaka chieng'.
An agene, an agene,
Ageno Yesu,
En owara, En owara,
Yesu owara.

title: Ruoth Ngimana
lyrics:
1. Ruoth ngimana, ayie ni
Mondo ilo chunya
Nimar paro kuomi pile,
Nyisa wach Kalwari.

Chorus:
Kik wiya wil Gethsemane
Gi sand ma niting'o kuoma.
Herani onego apar
Nyisa wach Kalwari.

2. Nyisa wach tho mar Ruoth Yesu,
Chunya to okuyo
Kuom tho niting'o richona
Ma notieko bura.

3. Ji moko nodhi e liende,
Ne giyudo wachni
Yesu nochier, noloyo tho,
Ongima kawuono.

4. An bende, Ruoth, mondo ayie,
Luwi kating'o yath
Kata ayudi sand kuomi
To niting'o duto.

title: Dak Irwak Yesu
lyrics:
1. Dak irwak Yesu e chunyi,
En ma noting'o richoni.
Odwong'o mondo odonji,
Dak iyiene koroni.

Chorus:
Mi Yesu kar bet e chunyi,
Winji oluongi koro.
Yawne chunyi mond' owari
Ka pod omiyi kinde.

2. In gi kinde kuom tich mathoth
Kod mor mag gik man e piny
En moheri ma nothoni;
Dak iwinje koluongi.

3. Koro e ndalo mowinjre,
Ka pod oluongi gi ng'wono.
Yaye, kik itamri koro
Di po kinde nokadhi.

title: Ok Nowara Gi Fedha
lyrics:
1. Ok nowara gi fedha kata dhahabu,
Mwandu duto mag piny ok dires chunya;
To remo ma nochwer e Yath e mowara:
Tho mar Yesu ma jawar e mokwoya.

Refrain:
Oseng'iewa to ok gi fedha;
Nong'iewa ok gi mwandu;
Nengo mar remo nong'iewago,
Nengo mar hera maduong'.

2. Ok nowara gi fedha kata dhahabu,
Bura mar richona noloyo gigo;
To remo ma nochwer e Yath e mowara,
Tho mar Yesu kende nogayo chunya.

3. Ok nowara gi fedha kata dhahabu,
Ketho chik maler e mogeng'a sudo
To remo ma nochwer e Yath e mowara:
Tho mar Yesu ogolo luoro kuoma.

4. Ok nowara gi fedha kata dhahabu,
Gigo ok dimi wadonjo e Polo:
To remo ma nochwer e Yath e mowara;
Tho mar Yesu Kristo nothego chunya.

title: Nabayo Chon Marach
lyrics:
1. Nabayo chon marach
Ka rombo ma nolal,
Nadagi winjo duond Jakwath,
Nadagi loch mang'won.
Nabayo chon marach,
Od Wuora ok nadwar.
Duond Wuora ok nahero ngang',
To bayo be nomit.

2. Jakwath nodwaroa,
To herane ne duong':
E thim gi gode to nodhi.
Ma an nabayoe.
Noyuda ku mabor
Machiegini gi tho,
Gi hera to noduogoa,
Noresa ka nalal.

3. Notwak koda mamit,
Noritoa mang'won
Nohoyo chunya ma noa,
Masicha mondo orum.
Noluoko richona,
Nomiya ler adier,
Notera mos e dalawa
Ma naseweyo chon.

4. To Yesu en Jakwath,
Owuon oheroa:
Gi rembe oseluokoa,
Ee, En mochangoa:
Nodwara ka nalal,
Nokwayoa mang'won,
Notera mos e kunde to
Kawuono orita.

5. Nabayo chon marach, Ka rombo ma nolal:
Kawuono to ahero duond, Jakwath, ahero kul,
Nabayo chon marach, To bayo be nomit.
Duond Wuora koro ahero, Ahero dalane.

title: Weche Mamit
lyrics:
1. Weruru weche Nyasaye, Wechene mar Ngima,
Somgiuru pile pile, Weche mamit maber,
To gi puonjowa niya, ni mond' wagen Yesu.

Refrain:
Weche mamit miwinjo ni, Wechene mar Ngima,
Weche mamit miwinjo ni, Weche mamit maber.

2. Yesu miyo ji duto te, Wechene mar Ngima,
Ji moketho winjuruwa, Weche mamit maber,
Yesu chiwo nono, gin to giyie kende.

3. Kik wamung' ni ji manie piny, Wechene mar Ngima,
To gin weche makonyogi, Weche mamit maber,
Yesu Ruoth ma Jawar nopwodhgi gi Wachne.

title: Onego Onyuolu
lyrics:
1. Jaduong' moro nobiro ir Yesu
Mond' openje yo mar donjo e Polo;
To Ruoth nodwoke, "Adieri onego
Onyuolu nyuol manyien."

Refrain:
Onego onyuolu
Nyuol manyien mar Nyasaye,
Adieri, adieri, onego uyud
Nyuol manyien mar Nyasaye.

2. Jo machwo gi mamon, winjuru weche
Ma Yesu nowacho gi adieri chutho;
Owachonu kama bende; onego
Onyuolu nyuol manyien.

3. Un duto madwaro donjo e Polo,
E yuweyo gi mor gi wer mar warru
Ngima ma nyaka chieng' niyudi ni
Nyuol manyien gi Roho.

4. Idwaro nenori gosiepe moko
Mosekwongoni dhi e Polo mariti?
Kamano yie kuom Yesu, kendo yud
Nyuol manyien gi Roho.

title: Isedhi Ir Yesu?
lyrics:
1. Isedhi ir Yesu Nyarombo Nyasaye,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer,
Kata kethruok dich e chunyi manade,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

Refrain:
Noluoki gi rembe,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer,
Kata kethruok dich e chunyi manade,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

2. Isedhi ir Yesu Kristo Jakonywa,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer;
Rembe e moromo mana ji duto,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

3. Isedhi ir Yesu Kristo Jagwedhwa,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer;
Enoyie ni mond' idonji e Polo,
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

4. Kethni duto ni mond' ihul ni Nyasaye,
Mond' oluoki gi remb Ruoth Yesu;
Mond' omii ngimane ma nyaka chieng',
Noluoki gi rembe mosechwer.

title: Jakwath Nokwayo Rombege
lyrics:
1.
Jakwath nokwayo rombege
Pier ochiko gochiko,
To achiel kuomgi nolalne,
Ma notimo piero apar.
Adier nolal e got moro,
Ne en ku mabor ma onge Jakwath.

2.
Rombe pier ochiko gochiko.
Ok oromi, yaye, Ruoth?
To en oruakoi gang'o
Kuom achiel mobayo yo?
To godno bende rach ngang',
Kik ichandori kamano, Ruoth.

3.
Rombega ne gidoko pier apar,
Ma nahero adiera.
Kat'achiel kuomgi olalna,
Ok dak ayie ngang',
Kata yo obet marach kama,
Adhina e thim manyo rombo.

4.
Ne onge ng'ato kat' achiel
Ma nong'eyo chandruokne;
Kamano e thim mak ojok ngang'
Nyak' owinjo duonde;
Nonwang'e koyuak koo! marach,
Ne en ka malich kodwaro tho.

5.
Jakwath noting'e mos komor,
Nodhigo dalane;
Nowacho ni wadgi niya:
"Moruru koro maber,
T'asenwang'o nyarombona
Ma yande olal e thim ku mabor."

6.
To Yesu yande omanyowa,
Nochandore e piny,
Notho ni rombege duto,
To rombege ni wan.
Malaika gimor ngang'
Ka gineno ng'a molokore.

title: Ng'iuru Nyarombo
lyrics:
1.
Kudwaro yudo gonyruok e richo,
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Nothonu e Yath mondo owaru;
Notho e Kalwari.

Refrain:
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
En kende e monyalo warou;
Ng'iuru Nyarombo.

2.
Satan kotemu mochando chunyu,
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Gi tekone nulo ndalo duto,
Notho e Kalwari.

3.
Chunyu kojok muneno yorni tek;
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Chunyu nomor kuparo herane,
Motho e Kalwari.

4.
E chand manadi kik uluor ngang',
Ng'iuru Nyarombo,
Yesu noritu ma ok noweu,
Notho e Kalwari.

title: Anadhi ka Yesu
lyrics:
1.
Anamor, ngang' ngang' kuom Yesu Jawarwa,
Nokelonwa ngima mak norum,
Anamor kuom geno momiya nono,
Nikech noherowa ahinya,

Refrain:
Anadhi ka Yesu nabed kode kucha,
Anawer achiel kuom Ruoth Yesu, Jawarwa,
Kuom rembe maluoko richo duto.

2.
Liswa Nyasaye ok ditim gi dhok gi diek;
To Yesu e moromowa.
Notimo misango moromo ji te,
Gi ringre owuon e Kalwari.

3.
Aseneno Satan wuondo ji mathoth,
Owuondo ji ni mach onge.
Chieng' moro gini yie puonjwa ne adier,
Ka gineno mach ma ok norum.

4.
Kitap Nyasaye onyisowa Wach adier,
Kuom richo man e chuny dhano,
Kwasomo wechene kendo luorogi,
Eka wana bedi gi Yesu.

title: Yesu, Jawarwa
lyrics:
1.
Yesu, Jawar, nobiro Bethlehem,
Koweyo duong'ne koruako kitwa,
Kuom man' awuoro apako Nyinge,
Nobiro warowa.
Nobiro warowa, nobiro warowa,
Kuom man' awuoro apako Nyinge,
Nobiro warowa.

2.
Yesu, Jawarwa, nodhi Kalwari,
Nochulo gopwa nogonyo chunya;
Kuom man' awuoro apako Nyinge,
Kotho kuom richowa.
Kotho kuom richowa, kotho kuom richowa,
Kuom man' awuoro apako Nyinge,
Kotho kuomwa, kuomwa.

3.
Yesu, Jawarwa, noluonga ire,
Kawuotho e yo marach mar mudho,
Noluonga aming'a gi ng'wonone,
Noluonga gi ng'wono.
Noluonga gi ng'wono, noluonga gi ng'wono,
Noluonga aming'a gi ng'wonone,
Noluonga gi ng'wono.

4.
Yesu, Jawarwa, enowir kendo,
Ma e genowa mamit malong'o,
Ananene kochung' e kor polo,
Kobiro omowa.
Kobiro omowa, kobiro omowa,
Ananene kochung' e kor polo,
Kobiro omowa.

title: Ng'iyo Ruoth Yesu
lyrics:
1.
Winjuru Wach mar Nyasaye, Halleluya.
Wach ngima moseelonwa
Kaka Ruodhwa nochiko, Halleluya.
Nyaka ng'iyo Ruoth Yesu Jawar.

Refrain:
Nyaka ing'i Ruoth Yesu,
King'iye niyud ngima.
Kaka Ruodhwa nochiko, Halleluya.
Ka ing'iye niyudi ngima.

2.
Wachno mar hera maduong', Halleluya
En kuom ogendini duto
Wach moa kuom Nyasaye, Halleluya
Yesu Wuode ema nokele.

3.
Wach mar ngima mochwere, Haleluya
Chunyi noyude ki yiere
King'iyo Yesu kende, Haleluya
En monyalo goloi e tho.

title: Iseikori?
lyrics:
1. Iseikori kuom biro Ruoth?
Osenyuoli nyuol manyien?
Noluoko chunyi
Miruakori gi law maler
Kirito duoke?
To in, iseikori koso?

Chorus:
Jariyo nobedi e kamirege,
Jariyo monindo mos e otieno,
Achiel nokaw kendo
Achiel nowe kodong' ka;
To in, iseikori koso?

2. Ee, arito biro mar Yesu,
Aseyudo nyuol manyien,
Rembe oluoka,
Moruaka gi law maler
Ma aseikora;
To in, iseikori koso?

title: Biuru Ire, Yesu
lyrics:
1. Biuru ire, Yesu Jakony,
Wechene ema onyisowa yo.
Yesu ochungo koro gi ka,
Kowacho, Biuru.

Chorus:
Wanamor to wanamor ngang',
Eka wanasiki gi Yesu:
Yesu Jakonywa oherowa,
Kendo nowarowa.

2. Yesu nowacho, Biuru ka,
Un joma ojony muting'o mapek,
To kik udeki, winjuru wach;
Ji duto to gibi.

3. Paruru kendo, En koro ka;
Winjuru duolno mar Ruodhwa maber.
Ochiko duto mondo gibi,
Nyithindo be gibi.

title: Galruok Kik Negi
lyrics:
1. Bi ir Ruoth Yesu koro, A eyor richo piyo
Chiw chunyi ni Ruoth Yesu. Galruok kik negi!
Machiegni nia e piny
Chunyi nodog ir Jachuech
Ing'eyo giko chiegni. Galruok kik negi!

Chorus:
Lal mar galruok lit.
Lal mar galruok duong'.
Inge'yo giko chiegni.
Galruok kik negi!

2. Kinde mag ng'uono rumo, Onge geno machielo
Ranga kech nolor chiengno, Galruok kik negi!
Kanichung' nyim buch Nyasaye,
Richo duto nofwenyre,
Jachien nochok jotichne, Galruok kik negi!

3. Owadwa wuog e galruok, Gol chunyi e mor Pinyni,
Tamruok winjo Wach Nyasaye, Galruok kik negi!
Ber duto mag Piny norum
Kachunyi wuok ae ringruok
Winj duond Nyasaye kawuono. Galruok kik negi!

title: Dhako Nomulo Riak Nangane
lyrics:
1. Dhako nomulo riak nangane,
Ka nodhine ling'ling',
E kind jo ma nodiyo Ruodhwa,
To nochange ling'ling'.

Chorus:
Ka'mulo riak nangane,
Ek' abiro chango,
To ma e saa mowinjore
Nimondo achangie.

2. Nodhine kokirini ahinya,
Chunye noparore,
To Yesu nowinjo ni tekone
Nosekowuok kuome.

3. Yesu nolokore mowachone,
"Nyarwa, dhiyo gi kwe
To mondo ing'e gi ma nochangi
En mana yieni."

title: En Luong' Maduong'
lyrics:
1. E luong maduong' maler ngang', luongoi e nyasi;
Un duto oluongou e nyasi mochwere,
Un duto man gi ting' mapek gi lit ei chunyu—
Kawuono oluongou Kristo nokaw ting'u.

Chorus:
Roho luongi, Bi. Ruoth luongi, Bi.
Ng'at mowinjo mondo Bi; Ka in gi riyo, Bi.
Kendo ng'atno mowinjo
Mond' obi okaw pi mar ngima nono.

2. Luongno maler mogwedhi! Winji kawuono, Bi;
Roho koro luongi. Ang'o momiy' ideko?
Ka chunyi odwaro jok, to ber igen Yesu,
To yie luongne e chunyi, chopi e nyasino.

3. Duonde oluongi kendo, landi gwethno maler;
Kik ng'ato kwed ng'uonone kata otamre yie.
En Yesu ema luongo. Oseiko duto—
Roho Maler notelni. Ruoth biro ruakoi.

title: Winji Jawarni e Dhoot
Biuru Wadhiuru
lyrics:
1. Biuru wadhiuru e pinyno maber,
Pacho maber ngang'; jo maler dak kuno;
Weuru un mohero gi piny maricho.
Winjuru, lokreuru, udhi kodwa.

Chorus:
Dak ubi? Dak ubi?
Dak ubi? Dak ubi?
Yieuru duto mondo ubi kodwa.

2. Onge jo machandore ka donj' e polo,
Ok giniwinji tuo kata tho, ngang',
Gidak gi Nyasaye e momiyo gin gimor.
Winjuru, lokreuru, udhi kodwa.

3. Weuru hero gik ma ni e piny maka,
Ok gikonyowa; girumo ma piyo,
Heruru gik me polo mosiko pile,
Winjuru, lokreuru, udhi kodwa.

4. Ji duto chandore nikech richo me piny.
Kwa yie Yesu eno luoko chunywa.
Biuru ir Yesu ma nothonwa e Yath.
Winjuru, lokreuru, udhi kodwa.

title: Yesu Oluongoi
lyrics:
1. Yesu oluongoi mondo ibi,
Oluongoi kawuononi,
Nikech oneno kibayo marach,
Kidhiyo mabor kode.

Chorus:
Oluongoi, Oluongoi,
Yesu oluongi,
Oluongi kawuono ibi.

2. Yesu oluongo jo mool giyuwe,
Oluongou kawuononi;
Kelne ting' duto machandi pile,
En ok noriembi kodgi.

3. Yesu oriti—bi ire tinde:
Oritoi kawuononi;
Bi ire, nyise richoni duto;
Reti, to kik ideki.

4. Yesu osayo—dak iwinj dwonde;
Yie winj dwonde, kawuononi;
Jogo moyie Nyinge giniyud mor,
Chungi, dhi ire piyo.

title: Ang'o Ma Digeng'i?
lyrics:
1. Ang'o ma digeng'i kuom Yesu,
Ang'o ma geng'i bi ire?
Nong'wononi kendo noheri,
Nyiso Yesu gi motami.

Chorus:
Ang'o ma digeng'i kuom Yesu?
Onyalo wari kendo riti,
Nothoni e Yath mar Kalwari.
Ang'o momiyo ideko?

2. Ka hera mar gik moko mag piny
Otami kuom yie Yesu,
Mor piny obiro kadho piyo,
To mor mar Yesu osiko.

3. Duto machandore e piny ka,
Dhiuru ka Yesu koro.
Onyalo warou tinende,
Lamo En gi yie Kende.

4. Ji duto moyie kuom Yesu,
Kik lal to obedi gi mor,
Giyudo ngima mak rum kuome,
Udagi herane nang'o?

title: Chunya Ma Onge
lyrics:
1. Chunya ma onge kod winjruok,
To mana rembi mosechwer,
Mi koro iluonga abi,
Ee, koro Yesu, abiro.

2. Chunya ochando ng'wononi,
Kuom golo richona duto,
Rembi kende e moluoka,
Abiro ni, Yesu, koro.

3. Gi chuny mayom ma ok ikwer,
Ruaki kendo los maler,
Nikech singruok mari ayie,
To koro, Yesu, abiro.

4. Gi chuny ma herani yawo,
Mogolo tamruok duto te,
Mond' abedi ng'ati kende
Abiro ni, Yesu, koro.

title: Rombe Molal
lyrics:
1. Adwaro manyo rombe mobayo
Akelgi ir Yesu Jakwath
Anyisgi weche kaka owacho
"Biuru ira, aherou."

Chorus:
Adwaro dhiyo mond' amanygi
Rombe molal manobayo
Mondo gidonj e kund Jawarwa
Yesu Nyarombo manotho.

2. Adwaro manyo rombe mobayo
Mondo anyisgi Yesu Jakwath
Mondo akelgi duto giyudi
Ngima Mochwere manosingnwa.

3. Mano e tich ma adwaro timo
Awinjo luong ni mond' atine
Mondo achung' rombe mosepodho
Akelgi ir Jakwadhwa maber.

title: Ji Duto Nolal E Mudho
lyrics:
1. Ji duto nolal e mudho mar richo,
To ler mar pinyni en Yesu.
Lerne noserienywa gi duong' mar Nyasaye,
To ler mar pinyni en Yesu.

Chorus:
Asayou biuru e ler,
Oserienyna, ma koro amor,
Ne an mwofu, koro aneno;
Nikech ler mar piny en Yesu.

2. Mudho onge kuom jo ma ni e Yesu,
To ler mar pinyni en Yesu.
Kwaluwe wanawuothi e ler bende
Nikech ler mar piny en Yesu.

3. In ma pod idak e mudho mar richo,
Ng'e ni ler mar piny en Yesu.
Yie mond' oluoki gi rembe ma nochwer,
Nikech ler mar piny en Yesu.

4. Wang' chieng' ok norieny e dala mar Nyasaye
Yesu nobedi ler kuno.
Nikech duong' mar Nyasaye norienyie pile,
Yesu ma Nyarombo en ler.

title: Nadhi Eote Ni Duto
lyrics:
1. Kata ok ewi gode malo, kata loka machielo,
Kata ok ei kind lweny mager, noora kamachielo,
Koora gi duol mamos machil, e gwengego makia
Nakwa lwete omak lwetena, kotelo e tich madhie.

Chorus:
Nadhi eote ni duto Ruodha;
E gode, pewe, loka nam,
Nawuoth eyori gi chunya duto,
Nawach wecheni mimiya.

2. Dipo tinende wach mar ng'wono, ma Ruoth didwar mond' ahul,
Dipo nitie ng'ato e richo, ma Ruoth ora alosgo,
Ka in Jawar e mitelona, e mudho kat' e ler
Dhoga nohul wachni mangima na wache kaka imiya.

3. E gweng' moro manie mudho, ma onge gi jayalo.
Ngima machiek ma an go e Piny, aland wach Yesu Jawar.
Kachiwo ngimana kuomi Ruoth, katimo dwaroni,
Na tim dwaroni gi chuny mamuol. Nabedi kaka idwaro.

title: Koro Winji Duond
lyrics:
1. Koro winji duond Jakwadhwa,
E thim mar mudho ku mabor.
Koluongo rombe moselal,
Ma dhi mabor kod Jakwadhwa.

Chorus:
Kelg' ire, kelg' ire,
Kelgi ire a e yo marach,
Kelg' ire, kelg' ire,
Kel jo moruenyo ir Yesu.

2. Ng'a modhi konyo Jakwadhwa,
Konye yudo jo moselal?
Ng'a ma nodhi kelgi ire,
Ka ma giniyud e konyruok?

3. E mudho winji ka giyuak,
Oko e got mabor ngang' ngang';
Winji duond Ruoth kowachoni,
"Dhi dwar rombe kama gilal."

title: Wach Nyasaye e Ma Kelonu
lyrics:
1. An wendo e piny ka, dalawa bet mabor,
E piny mar polo cha, kar dak maber chutho:
Koro an jaote mar Ruoth Yesu Kristo,
Nowara mondo atine.

title: Dwaruru Joma Molal
lyrics:
1. Dwaruru jo molal, jo ma ni e tho;
Kod ng'wono golgiuru e richo.
Gi hera maduong', chung jo mopodho,
Nyisgi Yesu manyalo warogi.

Chorus:
Dwaruru jo molal, jo ma ni e tho
Yesu ni kod ng'wono ma diwargi.

2. Kata gisekwere, pod oritogi,
Ka gilokore enoruakgi.
Sagi mondo gibi, jiwgi gi muolo;
Yesu oweyo richo kuom yie.

3. Satani owuondo chuny jo maricho;
To Yesu ema nyalo resogi.
Osebiro dwaro jo ma noruenyo,
Mondo okelgi e mor mar Nyasaye.

4. Dwaruru jo molal; osechikowa,
Kendo Ruoth nomii teko pile.
Kelgi e yo madiny, yuwagi gi kinda,
Nyisgi kuom Yesu mosethonigi.

title: Landuru Wach Nyasaye
lyrics:
1. Winjruru luong moanwa gi ku mabor,
"Omnwa ler, omnwa ler."
Onego wadhi reso jo ma nolal;
Kwalando Wechene.

Chorus:
Landuru Wach Yesu ma Jawar,
Lerne mond' orieny e piny,
Landuru Wach Yesu ma Jawar,
Lerne mond' orieny ni ji.

2. Wasewinjo kaka ikwayo kama,
"Bi loka, ikonywa."
Wanachiwore ni Yesu ngimawa,
Kwalando Wechene.

3. Wanalam mondo ng'wono omedrenwa;
Kwalando Wechene,
Hera mar Yesu ojiwowa pile,
Kwalando Wechene.

4. Kik wajony kwatiyo ni Ruodhwa Yesu,
Kwalando Wechene.
Wakano mwandu e Polo kuom Yesu,
Kwalando Wechene.

title: Wan Gi Weche Kuom Ji Duto
lyrics:
1. Wan gi weche kuom ji duto mag piny
Ma ka giyie ginikuwo;
Weche mamit kod adieri
Mokelo kuwe kendo ler,
Mokelo kuwe kendo ler.

Chorus:
Nikech noloknigi mudho chieng',
Kendo chieng' norienynigi,
Mi pinyruoth Kristo nobi kuomwa,
Pinyruodh mar hera kod ler.

2. Wan gi wer mwawero ni ji duto
Ma noyuwa chunygi kuom Yesu;
Monyiso ni rembe nochwer
Nogayowa kod Nyasaye,
Nogayowa kod Nyasaye.

3. Wan gi puonj kuom dhout pinje duto
Kaka Ruoth ma ni e Polo,
Nochiwo Wuode owarwa,
Monyisowa herane:
Monyisowa herane.

4. Wan gi Jawar ma dwanyis ji duto
Mosetho nikech richowa
Mondo ji mag pinje duto
Ging'e Nyasaye mar adier,
Ging'e Nyasaye mar adier.

title: Wasewinjo Wach Maber
lyrics:
1. Wasewinjo wach maber, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
To keuru wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Landuru e pinje te, puonjruru ji wach maber,
Ruodhwa e ma chikowa, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

2. Weruru pile pile, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Ne otho kendo nochier, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Weruru ni ji matuo, ka gidwaro hewore,
Weruru e kar liete, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

3. Chon wakiya wechegi, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Koro wan ti wamor ngang', Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Chon wadak e mudho ka, ti waneno ler Nyasaye
E momiyo mudho tur, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

4. Yaluru e piny ma ka, Yesu ni Jawarwa;
Yaluru e pinje te, Yesu ni Jawarwa.
Kik wadeki, kik waling', nyaka Yesu oduogi,
Nyaka ji duto ong'e, Yesu ni Jawarwa.

title: Weruru Wach Ruoth Yesu
lyrics:
1. Weruru wach Ruoth Yesu,
Odwaro jo maricho
Mobayo e yoregi
Mond' ores jo ma nolal.

Chorus:
Weruru pile pile
Kristo dwaro jo molal,
Huluru wach malong'o
Kristo ruako jo molal.

2. Nwang'uru yweyo kuome,
Gene chuth, Wachne adier,
Oyie ruako ji duto
Modwaro warruok kuome.

3. Bura ok nolo chunya,
Oketa kare kuom yie,
Rembe noluoka maler,
Noweyona richona.

4. Kristo oyie ruako ji,
Bi ire gi richoni,
Nowari mi nidonji
E ngima gi mor chutho.

title: Chwoyo Ndalo Duto
lyrics:
1. Chwoyo ndalo duto, chwoyo koth Injili,
Chwoyo wach adiera nyaka chieng' watho.
Keyo e mabiro, piny ochiek gilala,
Wanamor ahinya, wanamor maber.

Chorus:
Keyo biro wuok, Keyo biro wuok,
Wanamor gilala, Keyo biro wuok.
Keyo biro wuok, Keyo biro wuok,
Wanamor gilala, Keyo biro wuok.

2. Chwoyo pinje duto, kata tek ahinya,
Yesu e mochiko to wadhi koro:
Wan gi kinde tinde, kik wanindi koro,
Ende wadhiuru chwoyo wach maber.

3. Kata en Satani, en mawuondo nono,
En mamayo chutho jo madagi wach;
To wachwo gi kinda, wanatim sinani,
Keyo biro chopo, wanamor maber.

title: Chieng' Ma Yesu Nobi
lyrics:
1. Chieng' ma Yesu nobi omo joge
Kata en saa manadi,
Doyudwa ka jokinda morite
Ka techewa liel maber?

Chorus:
Wan, waseikore adier koso?
Mar dhi e polo malo?
Doyudwa ka warite gi kinda
Riti, riti nyaka Ruoth obi.

2. Dipo kobiro saa mar okinyi
Noluongwa achiel achiel
Mi wanamiye talanta marwa
Dowachni "Ber, jatichna?"

3. Wan wasebedo gadieri koso
Ka watiyo makare?
Nomi joge ma jokinda mwandu
Ma nosiki nyaka chieng'.

4. Gin johawi ma nonwang' karite,
Ginidonji e duong'ne;
Dipo ka Ruodhwa nobi tinende
Doyudwa ka warite?

title: Chieng' ma Tung' mar Nyasachwa
lyrics:
1. Chieng' ma tung' mar Nyasachwa noyuagi e ndalo giko,
Chieng'no e ma piny noyawre nyaka chieng'.
Chieng'no jomowar nochokre e dho wadh aoch ngima
Ka iluongo nying jomaler, nabedie.

Chorus:
Ka iluongo jom' olocho,
Ka iluongo jom' olocho,
Ka iluongo jom' olocho,
Ka iluongo jom' olocho, nabedie.

2. Chieng'no joma nosetho kogeno kuom Ruodhwa Yesu,
Gini chier e duong'ne maler ndalono.
Chieng'no joge mose yier ginichokre e dalano,
Ka iluongo nying jomaler, nabedie.

3. Watiuru gi kinda e kindewa ndalo duto.
Walanduru herane kuonde duto,
Eka chieng'no mangima ogik kendo tichne norum.
Ka iluongo nying jomaler, nabedie.

title: Biro Yesu Chalo Koda Mil Polo
lyrics:
1. Biro Yesu chalo kaka mil Polo kodi mach,
Biro Yesu enobed malich ngang'!
Biro Yesu enobed malich ngang' miwuoro!
Biro Yesu chalo koda mil Polo.
Polo mor piny lich, piny lich!
Biro Yesu enobed malich ngang'!
Polo mor piny lich, piny lich!
Biro Yesu chalo koda mil Polo!

2. Wan duto askeche mag Yesu oluongowa,
Dak ubi udeko nang'owa?
Piny otuk makuru gi lwenje dhi ukedi,
Wanarom kode e kor polo.
Chunguru wadhiyo urito ang'o?
Wanarom kode e kor Polo.
Chunguru wadhiyo urito ang'o?
Wanarom kode e kor Polo.

3. Thumbe mag dhahabu ywak kuno e dalano,
Mor maduong' nobedie chieng'ono!
Malaika duto lor gi teko kod abu,
Kagiwer gi duol achiel kor Polo.
Giwer mamit thumbe ywak, thumbe ywak,
Wanarom kode e kor Polo
Giwer mamit thumbe ywak, thumbe ywak,
Wanarom kode e kor Polo.

4. Pinywani ibiro ban, pinywani norum te,
Satan to enodong' e mudho.
En nogomb ng'ato moro monyalo wuondo to
Ok noyud kata ng'ato achiel.
Chunguru wadhiyo urito ang'o?
Satan enodong' e mudho.
Chunguru wadhiyo urito ang'o?
Satan enodong' e mudho.

title: Dibed Okinyi Mit Yesu Dibi
lyrics:
1. Dibed okinyi, ka piny oyaworenwa,
Ka chieng' pilore kendo ler biro e piny,
Mit Yesu dibi gi duong' maler chutho
Mondo oom joge moyie.

Chorus:
Nyaka karang'o, Ruoth Yesu,
Ma wanawer wendni? Kristo wiro,
Haleluya! haleluya! Amen.
Haleluya! Amen.

2. Dibed odiechieng' kata ka piny imore,
Kata odiewuor kod e mudho mandiwa,
Mit ler kaka chieng' dirieny gi duong'ne,
Ka Yesu noom joge.

3. Noa e Polo kolor gi duond malaika,
Kokelo joge ma yande nindo kuome,
To wananene kobiro gi duong'ne
Koomo joge moyie.

4. A! mor gi ilo! ka noterwa mak watho,
Tuo noonge gi yuak ok nobedie,
Noterwa malo e boche polo kar mor,
Ka Yesu noom joge.

title: Yesu Nowir!
lyrics:
1. Yesu e nowir! wer wechego,
Nobi noom joge mosereso,
Obiro loyo ka Ruoth Malong'o
Yesu e nowir kendo.

Chorus:
Yesu e nowir, e nowir kendo,
Yesu e nowir kendo,
Landuru weche e gwenge duto,
Yesu e nowir kendo.

2. Yesu nowir, jo motho nochier,
Osiepe nogudore kany' achiel,
Ka giromo kode e kor Polo,
Yesu e nowir kendo.

3. Yesu nowir kogonyo joge,
Kokelo mirembe e piny duto,
Richo gi kuyo gi remo norum,
Yesu e nowir kendo.

4. Yesu nowir, singruokne adier,
Jo moyier jokinda kata ginok,
Ka girite, ginone gi kinda,
Yesu e noom gi te.

title: Welo Mag Piny
lyrics:
1. Welo mag piny, ting'uru wiu,
Ndalo biro murito pile;
Gik mwawinjo nyisowa niya
Chieng' neno Jawarwa koro chiegni.

Chorus:
Yesu nowir kendo, Yesu nowir kendo,
Jal ma ji nokwero ka ne En e piny.
Yesu nowir kendo, Yesu nowir kendo,
Gi teko gi duong', Yesu nowir kendo.

2. Piny otimo mudho ahinya,
Tim mar richo omedore ka;
To okinyi ler oyawore,
Kamano wang'eyo, Ruoth nobi kendo.

3. Geno maber, singruok maduong',
Momiyowa mor ma ok norum.
Ka warito nenore kode
Chunywa pwodhore, kendo bedo maler.

4. Bi, Ruoth Yesu, In e mwageni,
Ka giduto mochweyo ochur,
Ka warito warruok mar pinyni
Kiterowa e Polo, nwasik kodi.

title: Para Chieng' Kiduogo
lyrics:
1. Ka Yesu nen' ogur gi jokwoge moko.
Jal moro no yanye, machielo no ywage.

Chorus:
Para chieng' kiduogo
Para kiwir e piny.
Para mond' adonji
E paradis maler.

2. To Yesu no yiene, adier tini donji,
E paradis maler, kama kuyo onge.

3. To jal machielo cha, ne ok odewo ma;
Ne ok olokore, motho girichone.

4. Adwaro lokora, ka jal machielo cha
En nen' olokore, moyudo kuwe maber.

5. Odwaro ji duto mondo gi lokore
To in kilokori ni bedi gi Yesu.

title: Yesu Terwa Dala
lyrics:
1. Yesu Mawuod Nyasaye asayi Ruodha yie kik iweya e piny marach,
Pinyno misekolosone jogo duto misekowaro e richogi.

Chorus:
(Terwa e dalano) en dala Jerusalem
(Ruoth terwa e dalano) en dala Jerusalem
Mondo ikawa iterae Polo adhi adagie manyaka chieng'. X2

2. Kristo Mawuod Nyasaye yie mond' iomwa iterwa dala miikonwa,
Dala mawana werie gi malaika kawawero Haleluya.

3. Yaye In migalori e timbe pinyni yiene Yesu Ruoth mond' owari,
Pinyni mawuondi nono to biro kadho mach biro wang'i chieng' giko piny.

title: Yesu Biro Kelo Bura
lyrics:
1. Yesu biro kelo bura, Obiro kelo bura ni piny
Piny orito bura nogo mabiro fwenyo joricho te.

Chorus:
Chieng' moduogo, polo gi pinyni,
Duto noring wang'e kolorie piny,
Jogo mosetho gi jo mangima,
Duto gibiro chung'e nyim Jayalo Maduong'.

2. Bura biro loyo pinyni; Gi jogo duto mane luwe
Obiro kelo bura nogo, ni jogo duto modagi yie.

3. Richo okelo bura nogo; Richo omiyo piny okuyo!
Omiyo jogo manodonji e Polo ginibed jomanok.

4. Bura nogo nolo Satan, gi malaika maneluwe
Obiro bolo jaduong' Satan e mach mosiko manyaka chieng'!

5. Yesu kelo ngima nono, obiro miyo jogo moyie
Obiro riembo joma nyinggi ok noyudie Kitap Ngima.

6. Jomoloyo bura nogo; gibiro yudo osimb Ngima.
Gini wer gi malaika e Polo malo manyaka chieng'.

title: Chunguru Kuom Adieri
lyrics:
1. Chunguru kuom adieri, mak chik mar Nyasaye,
Jokinda e mipako ka jonabi machon.

Chorus:
Bed jachir ka Daniel, kata in kendi
Chung matek kuom wach adier, Hul maber pile.

2. Bed matek ka ok iluor Hulo kuom Nyasaye;
Jo-Kristo nobed mang'eny kwabedo jokinda.

3. Jo me piny ok diyuwawa kwachungo matek.
Yesu e moherowa, En e mokonyowa.

4. Bed gi Wach Nyasaye pile Ek' ilo richo,
Tam Satani gi lamo Kigeno Ruoth Yesu.

title: Wan Nyithindo
lyrics:
1. Wan nyithindo, matindo ahinya, ngang'
To wanyalo mako weche mag Ruodhwa,

Chorus:
Ka wadware pile nyaka gokinyi,
Wanabed osiepene, kaka owacho.

2. Osiepe mag Yesu, gi mor ahinya;
Singruok mare nie kitape maler

3. Osiepe mag Yesu owuotho godo
Pile ndalo duto, kuonde modhiye,

4. Ka wahere tinde gi chunywa duto,
Wanabedi kode e Polo malo.

title: Tacha kuom Ruoth Yesu
lyrics:
1. Tacha kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Onego orienyne.
Tacha kuom Ruoth Yesu,
Onego orienyne,
Orienyne, orienyne, orienyne.

2. Pand' e bwo atonga?
Onego orienyne.
Pand' e bwo atonga?
Onego orienyne,
Orienyne, orienyne, orienyne.

3. Kik Satan neg tachi,
To orieny pile.
Kik Satan neg tachi,
To orieny pile.
Rieny pile, rieny pile, rieny pile.

4. Rieny e kuonde duto,
Adwaro mond' orieny.
Rieny e kuonde duto,
Adwaro mond' orieny,
Mond' orieny, mond' orieny, mond' orieny.

title: Pakeuru, Un Nyithindo Duto
lyrics:
1. Pakeuru, un nyithindo duto,
En hera, En hera.
Pakeuru, un nyithindo duto,
En hera, En hera.

2. Hereuru, un nyithindo duto,
En hera, En hera.
Hereuru, un nyithindo duto,
En hera, En hera.

3. Luweuru, un nyithindo duto,
En hera, En hera.
Luweuru, un nyithindo duto,
En hera, En hera.

4. Un nyithindo, ruak Yesu e chunyu,
En hera, En hera.
Un nyithindo, ruak Yesu e chunyu,
En hera, En hera.

title: Luetega
lyrics:
1. Luetega noti tich mar Yesu,
Lewa bende nahulego.
Itega nowinj puonjne kende,
Gi dwonda napaki Kristo.

Chorus:
Wabiro, wabiro,
Ni Yesu ma Ruodh nyithindo.
Wabiro, wabiro,
En oherowa.

2. Nomiya tiendega ariyogi
Mondo awuoth e yo maber;
Wenge mabeyo ango bende,
Nasom wachne ndalo duto.

3. Kendo Yesu Kristo ma Jawarwa
Odwaro chunya tinende;
Berna katimo tichne pile,
Ber kamiye ringra chutho.

title: Yesu 'Biro
lyrics:
1. Yesu 'biro, Yesu 'biro,
Ni mond' ochok joge,
Joge duto, joge duto,
Moseyie En.

Chorus:
Kaka sulwe me Polo
Mineno gotieno,
Ginibedi gi Yesu
E Polo maler.

2. Enochokgi, enochokgi,
Nyithinde malong'o;
Jo mabeyo, jo mabeyo,
Moseyie En.

3. Wan nyithinde, wan nyithinde,
Mohero Jawarwa,
Enoomwa, enoomwa,
Wanadag kode.

title: Yesu Ohera
lyrics:
1. Yesu hera, ang'eyo,
En nowachonwa ka ma;
Wan nyithindo en odwar,
Mondo en okonyowa.

Chorus:
Yesu ohera, Yesu ohera,
Yesu ohera,
Nowachonwa kama.

2. Yesu hera; en motho,
Yawo dho rangach Polo;
Ogolo richo maga,
En oyiena donj ire.

3. Yesu hera, en odong'
Koda nyaka chieng' atho;
Ka ahere kinde piny,
En notera dalane.

title: Mond Salem
lyrics:
1. Mond Salem nokelo nyithindgi ir Ruoth Yesu,
Jopuonjore mager noriembo gi dhi mabor;
To Yesu ka noneno gi. Gi wang' mamor noluongo gi
"Weuru nyithindo mond' obi ira."

2. "An abiro ruako gi duto kama antie
Nabed Jakwadh gi rombe go to kik uriembgi
Ka chuny gi duto gi miya, gini dag koda e polo
"Weuru nyithindo mond' obi ira."

3. En ng'uono mar Jawar kuom ruako nyithindo go!
Nyithindo mathoth mapok owinjo nying Yesu.
Wechene pok gi somo chuth. Ok gi ng'eyo wach Jawarwa.
"Weuru nyithindo mond' obi ira."

4. Machiegni joricho moa e pinje duto
Molokore moruako Wach, Nyasaye mangima;
Nyasaye man malo enorieny, Nyasach hera man gi ng'wono.
Nyis nyithindo duto gi bi ir Yesu.

title: Yesu Ohero Nyithindo Duto
lyrics:
1. Yesu luongo nyithindo, odwaro gibi ire,
Ohero nyithindo duto manie piny;
Odwaro golo richo mondo waluwe gi yie;
Ohero nyithindo duto, duto te.

Chorus:
Yesu her nyithindo duto,
Man e pinje duto te;
Wasungu gi Ratenge,
Gi Wahindi gi duto,
Odwaro nyithindo duto, duto te.

2. En Jakwath mag nyithindo, En oritogi pile;
Ohero nyithindo duto manie piny,
En Jakony man gi teko ogolo nwaricho te,
Odwaro nyithindo duto, duto te.

3. Yesu Ruoth, e motelo waluwe ndalo duto,
Omiwa ng'wono mare ndalo duto,
Wawe richowa, duto kendo wagene pile,
Ohero nyithindo duto, duto te.

title: Amor Nikech Wuonwa
lyrics:
1. Amor nikech Wuonwa ni e Polo
Onyiswa herane e Kitape,
Weche madongo apuonjorago
To maloyo ni Yesu ohera.

Chorus:
Amor nikech Yesu ohera,
En ohera, En ohera,
Amor nikech Yesu ohera,
Ohera an bende.

2. Yesu ohera koro ahere,
Nobiro e piny mondo owara.
Nikech ng'wonone nothona e Yath,
Ang'eyo Yesu ohera adier.

3. Ageno kuom Yesu pilepile.
Nomiya hawi mare kuom yie.
Satani ok onyal loya gi tem,
Remo mar Yesu owara chutho.

4. Ndalo moro anawer e Polo.
Ka'dhi romo kod Jawarwa kuno,
To anawer wer mamit nyaka chieng'
Nikech hera maduong' mar Yesu.

title: Ahero Winjo Weche
lyrics:
1. Ahero winjo weche
Moa kuom Nyasachwa,
Kaka Ruodhwa maduong'
Nodak e piny ka chon.
Kata an nyathi kende
Ang'eyo ni adier:
Nobiro mond' owara
Nikech oheroa.

2. Amor nikech Jawarna
Nodak e piny ka an,
Nonyiso wan nyithindo
Kaka dwapuonjore.
Ka luwo bang'e pile
Gi yie e chunya.
Yesu ok onyal weya
Nikech oheroa.

3. Koro apako Nyinge
Gi wer mamit maber,
Ok anene gi wang'a,
To Yesu ong'eya,
Ndalo moro notera
E Polo, anawer
Kod jomalaika kuno
Kuom hera mar Yesu.

title: Yesu Kotaya Pile
lyrics:
1. Yesu kotaya pile,
Oritowa mang'won;
Ani kabedo bute,
Onge gi manyalo luor.
Winji, machalo duonde
Malaika mawero,
Weche mabiro ira,
Weche mamiya mor.

Chorus:
Yesu kotaya pile,
Oritoa mang'won;
Ani kabedo bute,
Onge gi manyalo luor.

2. Yesu kotaya pile,
Ok anaparora;
Piny ok onyalo teroa,
Kata richo kethoa;
Kata aparo ndalo,
Ok naluor gi moro;
Kata ane masira,
Chieng' anamor kuno.

3. An anadhi ka Yesu,
En ma notho kuoma;
Pile ageno Yesu,
Luandana mageng'ona.
Piny pod otimo mudho
Ka pod awuotho ka;
Piny to norumo piyo,
Eka nadhi kuno.

title: Un Jowuoth
lyrics:
1. Un jowuoth to udhi kanye, Un maneno nyima ka?
Wan wadhiyo odi Ruodhwa, Wan wawuotho ku mabor.
Wan wadhiyo ku mabor cha, Wan wadhi ka piny moloyo,
Wan wadhi e piny mar Ruodhwa, Piny moloyo piny ma ka,
Wan wadhi e piny mar Ruodhwa, Piny moloyo piny ma ka.

2. Nyiswa gi mudwaro yudo. Kusetundo piny maber.
Wanayudi gik maloyo, Yesu madhi miyowa.
Wanane Jakonywa kucha, Gi Nyasaye, to wanabedi,
Nyaka chieng' to wanasiki, Kwasetundo piny maber:
Nyaka chieng' to wanasiki, Kwasetundo piny maber.

3. Un jowuoth to un uyie, Mondo wan wadhi kodu?
Ee biuru, kik udeki, Mond' udhi kaachiel gi wan.
Un ubi, to kik uwewa, Yesu e moruako duto.
En oyie mondo udonji, Mond' usiki piny maber.
En oyie mondo udonji, Mond' usiki piny maber.

title: Bi Ir Yesu
lyrics:
1. Bi ir Yesu, bi ir Yesu,
Bi ir Yesu koro; koro bi ir Yesu,
Bi ir Yesu koro.

2. En Jakonyi, En Jakonyi,
En Jakonyi koro; koro En Jakonyi,
En Jakonyi koro.

3. En gi teko, En gi teko,
En gi teko koro; koro En gi teko,
En gi teko koro.

4. Ka idwaro, Ka idwaro,
Ka idwaro koro; koro ka idwaro,
Ka idwaro koro.

5. Saye koro, Saye koro,
Saye koro Yesu; Yesu saye koro,
Saye koro Yesu.

6. En owinji, En owinji,
En owinji koro; koro En owinji,
En owinji koro.

7. En oluoki, En oluoki,
En oluoki koro; koro En oluoki,
En oluoki koro.

8. Yie kende, Yie kende,
Yie kende koro; koro yie kende,
Yie kende koro.

title: Nitie Piny Maber
Chik Apar
lyrics:
1. Chon Nyasaye nokelo
Chik apar moloyo;
An Nyasaye, Jehova:
Onge moro koda.

2. Gi ma ji gilamo,
Ma gine gi wang'gi,
Mago kik idew ngang';
Mago ok Nyasachi.

3. Kik iwachi piyo
Weche mak iparo:
Dhogi mosechiko,
Ber itim kamano.

4. Tich Nyasaye nomiyi,
Ber itiyo pile:
Walni Ruoth chieng' diro
Par malong'o chierne.

5. Winji jo madongo
Wuoru kodi meru;
To Nyasaye nomiyi
Gik mar piny miwuoro.

6. Kik ima owadu
Mak inyalo miye;
Kik inegi dhano;
Chunyi kik ochaye.

7. Chiwri ni Nyasachi:
Chunyi kik ogombi:
Kata gi manadi
Dineg chunyi marach.

8. Gik mibedo godo,
Mago mond' oromi;
Kik iyie kwalo
Wachi adier kende.

9. Injili to wacho
Ruoth Yesu nothonwa
Mond' ng'at moyie kuome
Bura kik oloye.

10. Remb Yesu manochwer
Ni kod teko duto
Mar puodho chuny dhano
Kendo kete thuolo.

11. Roho Maler mar Ruoth
Kodak ei chunywa
To wanyalo mako
Chike duto mag Ruoth.

title: Kik Yie Tem Oloyi
lyrics:
1. Kik yie tem oloyi, Richo dikethi,
In to ked lueny maber, nyaka ilo lweny.
Tam gombo mar ringruok kod richo duto,
Teg wang'i kuom Yesu, nomii loyo.

Chorus:
Kwa Jawar mond' okonyi
Kod tekone moriti:
En to ok noweyi ngang',
Nilo kuome pile.

2. Pogri gi joketho, kik iwuo marach,
Luor Nying Nyasaye pile, Kik wachi kayiem.
Jiwri kuom tim maber, hul gi ma adier,
Ket chunyi kuom Yesu, nokonyi chutho.

3. Joloyo noyudi osimbo mar duong';
Kuom yie e minyalo duto kata tek.
En moseherowa Nomiwa teko,
Teg wang'i kuom Yesu Nokonyi chutho.

title: Nitie Gi Maber Moloyo
lyrics:
1. Wawinjo kuom nga'to moro
Ma jasol osuru.
To mokone ok norome
Nodwaro gi maber.

Chorus:
Nitie gi maber moloyo,
Gik ma ni e piny:
King'eyo richoni nowe,
En gi maber chutho.

2. Nobedo ka ng'atni nodhi
Mondo one Yesu,
Kowinjo obiro e yo
Kod gi maber chutho.

3. Zakayo ne en nyadundo
Moidho e ng'owo,
Moneno Yesu kabiro
Kodwaro gi maber.

4. To Yesu nong'iyo malo
Mowacho "Lor piyo,
Koro abiro e odi
Akelni gi maber."

5. Mi nolor moruake gi mor
Noyudo gi maber,
Hera gi mor kod kwe e chuny
E moloyo duto.

title: Wend Kendruok
lyrics:
1. Wamor ka ji moko biro,
Ka gitimo chik mar Ruodhwa,
Mondo gilos kendruok maber
Kaka Jehovah noketo.

2. Kitap Nyasaye owach adier,
Kuom kendruok maber malong'o,
Kaka jariyo dok achiel,
Ranyis kanisa gi Kristo.

3. Ji duto ok omako chik,
To jo man gi Roho kende,
Yesu opuonjowa kama,
E Mathayo sula abich.

4. Moruru jo mo mako chik,
Lamuru un modonjie,
Ni kik Satani geng'u ngang',
Kuom yudo gweth mar Nyasachwa.

5. Wamor kuom Ruoth Yesu Kristo,
Wamor kuom chikne malong'o,
Wamor kuom jomodonjie yo,
Wanyalo mor manyaka chieng'.

title: Yesu Nohero Joge
lyrics:
1. Yesu nohero Kanisa mi nochiwore,
Chwo mondo giher mondgi gi hera makama
Mondo ng'at' obedgi chiege owuon (chiege owuon)
Kendo dhako bedgi chwore owuon.

Chorus:
Ka hera ni e ot kwe mari osiko
Yaye Ruoth riw chuny jogi mochungo
E nyimi ka gi hera matut michiwonua
Ae polo mondo nyingi oyudi duong'. (Repeat chorus)

2. Kanisa to owinjo weche mag Ruodhwa
Ka mon owinjo chwogi, winjruok nitie maber
Kristo e molosonwa winjruok ma (makama)
Kristo e molosonwa winjruok.

3. Owetewa ariyo mochungo nyimi ka
Riw chunygi chutho koro gi hera mosiko
In Kristo miseloso winjruok (makama)
Mondo gibed gi hera kod kuwe.

4. Roho Maler wasayi bedi machiegni
Konyruok moro to onge mak in mibet kodwa,
Iselosonwa winjruok maber (koro ka,)
Nyingi mondo oyudi duong'.

title: Kech Maduong' E Israel
lyrics:
1. Ndalo mane jobura rito piny,
Kech maduong' nowuok e Israel,
Ja Bethlehem Juda moro nodhi Moab,
Gi chiege kod yawuote ariyo.

Chorus:
To Ruth nodwoke niya: Kik ichun' apogra kodi,
Ni mond' adogi mak aluwi, Kamidhiye ema nadhiye
To Ruth nodwoke niya: Kamidakie 'manadagie,
Jou duto nobed jowa, Nyasachi nobed Nyasacha.
To Ruth nodwoke niya: Kamithoe manoyikae,
Kamano onge gi moro, Tho kende ema nopogwa.

2. Yawuotego nokendo nyi Moab,
Achiel Orpa, machielo nene Ruth,
Wuongi notho kuno gi yawuote,
Dhier gi parruok nomako Naome.

3. Israel nogwedh bang' higni apar,
Naome noparo mond' odogi,
Nokwayo Orpa gi Ruth odog thuchegi,
Nogonyogi mondo okendgi kendo.

title: Wimbo Wa Taifa
lyrics:
Kiswahili

1. Ee Mungu nguvu yetu
Ilete baraka kwetu.
Haki iwe ngao na mlinzi
Na tukae na udugu
Amani na uhuru
Raha tupate na ustawi.

2. Amkeni ndugu zetu
Tufanye sote bidii.
Nasi tujitoe kwa nguvu
Nchi yetu ya Kenya,
Tunayoipenda,
Tuwe tayari kuilinda.

3. Natujenge taifa letu
Ee, ndio wajibu wetu
Kenya istahili heshima,
Tuungane mikono
Pamoja kazini
Kila siku tuwe na shukrani.

English

1. O God of all creation,
Bless this our land and nation.
Justice be our shield and defender
May we dwell in unity,
Peace and liberty;
Plenty be found within our borders.

2. Let one and all arise
With hearts both strong and true.
Service be our earnest endeavour,
And our Homeland of Kenya,
Heritage of splendour,
Firm may we stand to defend.

3. Let all with one accord
In common bond united,
Build this our nation together,
And the glory of Kenya,
The fruit of our labour,
Fill every heart with thanksgiving.
